Title: Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Data Analyst - Join Our Innovative Team at think-cell Software




Our Story

At think-cell, we create powerful software solutions that help professionals be more efficient and productive. Founded in 2002 and based in Berlin, our tools integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Office to help users create presentations, charts, and diagrams with ease. Our dynamic, international team values creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence.




What You Will Do

We're a Data Team that operates like a scaleup within an established company: real ownership, short decision paths, and room to shape things. No corporate bureaucracy – but the resources of a mature business. Our team is made up of experienced senior individual contributors who work independently, challenge each other constructively, and collaborate closely on solving complex problems. It is an environment with a high level of trust, autonomy, and strong opportunities to learn from experienced peers across both technical and business topics.

You don't just analyze – you drive. You proactively identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, build the foundations to answer questions, and make sure stakeholders don't just receive dashboards, but know what to do with them.




Key Responsibilities:

Building and maintaining scalable data models and pipelines
Translating business questions into structured analytical approaches and communicating them in whatever format stakeholders actually need
Collaborating with teams across the company to improve data quality, transparency and accessibility
Contributing to the development of our data culture, standards, and ways of working




You will be great for this position if you have

3+ years of experience in Analytics, BI, or a similar role
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt
Experience with PowerBI
You guide stakeholders – not just serve them, both communication and domain wise
A proactive and ownership-driven mindset
Interest in improving processes and increasing efficiency, including through ML/LLM-based approaches




Our Values

As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us:

Forward Thinking: We embrace change and challenge the status quo.

Ownership: We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes.

Customer First: We prioritize delivering lasting value.

Unified Team: We foster collaboration, respect, and integrity.

Strive for Excellence: We set ambitious goals and pursue quality.




Why is think-cell the right place for you?

We empower over 1.3 million users across 35,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Munich, Denver, Boston, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 220 people, committed to innovation and excellence.

think-cell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Analytics Engineer

(€70K – €140K


Offers Equity
Offers Bonus)


Join our team as an Analytics Engineer, where you'll ensure our data is clean, accessible, and ready for analysis. As a core member of our analytics team, you’ll ensure our data infrastructure effectively supports self-service analytics, insightful reporting, and business intelligence across the organisation.

What You’ll Do 🎯


Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable, and performance-optimised data models using SQL and dbt.
Apply software engineering practices to analytics code, including version control, testing, and continuous integration.
Automate and streamline data validation, testing, and reporting processes.
Take ownership of data analysis for a designated domain, collaborating closely with Product Analysts, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to meet their analytical and reporting needs.
Proactively monitor data integrity, identify issues, and perform root cause analysis.
Maintain comprehensive data documentation and definitions for easy reference and understanding.
Train business users on utilising the data platform and data visualisation tools effectively.


What You’ll Bring 💡


2-4 years of experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, or similar role.
Experience in marketing analytics, with proficiency in SQL and Python.
Understanding of data warehousing concepts, data modelling, and performance optimization.
Knowledge of data validation, testing frameworks, and version control best practices (Git).
Familiarity with modern data stacks (dbt, Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift, Dagster/Airflow) and cloud data platforms (GCP, AWS).
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, influencing data-driven decisions.


What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟


Passionate about transforming data into actionable insights.
A detail-oriented problem-solver who excels in a collaborative environment.
Eager to innovate and continuously improve data processes.


Why Almedia? 🎁


Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.
Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.
Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.
Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.


We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Title: Data & Platform Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
NeXtWind betreibt und entwickelt Windenergieanlagen in Deutschland mit dem Ziel, bis 2028 auf 3 GW zu wachsen. Unser Data & IT-Team baut die interne Dateninfrastruktur als Produkt: Airtable als operativer Kern, automatisierte Prozesse und AI-Use-Cases in der Pipeline. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unsere Datenplattform — von der Architektur bis zur Adoption.




Deine Aufgaben




Datenplattform

Airtable-Architektur weiterentwickeln, pflegen und dokumentieren (Bases, Interfaces, Automations, Skripte)
Datenmodelle designen: Feldstandards, Naming Conventions, Tabellenbeziehungen — konsistent und zukunftsfähig
Schnittstellenmanagement ausbauen: Interfaces für Fachabteilungen bauen und iterieren
Automatisierte Reports aufsetzen und betreiben
Datenqualitätsprozesse definieren und gemeinsam mit den Teams einführen
AI- und Automatisierungs-Use-Cases identifizieren und mitumsetzen
Self-Service-Zugang für Fachabteilungen ausbauen




Dein Profil




Muss

Airtable: tiefes Verständnis von Bases, Interfaces, Automations und Scripting
Datenarchitektur: strukturiertes Denken in Datenmodellen, Abhängigkeiten und Standards
Sehr gutes Deutsch (Unternehmenssprache, schriftlich und mündlich)
Gutes Englisch (Teamkommunikation, externe Partner)
Eigenverantwortung: du bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne Micromanagement
Kommunikationsstärke: du kannst technische Konzepte für Nicht-Techniker verständlich machen

Von Vorteil

Erfahrung mit weiteren No-Code/Low-Code-Tools (z.B. Claude, n8n, Power Automate) und API-Verwendung
Python oder andere Scripting-Kenntnisse
Erfahrung in der Energie- oder Infrastrukturbranche




Warum wir?




NeXtWind ist angetrieben und beseelt von der Nutzung innovativer Technologien und Ansätze zur Schaffung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft. Unser Engagement für saubere Energielösungen macht uns zu starken Herausforderern im deutschen Energiesektor. Darüber hinaus ist unser Unternehmen auf einem Fundament stabiler Kernwerte gebaut, die unsere Kultur definieren und prägen.




Transparenz und Eigeninitiative stehen bei uns hoch im Kurs. Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander - intern wie extern - ist die unverzichtbare Grundlage unseres Handelns. In unserer Zusammenarbeit sind wir schnell und offen für unvermeidbare Fehler auf dem Weg zur Verbesserung. Kollegialität und gegenseitige Unterstützung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.




Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden jederzeit Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und zum Wachstum, basierend auf ihren individuellen Fähigkeiten und Neigungen. Flexibilität, so zu arbeiten, wie es optimale Produktivität und Effizienz ermöglicht, ist für uns selbstverständlich.




Wir bieten dir:

Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket
Abschluss einer provisionsfreien Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV)
Kostenlose Coaching-Sitzungen für deine Mentale Gesundheit mit unserem Partner nilo (Meditationen, Schreibübungen & weitere mentale Gesundheitsangebote)
Alle 2 Wochen laden wir dich zum Team-Mittagessen mit Catering ein
Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Energiewende mitzuwirken und einen positiven Einfluss auf die Umwelt zu nehmen




Bringe frischen Wind in Deine Karriere.




Wenn Du Leidenschaft für erneuerbare Energien hast und die nötigen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen mitbringst, um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Location: We are flexible! Come and join us either in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona.

Freenow empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Product Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our product squads, using data to build a flawless product experience. You will join the Product Data Team and work closely with PMs, designers, UX researchers, developers, and other data functions to discover new product opportunities, validate hypotheses, and launch valuable features to our users.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Providing expertise and collaborating with stakeholders to generate new product feature ideas and improvements, and also estimating the potential impact of planned projects.
Continuously engaging with the product squads to gain an understanding of the problems that need to be solved, gathering requirements, and defining the best deliverables to match the business needs.
Having full ownership of your analysis, from ideation to communication of results and making recommendations to all levels of the company including senior management and prioritization committees.
Developing and evaluating A/B test experiments or other analyses to measure and report the performance of released features, ensuring that we are launching the correct changes and features in our apps.
Working closely with our developers and data engineers to create and capture data that is aligned with the business logic and allows modeling and analysis.
Being involved throughout the complete product lifecycle in order to guarantee a data-driven process.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
You will have the opportunity to steer our products, which kind of features should be developed, and which changes should be made to solve hundreds of thousands of users' daily needs.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other fields with a strong mathematical-statistical background
3+ years experience in working as a Data Analyst in a data-driven analytics environment, preferably within tech product organizations, having direct contact with stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical skills, lateral thinking, and proven experience in solving highly challenging problems.
Very good knowledge of SQL, databases, and statistical programming tools (e.g. Python, R) so that exploratory analyses can be performed, reports created and ETLs maintained
Good understanding and hands-on experience in analyzing and interpreting A/B test results, backed by statistical knowledge.
Experience in working with data visualisation tools (e.g.Tableau, Qlikview) and event tracking (e.g. Mixpanel, GA, Firebase)
You are able to communicate findings in a concise and clear manner to a wide variety of stakeholders to support data-driven decision making by using data visualisation and storytelling and have excellent English communication skills.


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


Plus more local benefits depending on your work location!

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

ABOUT US:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app.

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

Title: Analytics Engineer (f/m/d)
Description:
We are smava – the online credit comparison platform. We make loans transparent, fair and affordable! With more than 300.000 satisfied customers, we are one of the biggest FinTech companies in Germany. Become now part of our vision to shape the digital future of the consumer loan market!

YOUR NEW TEAM

The Data Platform team provides the data infrastructure, advanced modeling frameworks, and analytical services to our entire organization. Our work spans the entire data lifecycle, from building robust pipelines and Data Vault models to delivering clean dbt datasets, creating reports using Tableau and Hex, and partnering with business stakeholders to solve complex analytical problems and help drive key business decisions. What You Will Be Doing



Build, maintain, and optimize reliable data pipelines and transformation models using dbt and Dagster.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and analysts to understand their data requirements and translate them into actionable data solutions.
Contribute to our centralized reporting models and framework, working with Data Vault principles.
Design and deliver high-quality, intuitive reports and analyses in Tableau or Hex to help drive key business decisions.
Ensure data reliability, performance, and quality across our transformation layers through robust testing and documentation.
Take an active part in team decisions regarding technical best practices, goals, timelines, and our modern stack.



OUR TECH STACK



Platform: AWS (S3, Redshift, Aurora, Glue, DMS, EC2, ECS, Fargate, Lambda, etc.)
Transformation & Orchestration: dbt, Dagster, Python
Data Ingestion & Streaming: SNS, SQS, Segment, Kinesis
DataOps & Infrastructure: Terraform, Docker, Github
Analytics & Visualization: Tableau, Hex



YOUR PROFILE



A solution-driven mindset with strong ownership mentality, a passion for self-learning and continuous improvement
2+ years of experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, BI Developer, or in a similar data role.
Strong SQL skills with the ability to write clean, optimized queries to manipulate and join complex datasets.
Hands-on experience or solid familiarity with dbt, modular modeling, and testing.
Experience working with BI tools, preferably Tableau and Hex.
Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders to translate analytical requirements into technical solutions.
Familiarity with leveraging modern AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot or similar LLMs) to optimize and accelerate your daily coding, debugging, and documentation workflows.



Nice-to-Haves:



Experience or familiarity with cloud data warehouses, preferably Amazon Redshift.
Familiarity with Data Vault architecture or similar data warehousing design methodologies (such as Kimball or Inmon).
Exposure to modern orchestration tools like Dagster or Airflow.
Familiarity with modern data architecture (e.g. data lakes, data lakehouses, data mesh)
Experience working within the FinTech or banking sectors.



Don’t meet every single requirement? We are not simply looking for years of experience – we are looking for the right person and are open to both mid-level and senior profiles. If you are excited about this role and meet the essential criteria but your previous experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Title: Marketing Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Your role

We are looking for a curious and insightful Marketing Data Analyst (all genders) to join our expanding Commercial Data Science team. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how we understand our customers and optimize our marketing efforts across marketing channels and countries.

In this role, you won’t just report numbers, you will be a strategic partner. You will connect the dots between acquisition and retention, using data to uncover narratives that drive efficiency and growth. If you are passionate about the intersection of data, marketing, and business impact, we would love to meet you.


Collaborate closely with Performance Marketing, CRM, and Influencer teams to align data insights with our acquisition and retention goals
Analyze complex datasets from ad platforms, such as Google, Meta, TikTok, web analytics (GA4), and internal order systems to refine targeting and budget allocation across channels and countries
Leverage dbt and BigQuery to ensure our marketing data models are robust, reliable, and ready for decision-making
Build intuitive dashboards with Tableau that provide stakeholders with clear and actionable insights
Design and analyze A/B tests and geo-lift studies and focus relentlessly on incremental lift, helping stakeholders understand what revenue we wouldn't have generated without a specific marketing touchpoint
Utilize, co-develop and validate our in-house Media Mix Models (MMM) to assess the holistic impact of our marketing spend and implement advanced analytical methods to optimize our marketing


Your profile


3-5 years in data analytics with a focus on commercial or marketing topics
Strong SQL skills are essential - you are self-sufficient in querying and manipulating large datasets within cloud environments like BigQuery to answer complex business questions
You design intuitive dashboards and reports that guide the user and present data in a way that allows stakeholders to effortlessly draw the right conclusions and make informed decisions
You have a solid understanding of the D2C marketing mix, incl. Performance, CRM, and Influencer and the KPIs that drive them, such as CAC, CLV, MER, retention rates
You are proactive, thrive in fast-paced environments and are able to navigate shifting priorities and manage multiple projects with a solution-oriented mindset
You excel at translating complex data into clear business insights and feel comfortable engaging with stakeholders to refine ideas and strategies


What We Offer


An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients
We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year
The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket
We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad
Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia
You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas
Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world
We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day


Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Description:
Analytics Engineer

Build the Data Foundation That Powers Every Product Decision

Doodle is a B2B SaaS platform used by millions of professionals to coordinate meetings and collaboration. As we continue expanding our platform, trusted data has become one of our most valuable products. Every product decision, customer insight, experiment, and business metric depends on reliable, well modelled data.

You are more than an Analytics Engineer. You are responsible for building the trusted data foundation that enables better decisions across Doodle. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Leadership, you will transform raw product data into trusted, scalable datasets that power experimentation, reporting, and product innovation.

What You Will Do

As an Analytics Engineer, you will own the analytics platform that enables self service insights across Doodle.

Analytics Platform


Design, build, and maintain scalable analytics data models using dbt and modern data engineering practices.
Develop reliable transformation pipelines that convert raw product data into trusted, business ready datasets.
Own the performance, reliability, and continuous improvement of Doodle's analytics platform.


Data Modelling & Semantic Layer


Define, document, and maintain trusted business metrics used across the company.
Build and evolve a scalable semantic layer that enables consistent reporting and self service analytics.
Ensure data definitions remain accurate, accessible, and aligned across teams.


Data Quality & Governance


Own data quality, validation, testing, monitoring, and governance across the analytics stack.
Implement best practices for documentation, version control, CI, and automated testing.
Establish standards that improve data reliability, consistency, security, and trust.


Product Analytics & Experimentation


Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to enable experimentation, funnel analysis, retention analysis, and customer insights.
Support product launches by providing reliable measurement frameworks and trusted analytics.
Enable accurate A B testing through high quality event modelling and instrumentation.


Cross Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Finance, and Leadership teams.
Translate business questions into scalable data models, trusted metrics, and actionable insights.
Advise teams on analytics architecture, data modelling standards, and best practices.
Influence product and business decisions by making data reliable, accessible, and easy to use.


Our Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who combines strong engineering fundamentals with a product mindset and a passion for building trusted, scalable analytics platforms.

Analytics Engineering


Strong experience building analytics data models using dbt or similar transformation frameworks.
Experience orchestrating modern data pipelines using Airflow or similar workflow tools.
Advanced SQL skills with experience working on large analytical datasets.
Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Amazon Redshift. Experience with Athena or Spark is an advantage.


Programming & Analytics


Strong Python skills for data processing and automation.
Good understanding of dimensional data modelling, database design, and analytics engineering principles.
Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and product analytics.


Engineering Excellence


Quality first mindset with experience in testing, documentation, version control, and CI.
Passion for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable analytics platforms.
Strong problem solving skills with excellent attention to detail.


Collaboration & Communication


Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working across Engineering, Product, Analytics, and business teams.
Enjoy collaborating in a fast moving SaaS environment.


Nice to Have


Experience with pandas or similar Python data processing libraries.
Experience supporting Product Led Growth organizations.
Experience building semantic layers or self service analytics platforms.
Experience with product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4.
Experience working in a modern B2B SaaS environment.


Hiring Journey


Initial Application Review + BRYQ Assessment
Hiring Manager Interview
Technical Assessment
Cross Functional Technical Interview
Executive Interview + HR Interview


So, Get in Touch!

At Doodle, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual trust and respect, where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to age, race, color, disability, religion, gender, or sexual orientation. Diversity and inclusion are important to us because the best products are built by teams with different experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds.

IMPORTANT NOTICE: Please note that we can only consider your application if you are based and have the right to work in Germany or London. At this time, we are unable to sponsor visas for this position or support relocation.

Title: Web Analyst (m/f/d) - Marketing & Data
Description:
We are home24, one of the leading home & living e-commerce platforms in continental Europe. We utilize data to provide personalized recommendations, tips, and inspiration for every home. We are looking for a Web Analyst (m/f/d) to join our team. In this role, you will support our marketing teams by ensuring data quality, maintaining our tracking setup, and delivering actionable insights through data visualization.

Your Responsibilities


You drive the implementation and maintenance of tracking concepts in GA4 and sGTM, refining event structures and debugging discrepancies to ensure delivery of high-quality data e.g. for attribution modeling and the design and evaluation of A/B tests
You evaluate the performance of marketing campaigns across various channels
You don't just deliver numbers, but interpret data to help the team understand trends and optimize ROI
You build and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., in Tableau or Looker) to monitor key marketing metrics, translating business requirements into clear visualizations
You look beyond standard KPIs to investigate the "why" behind the data, conducting ad-hoc deep dives to uncover the root causes of performance shifts and user behavior
You act as a contact person for analytical questions regarding GA4, helping stakeholders understand their data usage needs
You monitor the data flow to ensure accuracy and support the team in identifying and fixing bugs in the tracking landscape


Your Profile


You have professional experience in web analytics, data analysis, or a related field, ideally within an e-commerce environment
You have hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and (server-side) Google Tag Manager (sGTM)
You are proficient in SQL, capable of merging and transforming large-scale datasets from diverse sources. Proficiency in Python is a strong plus for building scalable data solutions
You have a basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to comprehend how tracking is implemented
Your mindset combines natural curiosity for new trends with a sharp eye for detail, ensuring your end-to-end thinking always aligns with the bigger picture
You have excellent English skills and can communicate your findings in a clear, structured way
You thrive in cross-functional collaboration, acting as a bridge between marketing, data, and tech teams


What We Offer You

Title: Datenanalyst / Data Engineer (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir sind Bertrandt.

Ein eigenständiger und internationaler Engineering Dienstleister mit langjähriger Expertise. Mit branchenübergreifendem Know-how und einem ganzheitlichen System- und Produktverständnis schaffen wir technologische Lösungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Wir beschäftigen uns mit den Trendthemen Digitalisierung, E-Mobilität und Autonome Systeme hauptsächlich für die Branchen Automotive, Luftfahrt, Defence und Maschinenbau und ermöglichen hier konsequent die Entstehung passgenauer Lösungen. Unser Ziel: den technologischen Fortschritt beschleunigen und einen relevanten Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Zukunft leisten. Daran arbeiten wir jeden Tag – mit rund 12.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an über 50 Standorten weltweit.

Was Sie Erwartet


Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung von Softwaretools zur Erfassung von Daten verschiedener Datenlieferanten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen, darunter Datenbanken, Tabellenkalkulationen und Unternehmenssysteme
Bereinigung, Validierung, Kontrolle und Organisation von Datensätzen für Berichts- und Analysezwecke
Pflege von Datensätzen und Unterstützung von Data-Governance-Maßnahmen
Analyse großer Datensätze zur Identifizierung von Trends, Mustern und Anomalien
Durchführung von Analysen zur Bewertung der Qualität der Datenlieferanten vor der Freigabe an den Kunden
Unterstützung bei Ad-hoc-Anfragen verschiedener Abteilungen zur Datenanalyse
Entwicklung und Pflege regelmäßiger Berichte, Dashboards und Leistungs-Scorecards
Präsentation von Daten auf klare und visuell ansprechende Weise mithilfe von Diagrammen, Tabellen und Dashboards
Verfolgung von Leistungskennzahlen (KPIs)
Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Berichtsprozessen, Datenqualität und Analysemethoden
Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung von Datenstandards, Vorlagen und Best Practices


Was Sie Mitbringen


Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Datenanalyse, Statistik, Informatik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung
Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Analyse und Aufbereitung von Daten
Grundverständnis im Bereich Informationssysteme von Vorteil
Sicherer Umgang mit Excel bzw. Google Sheets
Gute Kenntnisse in SQL zur Datenabfrage und -verarbeitung
Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Tableau
Programmierkenntnisse in Python oder R zur Datenanalyse und Automatisierung
Sehr gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil
Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft für gelegentliche kurzfristige Dienstreisen


Bertrandt legt großen Wert auf Gleichbehandlung und Chancengleichheit. Unsere Recruiting-Entscheidungen basieren auf den Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten der Bewerber*innen. Schwerbehinderte Menschen bzw. gleichgestellte Menschen im Sinne des SGB IX sind herzlich willkommen und werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.

Title: Pricing Analyst - Dynamic Pricing (m/f/d)
Description:
kfzteile24 is Germany’s leading digital company for car parts and automotive accessories. Based in Berlin, we operate as a multichannel business comprising the successful online shops kfzteile24.de, autoteile24.de, carpardoo.fr, carpardoo.nl, and carpardoo.dk, alongside physical branches and workshops. We are Germany’s best-known brand in the online automotive aftermarket. Through expert advice, an extensive product range, and fast, reliable parts delivery, we help maintain individual mobility. Our goal now is to transform an already highly successful company into an innovative top player in one of the most exciting sectors of the German economy.

This is not a reporting role. You'll own hypotheses, challenge assumptions, and push back on gut-feel decisions with data. You'll work close to the business, close to the numbers, and close to decisions that have real commercial impact. If that sounds natural to you, read on.

What We Offer


Permanent employment contract and 30 days vacation
Possibility of home office 3 days a week
Internal and external training opportunities
Up to 50% employee discount in our branches and workshops
Various health and sport offers (e.g. Bike-Leasing, screen glasses / monitor glasses (VDU))
Additional benefits such as language courses via Babbel, company pension plan, corporate benefits


Your Responsibilities


Price Analysis & Market Intelligence You analyze price elasticities, track competitor movements, and identify demand trends. You don't just surface findings; you translate them into concrete pricing recommendations.
Performance Monitoring You measure the impact of pricing decisions in your area and actively steer based on what the data tells you. You know when a metric is moving for the right reason — and when it isn't.
Project Ownership You take smaller pricing initiatives from hypothesis to implementation independently. In larger projects, you're an active contributor.
Decision Papers You turn complex data into clear recommendations and communicate them at the right level of detail — for stakeholders who don't speak pricing, and for leadership who need to act fast.
Stakeholder Interfaces You coordinate pricing topics across Sales, Marketing, Procurement, and IT. You make pricing legible to people outside the discipline.


Your Skills


3–5 years of professional experience in an analytical pricing, revenue, or data role — ideally in e-commerce or retail
SQL is a prerequisite: You write your own queries, work with large datasets, and know what you're looking for before you start.
Tableau or Power BI: You visualize insights in a way that drives decisions
Google Sheets or Excel: You know when a pivot is enough — and when it isn't
AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT): You use them to accelerate your own analytical workflow — not as a substitute for thinking. You evaluate outputs critically, and know where AI breaks down
Critical thinking: You recognize when a number is right — and when it's lying. Especially when the data is incomplete
Languages: You communicate fluently in both German and English (minimum C1)


Nice to Have

These aren't required, but relevant experience that helps from day one:


Python or R - queries, large dataset analysis, automation
Experience with automated pricing systems or repricing tools
Background in the automotive aftermarket or spare parts industry


Apply now!

If you would like to be part of our motivated Pricing team, apply now for the position with us as Pricing Analyst - Dynamic Pricing (m/f/d) , stating your salary expectations and your earliest starting date. If you have any questions, please contact Irina Ring at +49 1520 315 4804.

Please note that we only consider applications via our online portal. Applications by post or e-mail will not be considered and deleted.

For more information on data processing, see our data protection declaration.

Begleite KPMG bei den Herausforderungen unserer Kund:innen und bringe Deine Begeisterung für innovative Lösungen ein. Entwickle gemeinsam mit Deinem Team moderne Anwendungen und setze Impulse, die den Unterschied machen.

Deine Aufgaben

Mit Deiner Expertise möchtest Du den Aufbau der Pricing Excellence bei KPMG aktiv gestalten? Dann kannst Du Dich hier einbringen:



Modellierung & Datenmanagement: Du konzipierst und optimierst Datenmodelle und Datenbankstrukturen, um eine konsistente und effiziente Datenbasis sicherzustellen.
Datenintegration & Analyse: Du integrierst Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen, analysierst diese z.B. in Power BI und unterstützt das Management bei der Ableitung fundierter Entscheidungen.
KI Enablement & Automatisierung: Du identifizierst Potenziale für den Einsatz von KI und generativer KI innerhalb von Geschäftsprozessen, entwickelst entsprechende Use Cases und setzt automatisierte Workflows um.
Low-Code Entwicklung: Du entwickelst individuelle Anwendungen zur Optimierung interner Prozesse – vor allem mit Low-Code-Plattformen wie Microsoft Power Apps.
Schnittstellenarbeit & Abstimmung: Du arbeitest eng mit Fachteams und Stakeholdern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Deine entwickelten Lösungen die strategischen Ziele von KPMG unterstützen.
Anforderungsmanagement: Du überführst fachliche Anforderungen in technische Konzepte – im Einklang mit unseren organisatorischen Rahmenbedingungen und Systemlandschaften.



Dein Profil



Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, IT-Management oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Zusätzlich bringst Du idealerweise mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Engineering oder Tool-Entwicklung mit.
Technologie Know-How: Du verfügst über Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise mit Low-Code-Plattformen, sowie gute Kenntnisse in Datenbankmanagement, Datenmodellierung und -integration.
Tool Kenntnisse: Du hast bestenfalls bereits mit SAP Datasphere gearbeitet und bringst Kenntnisse in JavaScript, TypeScript oder React mit.
Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und bringst gerne eigene Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Lösungen ein.
Sprache: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) in Wort und Schrift.



Deine Benefits



Willkommen im Team Damit Du von Beginn an voll bei uns durchstarten kannst, begleiten wir Dich mit strukturierten Onboarding-Maßnahmen während der gesamten Orientierungsphase. Zudem fördert Deine Führungskraft gezielt Deine fachliche und persönliche Integration ins Team.
Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven Wir legen Wert auf die individuelle Entwicklung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken: Deine eigenen Ambitionen reflektieren wir in strukturierten Entwicklungsgesprächen. Systematische und regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche unterstützen Dich beim Erreichen dieser Ziele. Title: Analytics Engineer (Decision Logic / Rules) _metrify
Description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

metrify is Enpal’s smart metering unit and the digital infrastructure for a smart energy ecosystem. Title: People Data & Systems Advisor
Description:
About Marley Spoon

We are… a global food brand built for people who truly care about what they eat, even when life gets busy. From the US to Australia and across Europe, we support busy food lovers who see meals as more than a task.

We do… bring ease and inspiration into everyday eating — creating flexible, high-quality options that help people enjoy food that feels good, simply and naturally.

Our brand vision is… to make great food feel effortless and exciting every day, helping people build food habits that fit their lives.

The Role in a Nutshell

We're looking for an automation-first People Data & Systems Advisor to lead our data initiatives and serve as the architect and first point of contact of our HR tech stack. While you will support core compensation data—including benchmarking, job leveling, and EU Pay Transparency readiness—your primary focus will be on data analysis, integrity, systems integration, reporting and advanced automation.

You'll also drive the automation agenda: identifying manual processes across the employee lifecycle and re-engineering them into streamlined, AI-enabled workflows.


Serve as the go-to expert for People analytics, driving data compliance, delivering strategic analysis and quarterly People Reviews for key stakeholders, and partnering with Finance to spearhead People-related audits.
Support compensation end-to-end — salary benchmarking, range development, job leveling, and readiness for the EU Pay Transparency Directive
Lead compensation reporting — pay equity analysis, gender pay gap reporting, benchmarking, and STI/LTI program administration
Be the global owner of our HRIS and other tools — data accuracy, consolidation across tools, and support for audits and quarterly People Reviews
Drive process automation and AI adoption — auditing HR lifecycle workflows (onboarding, offboarding, role changes) and rebuilding them as automated, streamlined experiences
Bridge People and IT/Engineering — ensuring clean API integrations, provisioning workflows, and stack alignment
Build AI literacy across the People team — training others on prompting and automation shortcuts that save time


Is This You?

You're the person who spots a manual process and can't help but fix it. Numbers don't intimidate you — you use them to make the case. You've navigated compensation frameworks, equity plans, or pay equity work and actually enjoyed it. And you're excited by AI and automation, not just as buzzwords, but as tools to make people's work lives better.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.

What You Bring


2–3 years of experience in data analysis and HR roles
Working knowledge of compensation frameworks and reward instruments
Experience with pay equity analysis, gender pay gap reporting, and compensation compliance
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; Power BI or Tableau a plus
Comfort managing cross-functional projects with competing stakeholder needs
Sharp communication skills — you can translate data into decisions for non-HR leadership
Fluent English
Experience with workflow automation platforms and LLM/AI productivity tools


Nice to Have

International payroll/tax exposure, startup or high-growth experience, equity incentive plans, German/Portuguese/Dutch fluency, HRIS experience (e.g., BambooHR).

Our Values


We are entrepreneurs — get things done, dare, always have a plan B.
We enjoy what we do — assume positive intent, treat problems as opportunities.
We act with integrity — radically candid, always asking why.
We are ambitious — details matter, data over opinions.
We are team players — own your work, no ego, disagree and commit.


Benefits


Vary by location

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Your tasks:




Act as the central data expert and Business Data Steward for the German Mortgages business.
Analyse customer, product, portfolio, channel and risk data to provide insights, identify trends, detect anomalies and support business decision-making.

Fluent in spoken and written English.

Du willst im Bereich Data Science & Analytics dort arbeiten, wo es wirklich zählt – an komplexen Industrieprojekten mit direktem Einfluss auf Entscheidungen auf Management-Ebene?

Bei DRIVE Consulting arbeitest du an anspruchsvollen Fragestellungen führender Industrieunternehmen. Du unterstützt dabei, datengetriebene Entscheidungen in Transformations- und Beratungsprojekten umzusetzen. Unsere Analysen und Dashboards fließen direkt in das Reporting und die Entscheidungsgrundlagen unserer Kunden ein.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du hands-on an Analytics-Lösungen und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Dashboards, der Analyse komplexer Daten sowie beim Aufbau von Datenstrukturen und -pipelines. Dabei begleitest du Projekte von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und entwickelst deine fachlichen und methodischen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiter.

Du arbeitest an Analytics-Workstreams in Kundenprojekten und übernimmst Verantwortung für eigene Aufgaben und Teilprojekte
Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst und betreibst du Datenpipelines zwischen Cloud-Quellen und Analytics- bzw. Dashboard-Tools und stellst deren Qualität, Automatisierung und Performance sicher (insbesondere über SQL)
Du konzipierst und entwickelst Dashboards mit Fokus auf Usability und klare Entscheidungsunterstützung für das Management
Du analysierst komplexe und heterogene Datenstrukturen, bereitest Daten auf und führst verschiedene Datenquellen effizient zusammen
Du führst Ad-hoc-Analysen und explorative Auswertungen durch und bereitest Ergebnisse adressatengerecht auf
Du arbeitest eng im Projektteam und mit relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen und treibst die Umsetzung datengetriebener Lösungen aktiv voran
Du unterstützt bei Architekturfragen, Priorisierungen und der Weiterentwicklung von Analytics-Lösungen
Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst dich fachlich und methodisch kontinuierlich weiter

Du hast erste Berufserfahrung (ca. 1–3 Jahre) im Bereich Data Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Umfeld
Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Python und bist in der Lage, komplexe Datenstrukturen eigenständig zu analysieren und aufzubereiten
Du hast erste Erfahrung im Aufbau von Datenpipelines und/oder im Dashboarding gesammelt
Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit BI-Tools (z. B. AWS QuickSight, Grafana, Tableau, etc.) mit
Du arbeitest analytisch und strukturiert und hast Freude daran, komplexe Fragestellungen zu lösen
Du denkst dich schnell in neue Themen ein und entwickelst dich fachlich kontinuierlich weiter
Idealerweise hast du erste Berührungspunkte mit Prozessen in der Automobilindustrie oder im industriellen Umfeld
Du arbeitest gerne im Team, kommunizierst klar und trittst auch im Austausch mit Kunden sicher auf
Du bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu arbeiten


Unser Angebot an dich

Bei DRIVE Consulting triffst du auf ein junges, wachsendes Team, dessen Herz für technische Beratungsprojekte in der Industrie schlägt – insbesondere im Automotive-Umfeld.

Dich erwartet ein Umfeld mit hohem fachlichen Anspruch, schneller Lernkurve und individueller Weiterentwicklung. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen zusammen, übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und entwickelst deine fachlichen und methodischen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiter.

Offenheit, Vertrauen und Teamspirit prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit – in einem motivierten Team mit klarer Umsetzungsorientierung.

Außerdem Erwarten Dich


Individuelles Coaching und persönliches Buddy-Programm für deinen Einstieg und deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung
Dienstwagen oder Jobrad bzw. Jobticket – flexibel nach deinen Bedürfnissen
Täglicher Lunch-Zuschuss (6 €)
EGYM Wellpass für Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote
Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte über Corporate Benefits
Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
Obst, Kaffee und Erfrischungsgetränke im Office
Regelmäßige Teamevents zur Stärkung des Teamzusammenhalts
Monatliches Happy Friday Frühstück
100 € Spendenbudget zur freien Verfügung
Sabbatical-Optionen


Über uns

DRIVE Consulting GmbH ist eine Unternehmensberatung mit Hauptsitz in Aachen sowie Standorten in München, Berlin, Peking und Shanghai. Unser Herz schlägt für technische Beratungsprojekte mit Fokus auf die Automobil- und Industriebranche. Zu unseren Kunden zählen sowohl deutsche Premium OEMs als auch junge, aufstrebende Automobilhersteller sowie große und mittelständische Industrieunternehmen.

Unser Name steht für unseren klaren Fokus auf die Mobilitätsbranche und repräsentiert gleichzeitig unseren Spirit – denn wir sind ein Team, in dem jede*r Einzelne DRIVE hat.

Wir stehen unseren Kunden als Wegbereiter ins Unbekannte und als Katalysator für Innovationen zur Seite. Denn wir sind überzeugt, dass man nur mit dem Mut, neue Wege einzuschlagen, einzigartige Erfolgsgeschichten schreiben kann.

Wir schlagen Brücken zwischen kleinen Ideenschmieden und großen Konzernen sowie zwischen Management und Technologieexpert*innen.

Durch den engen und partnerschaftlichen Austausch mit unseren Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte und individuelle Lösungen. Ein entscheidender Erfolgsfaktor ist dabei unser einzigartiges Partnernetzwerk aus Industrie und Forschung. Dank unserer Nähe zu namhaften Universitäten wie der RWTH Aachen verbinden wir Wissenschaft und Praxis.

Begeisterung wird bei uns großgeschrieben und bestimmt unseren Arbeitsalltag – denn sie ist der beste Antrieb.

Title: Analytics Engineer (f/m/d)
Description:
We are Finanzcheck – the online loan comparison platform and the go-to place for consumer loans in Germany. We shape the credit market of tomorrow and in 2022 we were recognized with the Kununu Top Employer Award. Become now part of our success story!

YOUR NEW TEAM

The Data Platform team provides the data infrastructure, advanced modeling frameworks, and analytical services to our entire organization. Our work spans the entire data lifecycle, from building robust pipelines and Data Vault models to delivering clean dbt datasets, creating reports using Tableau and Hex, and partnering with business stakeholders to solve complex analytical problems and help drive key business decisions. You will join a collaborative team of 6 data professionals based in Berlin.

What You Will Be Doing


Build, maintain, and optimize reliable data pipelines and transformation models using dbt and Dagster.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and analysts to understand their data requirements and translate them into actionable data solutions.
Contribute to our centralized reporting models and framework, working with Data Vault principles.
Design and deliver high-quality, intuitive reports and analyses in Tableau or Hex to help drive key business decisions.
Ensure data reliability, performance, and quality across our transformation layers through robust testing and documentation.
Take an active part in team decisions regarding technical best practices, goals, timelines, and our modern stack.



OUR TECH STACK


Platform: AWS (S3, Redshift, Aurora, Glue, DMS, EC2, ECS, Fargate, Lambda, etc.)
Transformation & Orchestration: dbt, Dagster, Python
Data Ingestion & Streaming: SNS, SQS, Segment, Kinesis
DataOps & Infrastructure: Terraform, Docker, Github
Analytics & Visualization: Tableau, Hex



YOUR PROFILE


A solution-driven mindset with strong ownership mentality, a passion for self-learning and continuous improvement
2+ years of experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, BI Developer, or in a similar data role.
Strong SQL skills with the ability to write clean, optimized queries to manipulate and join complex datasets.
Hands-on experience or solid familiarity with dbt, modular modeling, and testing.
Experience working with BI tools, preferably Tableau and Hex.
Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders to translate analytical requirements into technical solutions.
Familiarity with leveraging modern AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot or similar LLMs) to optimize and accelerate your daily coding, debugging, and documentation workflows.



Nice-to-Haves:


Experience or familiarity with cloud data warehouses, preferably Amazon Redshift.
Familiarity with Data Vault architecture or similar data warehousing design methodologies (such as Kimball or Inmon).
Exposure to modern orchestration tools like Dagster or Airflow.
Familiarity with modern data architecture (e.g. data lakes, data lakehouses, data mesh)
Experience working within the FinTech or banking sectors.



Don’t meet every single requirement? We are not simply looking for years of experience – we are looking for the right person and are open to both mid-level and senior profiles. If you are excited about this role and meet the essential criteria but your previous experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

What We Offer


Our team comes from over 50 nations and you can expect an open and dynamic working environment with plenty of room for your further development
We actively work to create a diverse and inclusive work environment by sharing our different skills, ideas and experiences as a team and representing diversity within the company
For your personal development, we offer internal career programs, further training opportunities and language courses (German)
A modern equipped office with roof terrace, lounge and much more
We value our successes and celebrate them through regular events, such as the Company Lunch, the Table Tennis Tournament or our Summer Party
Get your lunch delivered right to the office and save at the same time through the subsidy from smava
Your rest is important to us so we offer 30 days of vacation, parents benefit from 10-child sick days in addition to the statutory entitlement
To support your physical and mental health, we offer collaborations with sports providers and weekly sports activities in our office
We support social projects and subsidize your ticket for public transport so that you can get to your destination in an environmentally conscious way
Enjoy exclusive offers from a large number of brands and secure the best prices when buying through our Corporate Benefits partnership
With smava you are secured in your old age and benefit from a subsidized company pension plan



INTERESTED?

Apply online with just a few click via the application button. Simply upload your CV (preferably as PDF file) and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

All applications are accepted exclusively via the application form.

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst - Paper.io 2
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control, Paper.io2 and Hole.io, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

This position can be full remote within CET time ±3h.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2.

With Paper.io2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.

Role


Autonomously take ownership of the A/B testing cycle on Paper.io 2, validating feature values, refining key parameters, and optimizing monetization to drive core KPIs.
Lead analysis of large, complex datasets to uncover player behaviors and growth opportunities.
Translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations that shape game design and the product roadmap.
Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and developers to embed data-driven decisions throughout the game lifecycle.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that keep the team aligned on critical metrics.


Profile


4+ years in analytical roles within gaming, comfortable working with product teams.
Skilled in SQL and either R or Python; experience with complex, large datasets.
Strong grasp of A/B testing and statistical analysis methods.
Autonomous and pragmatic problem solver with a sharp analytical mind and attention to detail.
Thrives in fast-paced live-ops/product-driven environments with rapid iteration.
Creative thinker who challenges assumptions and sees beyond the obvious.
Player-first mindset with genuine interest in games and player behavior.
Excellent communicator who turns data into compelling, actionable stories.
Collaborative team player who adapts quickly to change and ambiguity.


Benefits


Best-in-class compensation
Other benefits based on your country of residence

Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control, Paper.io2 and Hole.io, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

This position can be full remote within CET time ±3h.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2.

With Paper.io2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.

Role

  • Autonomously take ownership of the A/B testing cycle on Paper.io 2, validating feature values, refining key parameters, and optimizing monetization to drive core KPIs.
  • Lead analysis of large, complex datasets to uncover player behaviors and growth opportunities.
  • Translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations that shape game design and the product roadmap.
  • Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and developers to embed data-driven decisions throughout the game lifecycle.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that keep the team aligned on critical metrics.

Profile

  • 4+ years in analytical roles within gaming, comfortable working with product teams.
  • Skilled in SQL and either R or Python; experience with complex, large datasets.
  • Strong grasp of A/B testing and statistical analysis methods.
  • Autonomous and pragmatic problem solver with a sharp analytical mind and attention to detail.
  • Thrives in fast-paced live-ops/product-driven environments with rapid iteration.
  • Creative thinker who challenges assumptions and sees beyond the obvious.
  • Player-first mindset with genuine interest in games and player behavior.
  • Excellent communicator who turns data into compelling, actionable stories.
  • Collaborative team player who adapts quickly to change and ambiguity.

Benefits

  • Best-in-class compensation
  • Other benefits based on your country of residence

Title: Data Analyst - (Mid or Senior level )(F/M/X)
Description:
About us

At ablefy, we believe passion can turn into a career for anyone. With ablefy.io, we give coaches, consultants, creators, and entrepreneurs everything they need to build and sell digital products online — simply and efficiently. 70,000+ entrepreneurs already trust us to power their business.




Born in 2015, ablefy has grown into a true all-in-one solution — courses, memberships, payments, e-ticketing, and more. We take care of the hard stuff, so our users can focus on what truly matters: growing their business.




Today we're the #1 platform for coaches and creators in the DACH region — and we're not slowing down. That's where you come in.




Our mission; to build software that empowers everyone to start, run and grow a successful digital business - borderless, is supported by our high performance principles that are crucial to our success:

Radical Collaboration
Constructive confrontation
Adaptive execution
Collective ambition
Evolving expertise
Empathetic leadership




About the role

Data is at the core of how we build products at ablefy — not only to guide our own decisions, but also as a value we deliver to our customers. As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping both our internal analytics and the customer-facing data products we bring to market. This includes delivering business-critical insights and reports, working on our AI-powered self-service analytics agent and the intelligence layer that powers agentic, data-driven product recommendations for our customers.




You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to define priorities and deliver end-to-end data projects. You will also stay close to customer needs and feedback to shape impactful data products — ensuring that data and AI-driven insights deliver maximum impact.




Responsibilities

Take responsibility for key analytics initiatives across the business, owning projects end-to-end and ensuring insights are translated into decisions.
Work closely with internal teams to understand business and customer workflows, challenges & goals, and translate these into meaningful analytics solutions.
Design and build customer-facing data products — from embedded dashboards and reports to AI-based self-service analytics tools and our intelligence layer — empowering internal stakeholders and our customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions more efficiently.
Collaborate with senior leadership and stakeholders to define and track KPIs, assess opportunities, and prioritize projects with the largest impact.
Drive experimentation and deep quantitative analysis — from A/B testing to customer behavior deep dives — to support product strategy and feature prioritization.
Contribute to the development of our data warehouse and ensure scalable, consistent metrics across the company.




Qualifications

Strong quantitative background and 3-5 years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst.
Proven experience with product analytics and experimentation.
Exposure to AI-driven analytics products or LLM applications (e.g. self-service analytics agents, chatbots and dashboarding tools). Hands-on experience is a plus, but curiosity and the ability to learn are essential.
Experience with product and business event tracking — including defining business events, understanding product flows, and identifying the signals that drive meaningful analytics.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and an interest in applying them to build and iterate on data pipelines, models, and analytics products more efficiently.
Great knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data warehouse concepts.
Proficiency in Python for analytics and statistics.
Strong communication skills and commercial awareness — able to simplify complex insights, prioritize based on customer and business impact, and manage diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering and Finance.
Experience building or contributing to customer-facing data products is a plus (embedded analytics, data APIs, or AI-based self-service tools).
Experience in fintech domains — such as payments, PSPs and checkout is a plus.
Fluent in English; German is a plus.




Benefits

Paid time off – 30 vacation days.
A competitive salary.
A personal training and development budget of €1,500 per year.
Responsibility and trust from day one.
Individual coaching and further training to support you in your development.
A free BVG ticket.
Employee discounts at numerous companies (e.g. at the gym or in online stores).
Pension program with company match up to 30% of employee contributions.
A culture of equity and inclusion where you are appreciated for the person you are.




Diversity & Inclusion

At ablefy, we embrace our differences, as they are our greatest strength. We recognize that everyone has a unique perspective based on their experiences, identities, and thought processes, and we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. Discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or any other aspect that makes you unique is not tolerated at ablefy. We aim to make growth accessible to everyone!




We know that no candidate checks every single box, and that’s okay! If you’re excited about this role and think you can bring something valuable to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement. We’d love to hear from you!




AI at ablefy

As an AI-first company, we put intelligent technology at the heart of everything we do. AI is part of how we build, learn, and grow together. It helps us work smarter, move faster, and focus on creating real impact. Description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

As a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d), you will be a part of the Commercial Intelligence Team within our Commercial Analytics unit. You will be responsible for strengthening our analytics capabilities and directly impacting the company’s success. In this highly visible role, you will drive the development of analytical products and standards that enable data‑driven pricing, marketing, and revenue decisions across the organization. Working closely with Revenue Management and Commercial Excellence, and Marketing stakeholders, you will translate complex data into actionable insights and scalable, automated solutions that support profitable and sustainable growth.

About The Role


Proven experience building, maintaining, and optimizing reporting solutions in Power BI and Excel
Ability to proactively identify new reporting needs and improve existing analytical processes with business stakeholders
Hands-on, autonomous, and well‑organized working style suited for a highly visible, impact‑driven role
Experience translating business questions into insights and clearly communicating findings to non‑technical audiences
Solid documentation skills to ensure accuracy and transparency of data products and reports
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to support revenue optimization processes, profitability, and sustainable growth
Contribute to advancing the know-how and skill-set within the team through sharing knowledge and best practice


About You


5+ years of professional experience as a Data Analyst or Business Analyst
Strong SQL skills and hands‑on experience working with Snowflake. Python, Power Platform, Jenkins/GitLab, and VS Code experience is considered an advantage
Solid experience in building analytical models and reports using Power BI (connected to Snowflake)
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas and macros. Experience with AI tools will be considered an advantage
Experience working in Agile team environments, ideally alongside other analysts
Proven ability to communicate insights effectively to internal and external non‑technical stakeholders
Fluent English (spoken and written)


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer


Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.

Title: Data Analyst – Fraud & Financial Crime
Description:
Summary

We are seeking an organised and self-motivated Data Analyst to work embedded in our Banking Foundations (Customer Risk Lifecycle) team, to help shape the development of one of the world's leading FinTech products.

About The Opportunity

As a Data Analyst you will enable our product and business segment (CRL - including focus on the AFC Operations function) in the Banking Foundations domain to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams’ initiatives, as well as help drive the strategy of your business segment. You are here to establish a data-mindset and thereby to foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross functional setup, working closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers.

In This Role, You Will


Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities.
Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions.
Evaluate initiatives: Support Product experimentation & testing initiatives; design test plans, obtain cross-functional alignment, execute robust analysis, and deliver actionable insights. Share these learnings through clear documentation and concise and empathic communication.
Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves.
Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs.
Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture.
Be part of our data-community: Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.
Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to):
You support your team in discovery of new product ideas, identifying user friction points and business opportunities.
Evaluate your teams’ continuous releases making sure they are delivering on business goals via experimental or observational methods.
Collaborate with UX researchers to combine qualitative and quantitative research for better product hypotheses.
During product development you make sure all data needed for future evaluation is being captured through set up of tracking events or as part of the backend service.
Drive the quantitative analysis on your segment, being responsible for the insights and business discovery on the team.

Background

What you need to be successful:

3+ years of experience within the Product or Analytics field.

Skills


Strong understanding of statistical methods used in the analysis of experimental and observational data.
Highly experienced with SQL and Python/R for analytics
Experience working with one or more common data visualisation tools (Tableau, Metabase, Looker, Superset, etc)
Good presentation skills and communication skills.
Having experience in high growth startups managing topics like Fraud or AFC would be a plus.
Having experience in quantitative research would be a plus.
Having experience in fintech would be a plus.


What’s In It For You


Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
As an N26 employee, you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account, as well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting-edge technologies—all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.


Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position. Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d)
Description:
Intro

Zur CKM Group gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.

Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service gestalten wir den Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis für Menschen mit chronischen Beschwerden so einfach, niedrigschwellig, erschwinglich und sicher wie möglich, und wollen dabei unterstützen, Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu verbessern: https://greenmedical.health/de/cannabis

Du liebst es, aus Daten Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und möchtest mit deinen Analysen echten Mehrwert schaffen? Dann werde unser  Data Scientist (m/w/d) und unterstütze uns beim Aufbau intelligenter Datenprozesse und datengetriebener Entscheidungen!

Deine Mission bei uns


Datenaufbereitung & Datenmodellierung: Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Datenstrukturen und -flüssen in Zusammenarbeit mit der IT, mit dem Ziel konsistenter und nutzbarer Daten.
Analyse & Visualisierung: Entwicklung von KPIs, Durchführung fundierter Analysen sowie Übersetzung von Daten in klare, entscheidungsrelevante Visualisierungen (z. B. inGrafanaoder Power BI).
Strukturierung von Fragestellungen: Eigenständige Zerlegung komplexer, offener Anforderungen in konkrete Analysen, Datenmodelle und umsetzbare Schritte.
End-to-End Umsetzung: Verantwortung für die Umsetzung von Use Cases,von der initialen Fragestellung über Datenaufbereitung bis hin zu Dashboard und Interpretation.
Schnittstelle zu Fachbereichen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Bereichen wie Marketing undOperationszur Klärung, Priorisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Anforderungen.
Monitoring & Reporting: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards und Reports zur Überwachung von Datenqualität, Systemzuständen und operativen KPIs.
Datenlogik & Modelle: Entwicklung, Anwendung und Validierung von Berechnungslogiken und Modellen (z. B. Performanceanalysen, Forecasts).
