Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Location: We are flexible! Come and join us either in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona.

Freenow empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Product Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our product squads, using data to build a flawless product experience. You will join the Product Data Team and work closely with PMs, designers, UX researchers, developers, and other data functions to discover new product opportunities, validate hypotheses, and launch valuable features to our users.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Providing expertise and collaborating with stakeholders to generate new product feature ideas and improvements, and also estimating the potential impact of planned projects.
Continuously engaging with the product squads to gain an understanding of the problems that need to be solved, gathering requirements, and defining the best deliverables to match the business needs.
Having full ownership of your analysis, from ideation to communication of results and making recommendations to all levels of the company including senior management and prioritization committees.
Developing and evaluating A/B test experiments or other analyses to measure and report the performance of released features, ensuring that we are launching the correct changes and features in our apps.
Working closely with our developers and data engineers to create and capture data that is aligned with the business logic and allows modeling and analysis.
Being involved throughout the complete product lifecycle in order to guarantee a data-driven process.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
You will have the opportunity to steer our products, which kind of features should be developed, and which changes should be made to solve hundreds of thousands of users' daily needs.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other fields with a strong mathematical-statistical background
3+ years experience in working as a Data Analyst in a data-driven analytics environment, preferably within tech product organizations, having direct contact with stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical skills, lateral thinking, and proven experience in solving highly challenging problems.
Very good knowledge of SQL, databases, and statistical programming tools (e.g. Python, R) so that exploratory analyses can be performed, reports created and ETLs maintained
Good understanding and hands-on experience in analyzing and interpreting A/B test results, backed by statistical knowledge.
Experience in working with data visualisation tools (e.g.Tableau, Qlikview) and event tracking (e.g. Mixpanel, GA, Firebase)
You are able to communicate findings in a concise and clear manner to a wide variety of stakeholders to support data-driven decision making by using data visualisation and storytelling and have excellent English communication skills.


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


Plus more local benefits depending on your work location!

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

ABOUT US:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app.

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

Title: Pricing Analyst, Product Operations (Global Pricing)
Description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Pricing Analyst, Product Operations (Global Pricing) to join the Pricing Team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

As a Pricing Analyst, Product Operationswithin the Global Pricing Team, you will sit at the intersection of Product & Business. You will be responsible for analyzing and optimizing how we charge for our services—balancing customer affordability with sustainable unit economics. Your mission is to support the specification, testing, rollout & ongoing operation of pricing features (like Small Order Fees, Service Fees, and Delivery Fee ladders) and provide the insights needed to scale these globally.


Feature Impact Modeling & Forecasting: Based on your conversations with the different pricing teams in Delivery Hero, you will own the "Business Case" for new pricing product requirements. You will build predictive models to estimate the impact of proposed features (e.g., MOV adjustments, service fees) on key metrics like GPO, Conversion Rate, and Order Frequency before they hit the roadmap.
Accountability & Performance Tracking: Lead the testing efforts & rollout analysis for all new pricing features. You will hold stakeholders accountable to adopt new features and compare actual performance against the initial impact estimations, identifying "value leakage" and recommending data-backed pivots.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: Partner with Global Marketing and Regional Ops leads to translate business visions into actionable product requirements. You will refine and challenge stakeholder requests to ensure we are prioritizing high-impact initiatives which benefit the whole organisation.
Pricing Product Operations: Support the day-to-day "Product Ops" side of pricing by monitoring the health of fee structures globally, for example identifying an opportunity to change the distance-based fee increases. This also includes answering questions of the end-users of our product on a daily basis regarding best practices and how to set up a specific pricing strategy within the product.
Advanced Visualization & Tooling: Build accessible, creative, and engaging data visualizations in Tableau/BigQuery to facilitate access to insights. You will own the "Value Tracker" that aggregates incremental revenue generated by pricing features across all regions.
Data Stewardship & Governance: Own the data catalog for all Pricing dimensions, metrics, and KPIs. Collaborate with Data Engineering and Product to ensure that experiment data, fee points, and subsidies are correctly logged and scalable.


Qualifications


3+ years experience as a Product or Pricing Analyst within a fast-paced marketplace or e-commerce environment.
Mastery of BigQuery and SQL is essential with the ability to build Python-based modeling pipelines and experience with GitHub.
Strong grasp of applied statistics, specifically for A/B testing and price elasticity modeling.
Deep understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, GPO, and Contribution Margin). You can explain why a $200 increase in a fee matters to the bottom line.
Fluent in English with the ability to translate complex data into a narrative for non-technical stakeholders in Marketing and Product.
Experience with Airflow for data pipeline management and familiarity with Google Analytics/Amplitude to track the customer checkout funnel.


Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.


Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week

Title: Marketing Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Your role

We are looking for a curious and insightful Marketing Data Analyst (all genders) to join our expanding Commercial Data Science team. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how we understand our customers and optimize our marketing efforts across marketing channels and countries.

In this role, you won’t just report numbers, you will be a strategic partner. You will connect the dots between acquisition and retention, using data to uncover narratives that drive efficiency and growth. If you are passionate about the intersection of data, marketing, and business impact, we would love to meet you.


Collaborate closely with Performance Marketing, CRM, and Influencer teams to align data insights with our acquisition and retention goals
Analyze complex datasets from ad platforms, such as Google, Meta, TikTok, web analytics (GA4), and internal order systems to refine targeting and budget allocation across channels and countries
Leverage dbt and BigQuery to ensure our marketing data models are robust, reliable, and ready for decision-making
Build intuitive dashboards with Tableau that provide stakeholders with clear and actionable insights
Design and analyze A/B tests and geo-lift studies and focus relentlessly on incremental lift, helping stakeholders understand what revenue we wouldn't have generated without a specific marketing touchpoint
Utilize, co-develop and validate our in-house Media Mix Models (MMM) to assess the holistic impact of our marketing spend and implement advanced analytical methods to optimize our marketing


Your profile


3-5 years in data analytics with a focus on commercial or marketing topics
Strong SQL skills are essential - you are self-sufficient in querying and manipulating large datasets within cloud environments like BigQuery to answer complex business questions
You design intuitive dashboards and reports that guide the user and present data in a way that allows stakeholders to effortlessly draw the right conclusions and make informed decisions
You have a solid understanding of the D2C marketing mix, incl. Performance, CRM, and Influencer and the KPIs that drive them, such as CAC, CLV, MER, retention rates
You are proactive, thrive in fast-paced environments and are able to navigate shifting priorities and manage multiple projects with a solution-oriented mindset
You excel at translating complex data into clear business insights and feel comfortable engaging with stakeholders to refine ideas and strategies


What We Offer


An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients
We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year
The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket
We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad
Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia
You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas
Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world
We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day


Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

Title: Data & Platform Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
NeXtWind betreibt und entwickelt Windenergieanlagen in Deutschland mit dem Ziel, bis 2028 auf 3 GW zu wachsen. Unser Data & IT-Team baut die interne Dateninfrastruktur als Produkt: Airtable als operativer Kern, automatisierte Prozesse und AI-Use-Cases in der Pipeline. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unsere Datenplattform — von der Architektur bis zur Adoption.




Deine Aufgaben




Datenplattform

Airtable-Architektur weiterentwickeln, pflegen und dokumentieren (Bases, Interfaces, Automations, Skripte)
Datenmodelle designen: Feldstandards, Naming Conventions, Tabellenbeziehungen — konsistent und zukunftsfähig
Schnittstellenmanagement ausbauen: Interfaces für Fachabteilungen bauen und iterieren
Automatisierte Reports aufsetzen und betreiben
Datenqualitätsprozesse definieren und gemeinsam mit den Teams einführen
AI- und Automatisierungs-Use-Cases identifizieren und mitumsetzen
Self-Service-Zugang für Fachabteilungen ausbauen




Dein Profil




Muss

Airtable: tiefes Verständnis von Bases, Interfaces, Automations und Scripting
Datenarchitektur: strukturiertes Denken in Datenmodellen, Abhängigkeiten und Standards
Sehr gutes Deutsch (Unternehmenssprache, schriftlich und mündlich)
Gutes Englisch (Teamkommunikation, externe Partner)
Eigenverantwortung: du bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne Micromanagement
Kommunikationsstärke: du kannst technische Konzepte für Nicht-Techniker verständlich machen

Von Vorteil

Erfahrung mit weiteren No-Code/Low-Code-Tools (z.B. Claude, n8n, Power Automate) und API-Verwendung
Python oder andere Scripting-Kenntnisse
Erfahrung in der Energie- oder Infrastrukturbranche




Warum wir?




NeXtWind ist angetrieben und beseelt von der Nutzung innovativer Technologien und Ansätze zur Schaffung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft. Unser Engagement für saubere Energielösungen macht uns zu starken Herausforderern im deutschen Energiesektor. Darüber hinaus ist unser Unternehmen auf einem Fundament stabiler Kernwerte gebaut, die unsere Kultur definieren und prägen.




Transparenz und Eigeninitiative stehen bei uns hoch im Kurs. Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander - intern wie extern - ist die unverzichtbare Grundlage unseres Handelns. In unserer Zusammenarbeit sind wir schnell und offen für unvermeidbare Fehler auf dem Weg zur Verbesserung. Kollegialität und gegenseitige Unterstützung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.




Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden jederzeit Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und zum Wachstum, basierend auf ihren individuellen Fähigkeiten und Neigungen. Flexibilität, so zu arbeiten, wie es optimale Produktivität und Effizienz ermöglicht, ist für uns selbstverständlich.




Wir bieten dir:

Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket
Abschluss einer provisionsfreien Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV)
Kostenlose Coaching-Sitzungen für deine Mentale Gesundheit mit unserem Partner nilo (Meditationen, Schreibübungen & weitere mentale Gesundheitsangebote)
Alle 2 Wochen laden wir dich zum Team-Mittagessen mit Catering ein
Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Energiewende mitzuwirken und einen positiven Einfluss auf die Umwelt zu nehmen




Bringe frischen Wind in Deine Karriere.




Wenn Du Leidenschaft für erneuerbare Energien hast und die nötigen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen mitbringst, um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Description:
kfzteile24 is Germany’s leading digital company for car parts and automotive accessories. Based in Berlin, we operate as a multichannel business comprising the successful online shops kfzteile24.de, autoteile24.de, carpardoo.fr, carpardoo.nl, and carpardoo.dk, alongside physical branches and workshops. We are Germany’s best-known brand in the online automotive aftermarket. Through expert advice, an extensive product range, and fast, reliable parts delivery, we help maintain individual mobility. Our goal now is to transform an already highly successful company into an innovative top player in one of the most exciting sectors of the German economy.

This is not a reporting role. You'll own hypotheses, challenge assumptions, and push back on gut-feel decisions with data. You'll work close to the business, close to the numbers, and close to decisions that have real commercial impact. If that sounds natural to you, read on.

What We Offer


Permanent employment contract and 30 days vacation
Possibility of home office 3 days a week
Internal and external training opportunities
Up to 50% employee discount in our branches and workshops
Various health and sport offers (e.g. Bike-Leasing, screen glasses / monitor glasses (VDU))
Additional benefits such as language courses via Babbel, company pension plan, corporate benefits


Your Responsibilities


Price Analysis & Market Intelligence You analyze price elasticities, track competitor movements, and identify demand trends. You don't just surface findings; you translate them into concrete pricing recommendations.
Performance Monitoring You measure the impact of pricing decisions in your area and actively steer based on what the data tells you. You know when a metric is moving for the right reason — and when it isn't.
Project Ownership You take smaller pricing initiatives from hypothesis to implementation independently. In larger projects, you're an active contributor.
Decision Papers You turn complex data into clear recommendations and communicate them at the right level of detail — for stakeholders who don't speak pricing, and for leadership who need to act fast.
Stakeholder Interfaces You coordinate pricing topics across Sales, Marketing, Procurement, and IT. You make pricing legible to people outside the discipline.


Your Skills


3–5 years of professional experience in an analytical pricing, revenue, or data role — ideally in e-commerce or retail
SQL is a prerequisite: You write your own queries, work with large datasets, and know what you're looking for before you start.
Tableau or Power BI: You visualize insights in a way that drives decisions
Google Sheets or Excel: You know when a pivot is enough — and when it isn't
AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT): You use them to accelerate your own analytical workflow — not as a substitute for thinking. You evaluate outputs critically, and know where AI breaks down
Critical thinking: You recognize when a number is right — and when it's lying. Especially when the data is incomplete
Languages: You communicate fluently in both German and English (minimum C1)


Nice to Have

These aren't required, but relevant experience that helps from day one:


Python or R - queries, large dataset analysis, automation
Experience with automated pricing systems or repricing tools
Background in the automotive aftermarket or spare parts industry


Apply now!

If you would like to be part of our motivated Pricing team, apply now for the position with us as Pricing Analyst - Dynamic Pricing (m/f/d) , stating your salary expectations and your earliest starting date. If you have any questions, please contact Irina Ring at +49 1520 315 4804.

Please note that we only consider applications via our online portal. Applications by post or e-mail will not be considered and deleted.

For more information on data processing, see our data protection declaration.

Title: Data & Platform Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Willkommen.

NeXtWind betreibt und entwickelt Windenergieanlagen in Deutschland mit dem Ziel, bis 2028 auf 3 GW zu wachsen. Unser Data & IT-Team baut die interne Dateninfrastruktur als Produkt: Airtable als operativer Kern, automatisierte Prozesse und AI-Use-Cases in der Pipeline. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unsere Datenplattform — von der Architektur bis zur Adoption.

Deine Aufgaben

Datenplattform


Airtable-Architektur weiterentwickeln, pflegen und dokumentieren (Bases, Interfaces, Automations, Skripte)
Datenmodelle designen: Feldstandards, Naming Conventions, Tabellenbeziehungen — konsistent und zukunftsfähig
Schnittstellenmanagement ausbauen: Interfaces für Fachabteilungen bauen und iterieren
Automatisierte Reports aufsetzen und betreiben
Datenqualitätsprozesse definieren und gemeinsam mit den Teams einführen
AI- und Automatisierungs-Use-Cases identifizieren und mitumsetzen
Self-Service-Zugang für Fachabteilungen ausbauen


Dein Profil

Muss


Airtable: tiefes Verständnis von Bases, Interfaces, Automations und Scripting
Datenarchitektur: strukturiertes Denken in Datenmodellen, Abhängigkeiten und Standards
Sehr gutes Deutsch (Unternehmenssprache, schriftlich und mündlich)
Gutes Englisch (Teamkommunikation, externe Partner)
Eigenverantwortung: du bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne Micromanagement
Kommunikationsstärke: du kannst technische Konzepte für Nicht-Techniker verständlich machen


Von Vorteil


Erfahrung mit weiteren No-Code/Low-Code-Tools (z.B. Claude, n8n, Power Automate) und API-Verwendung
Python oder andere Scripting-Kenntnisse
Erfahrung in der Energie- oder Infrastrukturbranche


Warum wir?

Was dich erwartet


Kleines Team mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung
Hohe Eigenverantwortung von Tag eins
Aufbauarbeit: du gestaltest die Datenstrategie bei NeXtWind maßgeblich mit


Bringe frischen Wind in Deine Karriere.

Wenn Du Leidenschaft für erneuerbare Energien hast und die nötigen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen mitbringst, um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Über uns

NeXtWind ist ein innovatives Unternehmen für erneuerbare Energien, das sich der Nutzung der Windkraft zur Schaffung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft widmet. Unser Engagement für saubere Energielösungen positioniert uns als starke Herausforderer im deutschen Windenergiesektor.

Title: Web Analyst (m/f/d) - Marketing & Data
Description:
We are home24, one of the leading home & living e-commerce platforms in continental Europe. We utilize data to provide personalized recommendations, tips, and inspiration for every home. We are looking for a Web Analyst (m/f/d) to join our team. In this role, you will support our marketing teams by ensuring data quality, maintaining our tracking setup, and delivering actionable insights through data visualization.

Your Responsibilities


You drive the implementation and maintenance of tracking concepts in GA4 and sGTM, refining event structures and debugging discrepancies to ensure delivery of high-quality data e.g. for attribution modeling and the design and evaluation of A/B tests
You evaluate the performance of marketing campaigns across various channels
You don't just deliver numbers, but interpret data to help the team understand trends and optimize ROI
You build and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., in Tableau or Looker) to monitor key marketing metrics, translating business requirements into clear visualizations
You look beyond standard KPIs to investigate the "why" behind the data, conducting ad-hoc deep dives to uncover the root causes of performance shifts and user behavior
You act as a contact person for analytical questions regarding GA4, helping stakeholders understand their data usage needs
You monitor the data flow to ensure accuracy and support the team in identifying and fixing bugs in the tracking landscape


Your Profile


You have professional experience in web analytics, data analysis, or a related field, ideally within an e-commerce environment
You have hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and (server-side) Google Tag Manager (sGTM)
You are proficient in SQL, capable of merging and transforming large-scale datasets from diverse sources. Proficiency in Python is a strong plus for building scalable data solutions
You have a basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to comprehend how tracking is implemented
Your mindset combines natural curiosity for new trends with a sharp eye for detail, ensuring your end-to-end thinking always aligns with the bigger picture
You have excellent English skills and can communicate your findings in a clear, structured way
You thrive in cross-functional collaboration, acting as a bridge between marketing, data, and tech teams


What We Offer You

Your impact


The chance to make an impact in a highly motivated team of professionals
An open-minded culture ready to incorporate new and creative ideas


Your growth


Extensive learning opportunities from our home24 academy and external partners
Room for growth and development within your role through regular feedback rounds


Your path


Hybrid working model: you have the flexibility to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays in our standard working mode. We are in the office together Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays
The possibility to work up to two months per year within Germany or from an EU country
Up to 30 days paid vacation each year to unwind and recharge
City mobility with a subsidized public transportation ticket and our eco-friendly bike leasing program #ridinghome


Your second home


International campus in the heart of Berlin featuring drive-in bicycle garage, outdoor space and lounge areas, fitness facilities, parent and multi-faith rooms close to the Berlin S-Bahn train station Landsberger Allee
Company benefits including a pension scheme, 30 % off the home24 assortment, and employee discounts at partner organizations
You want to learn more about our home24 company culture and what it is like to be a homie? Follow @teamhome24 on Instagram


If you want to become part of a thrilling success story – we are looking forward to your application. Please send us your application together with your salary expectations and the earliest possible starting date via our career site.

Your home is surely filled with furniture of varying materials and styles. The same is true for home24 as an employer. We celebrate the diversity of the people who work with us. Be who you are and feel welcome to #makeyourselfathome24

You can find all job offers on our career site !

We are home24, the leading home & living e-commerce platform in continental Europe. We are currently active in seven countries. Over 1,000 Homies work together towards a common goal: to create happy homes for everyone and every budget.

How can we reach this goal? With an assortment of over 250,000 pieces of furniture and accessories from more than 1,000 suppliers, we offer the perfect addition to any living space combined with the comfort of being able to shop from anywhere.

What makes us proud to be Homies? We are pioneers in our market who seamlessly combine technology and creativity. We utilize data to provide personalized recommendations, tips and inspiration for every home.

At home24, we strive to deliver a superior assortment of products and the best service. To do this, we need fresh ideas, 100% motivation, and dedication to our company mission. Title: Datenanalyst / Data Engineer (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir sind Bertrandt.

Ein eigenständiger und internationaler Engineering Dienstleister mit langjähriger Expertise. Mit branchenübergreifendem Know-how und einem ganzheitlichen System- und Produktverständnis schaffen wir technologische Lösungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Wir beschäftigen uns mit den Trendthemen Digitalisierung, E-Mobilität und Autonome Systeme hauptsächlich für die Branchen Automotive, Luftfahrt, Defence und Maschinenbau und ermöglichen hier konsequent die Entstehung passgenauer Lösungen. Unser Ziel: den technologischen Fortschritt beschleunigen und einen relevanten Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Zukunft leisten. Daran arbeiten wir jeden Tag – mit rund 12.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an über 50 Standorten weltweit.

Was Sie Erwartet


Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung von Softwaretools zur Erfassung von Daten verschiedener Datenlieferanten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen, darunter Datenbanken, Tabellenkalkulationen und Unternehmenssysteme
Bereinigung, Validierung, Kontrolle und Organisation von Datensätzen für Berichts- und Analysezwecke
Pflege von Datensätzen und Unterstützung von Data-Governance-Maßnahmen
Analyse großer Datensätze zur Identifizierung von Trends, Mustern und Anomalien
Durchführung von Analysen zur Bewertung der Qualität der Datenlieferanten vor der Freigabe an den Kunden
Unterstützung bei Ad-hoc-Anfragen verschiedener Abteilungen zur Datenanalyse
Entwicklung und Pflege regelmäßiger Berichte, Dashboards und Leistungs-Scorecards
Präsentation von Daten auf klare und visuell ansprechende Weise mithilfe von Diagrammen, Tabellen und Dashboards
Verfolgung von Leistungskennzahlen (KPIs)
Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Berichtsprozessen, Datenqualität und Analysemethoden
Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung von Datenstandards, Vorlagen und Best Practices


Was Sie Mitbringen


Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Datenanalyse, Statistik, Informatik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung
Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Analyse und Aufbereitung von Daten
Grundverständnis im Bereich Informationssysteme von Vorteil
Sicherer Umgang mit Excel bzw. Google Sheets
Gute Kenntnisse in SQL zur Datenabfrage und -verarbeitung
Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Tableau
Programmierkenntnisse in Python oder R zur Datenanalyse und Automatisierung
Sehr gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil
Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft für gelegentliche kurzfristige Dienstreisen


Bertrandt legt großen Wert auf Gleichbehandlung und Chancengleichheit. Unsere Recruiting-Entscheidungen basieren auf den Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten der Bewerber*innen. Schwerbehinderte Menschen bzw. gleichgestellte Menschen im Sinne des SGB IX sind herzlich willkommen und werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.

Title: Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Data Analyst - Join Our Innovative Team at think-cell Software




Our Story

At think-cell, we create powerful software solutions that help professionals be more efficient and productive. Founded in 2002 and based in Berlin, our tools integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Office to help users create presentations, charts, and diagrams with ease. Our dynamic, international team values creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence.




What You Will Do

We're a Data Team that operates like a scaleup within an established company: real ownership, short decision paths, and room to shape things. No corporate bureaucracy – but the resources of a mature business. Our team is made up of experienced senior individual contributors who work independently, challenge each other constructively, and collaborate closely on solving complex problems. It is an environment with a high level of trust, autonomy, and strong opportunities to learn from experienced peers across both technical and business topics.

You don't just analyze – you drive. You proactively identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, build the foundations to answer questions, and make sure stakeholders don't just receive dashboards, but know what to do with them.




Key Responsibilities:

Building and maintaining scalable data models and pipelines
Translating business questions into structured analytical approaches and communicating them in whatever format stakeholders actually need
Collaborating with teams across the company to improve data quality, transparency and accessibility
Contributing to the development of our data culture, standards, and ways of working




You will be great for this position if you have

3+ years of experience in Analytics, BI, or a similar role
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt
Experience with PowerBI
You guide stakeholders – not just serve them, both communication and domain wise
A proactive and ownership-driven mindset
Interest in improving processes and increasing efficiency, including through ML/LLM-based approaches




Our Values

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Location: We are flexible! Come and join us either in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona.

Freenow empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Product Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our product squads, using data to build a flawless product experience. You will join the Product Data Team and work closely with PMs, designers, UX researchers, developers, and other data functions to discover new product opportunities, validate hypotheses, and launch valuable features to our users.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Providing expertise and collaborating with stakeholders to generate new product feature ideas and improvements, and also estimating the potential impact of planned projects.
Continuously engaging with the product squads to gain an understanding of the problems that need to be solved, gathering requirements, and defining the best deliverables to match the business needs.
Having full ownership of your analysis, from ideation to communication of results and making recommendations to all levels of the company including senior management and prioritization committees.
Developing and evaluating A/B test experiments or other analyses to measure and report the performance of released features, ensuring that we are launching the correct changes and features in our apps.
Working closely with our developers and data engineers to create and capture data that is aligned with the business logic and allows modeling and analysis.
Being involved throughout the complete product lifecycle in order to guarantee a data-driven process.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
You will have the opportunity to steer our products, which kind of features should be developed, and which changes should be made to solve hundreds of thousands of users' daily needs.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other fields with a strong mathematical-statistical background
3+ years experience in working as a Data Analyst in a data-driven analytics environment, preferably within tech product organizations, having direct contact with stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical skills, lateral thinking, and proven experience in solving highly challenging problems.
Very good knowledge of SQL, databases, and statistical programming tools (e.g. Python, R) so that exploratory analyses can be performed, reports created and ETLs maintained
Good understanding and hands-on experience in analyzing and interpreting A/B test results, backed by statistical knowledge.
Experience in working with data visualisation tools (e.g.Tableau, Qlikview) and event tracking (e.g. Mixpanel, GA, Firebase)
You are able to communicate findings in a concise and clear manner to a wide variety of stakeholders to support data-driven decision making by using data visualisation and storytelling and have excellent English communication skills.


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


Plus more local benefits depending on your work location!

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

ABOUT US:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app.

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

Title: Pricing Analyst, Product Operations (Global Pricing)
Description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Pricing Analyst, Product Operations (Global Pricing) to join the Pricing Team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

As a Pricing Analyst, Product Operationswithin the Global Pricing Team, you will sit at the intersection of Product & Business. You will be responsible for analyzing and optimizing how we charge for our services—balancing customer affordability with sustainable unit economics. Your mission is to support the specification, testing, rollout & ongoing operation of pricing features (like Small Order Fees, Service Fees, and Delivery Fee ladders) and provide the insights needed to scale these globally.


Feature Impact Modeling & Forecasting: Based on your conversations with the different pricing teams in Delivery Hero, you will own the "Business Case" for new pricing product requirements. You will build predictive models to estimate the impact of proposed features (e.g., MOV adjustments, service fees) on key metrics like GPO, Conversion Rate, and Order Frequency before they hit the roadmap.
Accountability & Performance Tracking: Lead the testing efforts & rollout analysis for all new pricing features. You will hold stakeholders accountable to adopt new features and compare actual performance against the initial impact estimations, identifying "value leakage" and recommending data-backed pivots.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: Partner with Global Marketing and Regional Ops leads to translate business visions into actionable product requirements. You will refine and challenge stakeholder requests to ensure we are prioritizing high-impact initiatives which benefit the whole organisation.
Pricing Product Operations: Support the day-to-day "Product Ops" side of pricing by monitoring the health of fee structures globally, for example identifying an opportunity to change the distance-based fee increases. This also includes answering questions of the end-users of our product on a daily basis regarding best practices and how to set up a specific pricing strategy within the product.
Advanced Visualization & Tooling: Build accessible, creative, and engaging data visualizations in Tableau/BigQuery to facilitate access to insights. You will own the "Value Tracker" that aggregates incremental revenue generated by pricing features across all regions.
Data Stewardship & Governance: Own the data catalog for all Pricing dimensions, metrics, and KPIs. Collaborate with Data Engineering and Product to ensure that experiment data, fee points, and subsidies are correctly logged and scalable.


Qualifications


3+ years experience as a Product or Pricing Analyst within a fast-paced marketplace or e-commerce environment.
Mastery of BigQuery and SQL is essential with the ability to build Python-based modeling pipelines and experience with GitHub.
Strong grasp of applied statistics, specifically for A/B testing and price elasticity modeling.
Deep understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, GPO, and Contribution Margin). You can explain why a $200 increase in a fee matters to the bottom line.
Fluent in English with the ability to translate complex data into a narrative for non-technical stakeholders in Marketing and Product.
Experience with Airflow for data pipeline management and familiarity with Google Analytics/Amplitude to track the customer checkout funnel.


Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.


Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.

Title: Marketing Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Your role

We are looking for a curious and insightful Marketing Data Analyst (all genders) to join our expanding Commercial Data Science team. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how we understand our customers and optimize our marketing efforts across marketing channels and countries.

In this role, you won’t just report numbers, you will be a strategic partner. You will connect the dots between acquisition and retention, using data to uncover narratives that drive efficiency and growth. If you are passionate about the intersection of data, marketing, and business impact, we would love to meet you.


Collaborate closely with Performance Marketing, CRM, and Influencer teams to align data insights with our acquisition and retention goals
Analyze complex datasets from ad platforms, such as Google, Meta, TikTok, web analytics (GA4), and internal order systems to refine targeting and budget allocation across channels and countries
Leverage dbt and BigQuery to ensure our marketing data models are robust, reliable, and ready for decision-making
Build intuitive dashboards with Tableau that provide stakeholders with clear and actionable insights
Design and analyze A/B tests and geo-lift studies and focus relentlessly on incremental lift, helping stakeholders understand what revenue we wouldn't have generated without a specific marketing touchpoint
Utilize, co-develop and validate our in-house Media Mix Models (MMM) to assess the holistic impact of our marketing spend and implement advanced analytical methods to optimize our marketing


Your profile


3-5 years in data analytics with a focus on commercial or marketing topics
Strong SQL skills are essential - you are self-sufficient in querying and manipulating large datasets within cloud environments like BigQuery to answer complex business questions
You design intuitive dashboards and reports that guide the user and present data in a way that allows stakeholders to effortlessly draw the right conclusions and make informed decisions
You have a solid understanding of the D2C marketing mix, incl. Performance, CRM, and Influencer and the KPIs that drive them, such as CAC, CLV, MER, retention rates
You are proactive, thrive in fast-paced environments and are able to navigate shifting priorities and manage multiple projects with a solution-oriented mindset
You excel at translating complex data into clear business insights and feel comfortable engaging with stakeholders to refine ideas and strategies


What We Offer


An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients
We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year
The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket
We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

Title: Data & Platform Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
NeXtWind betreibt und entwickelt Windenergieanlagen in Deutschland mit dem Ziel, bis 2028 auf 3 GW zu wachsen. Unser Data & IT-Team baut die interne Dateninfrastruktur als Produkt: Airtable als operativer Kern, automatisierte Prozesse und AI-Use-Cases in der Pipeline. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unsere Datenplattform — von der Architektur bis zur Adoption.




Deine Aufgaben




Datenplattform

Airtable-Architektur weiterentwickeln, pflegen und dokumentieren (Bases, Interfaces, Automations, Skripte)
Datenmodelle designen: Feldstandards, Naming Conventions, Tabellenbeziehungen — konsistent und zukunftsfähig
Schnittstellenmanagement ausbauen: Interfaces für Fachabteilungen bauen und iterieren
Automatisierte Reports aufsetzen und betreiben
Datenqualitätsprozesse definieren und gemeinsam mit den Teams einführen
AI- und Automatisierungs-Use-Cases identifizieren und mitumsetzen
Self-Service-Zugang für Fachabteilungen ausbauen




Dein Profil




Muss

Airtable: tiefes Verständnis von Bases, Interfaces, Automations und Scripting
Datenarchitektur: strukturiertes Denken in Datenmodellen, Abhängigkeiten und Standards
Sehr gutes Deutsch (Unternehmenssprache, schriftlich und mündlich)
Gutes Englisch (Teamkommunikation, externe Partner)
Eigenverantwortung: du bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne Micromanagement
Kommunikationsstärke: du kannst technische Konzepte für Nicht-Techniker verständlich machen

Von Vorteil

Erfahrung mit weiteren No-Code/Low-Code-Tools (z.B. Claude, n8n, Power Automate) und API-Verwendung
Python oder andere Scripting-Kenntnisse
Erfahrung in der Energie- oder Infrastrukturbranche




Warum wir?




NeXtWind ist angetrieben und beseelt von der Nutzung innovativer Technologien und Ansätze zur Schaffung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft. Unser Engagement für saubere Energielösungen macht uns zu starken Herausforderern im deutschen Energiesektor. Darüber hinaus ist unser Unternehmen auf einem Fundament stabiler Kernwerte gebaut, die unsere Kultur definieren und prägen.




Transparenz und Eigeninitiative stehen bei uns hoch im Kurs. Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander - intern wie extern - ist die unverzichtbare Grundlage unseres Handelns. In unserer Zusammenarbeit sind wir schnell und offen für unvermeidbare Fehler auf dem Weg zur Verbesserung. Kollegialität und gegenseitige Unterstützung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.




Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden jederzeit Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und zum Wachstum, basierend auf ihren individuellen Fähigkeiten und Neigungen. Flexibilität, so zu arbeiten, wie es optimale Produktivität und Effizienz ermöglicht, ist für uns selbstverständlich.




Wir bieten dir:

Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket
Abschluss einer provisionsfreien Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV)
Kostenlose Coaching-Sitzungen für deine Mentale Gesundheit mit unserem Partner nilo (Meditationen, Schreibübungen & weitere mentale Gesundheitsangebote)
Alle 2 Wochen laden wir dich zum Team-Mittagessen mit Catering ein
Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Energiewende mitzuwirken und einen positiven Einfluss auf die Umwelt zu nehmen




Bringe frischen Wind in Deine Karriere.




Wenn Du Leidenschaft für erneuerbare Energien hast und die nötigen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen mitbringst, um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Description:
Data Analyst




Industry: Designer toys and collectible pieces

Location: London, Canary Wharf

Job type: Full time Permanent




About POP MART




POP MART (09992.HK) is a leading global company in the trend culture and entertainment industry. Centered around IP, POP MART has built a comprehensive platform for creative incubation and IP operation, empowering global creators while delivering exciting products, services and immersive entertainment experiences to consumers.




POP MART identifies and nurtures emerging artists and designers worldwide, creating popular character IPs through a well-established development and operation system. Our portfolio includes iconic characters such as MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, DIMOO, THE MONSTERS and Hirono. POP MART operates over 500 physical stores and more than 2,300 Robo Shops across more than thirty countries and regions, and through multiple cross border e commerce platforms reaches audiences in over ninety countries and regions, bringing joy to young consumers around the world.




POP MART has developed a comprehensive IP commercialisation ecosystem that spans multiple industries, deepening emotional bonds between fans and IPs while exploring broader opportunities for value creation. Our ventures include the world’s first immersive intellectual property themed park in the art toy industry, the expansion of its IPs into global markets through licensing and co-branding with leading global brands, and the curation of art toy expos and intellectual property themed exhibitions internationally. In Europe, POP MART has built a strong presence in key markets including the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands and Spain, and is expanding into new high potential markets. Our expansion brings POP MART closer to European fans and offers new ways for them to connect with our IPs and stories.




For more information, please visit www.popmart.com and our LinkedIn Career page.




What to Expect




POP MART is a fast-paced company with a young and multicultural team where you can expect to:




Contribute to a fast-growing European business that combines retail, art, and creative storytelling
Work with passionate teams across different countries, all connected by a shared love for designer toys and unique customer experiences
Grow your skills through hands-on projects, collaborative learning, and opportunities to explore new ideas




Benefits




POP MART offers our employees:




Monthly appreciation gifts featuring our latest POP MART designs
A structured bonus scheme linked to both company and individual performance
25 days of annual leave, in addition to bank holidays
4x life insurance, together with group medical and travel insurance
A confidential Employee Assistance Programme, alongside access to a discount platform for selected online retailers
Training and development programmes, together with regular team events that encourage learning, collaboration, and celebration




The Role and Candidate




We are looking for a data driven and detail oriented professional to support business performance monitoring and analysis across POP MART’s European business.

This role focuses on operational reporting, performance tracking, and business insight generation across key revenue channels, including physical stores, vending machines, and online business. You will support the business by monitoring core operational indicators, identifying trends and issues through data, and helping teams better understand performance through clear, accurate, and practical analysis.

You will also work closely with teams including Finance, Retail Operations, Marketing, Merchandising, and Business Development to support regular reporting, operational reviews, and day to day data requests. In parallel, the role will contribute to improving reporting consistency, data quality, and the practical use of data in business operations.

This position would suit someone with solid analytical capability, structured thinking, and a hands on approach, who is comfortable working with detailed data while supporting wider business needs in a fast paced environment.




Responsibilities




Daily Operation Monitoring and Performance Review




Establish daily, weekly and monthly monitoring for core operational indicators, including revenue, gross profit, expense ratio, payment collection, labour efficiency and store efficiency, across all revenue channels such as physical stores, vending machines and online business
Prepare daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly operational reports in a timely manner, benchmark performance against budget, year on year and month on month data, and analyse the causes of performance gaps
Track key business indicators including sales volume, average transaction value, conversion rate and profit margin, and provide regular operational analysis to support performance improvement
Analyse the performance of different markets, stores and vending machines, identify trends and issues, and support the development of targeted actions to improve profitability
Support the Business Development team with data input for store and vending machine site selection, based on market data and operational analysis
Support monthly and quarterly operational review meetings by preparing review materials and presentations, highlighting business progress, key issues and improvement priorities, and tracking follow up actions
Work closely with the Finance team to verify operational, cost and expense data, align statistical definitions, resolve data discrepancies, and ensure management reporting is accurate and reliable




Business Insights and Reporting




Work closely with business teams on a daily basis to understand key business pain points, and support practical data solutions based on business needs and operating scenarios
Conduct data analysis across sales operations, marketing and consumer insights, identify the business logic behind the data, and provide insights to support business optimisation
Improve the quality and depth of recurring insight reports by moving beyond data listing and strengthening business focused conclusions and recommendations
Build and maintain structured data records and archives to support data traceability, consistency and reusability
Extract and process data from multiple sources, including business systems, CRM and ERP systems, and use SQL for regular queries, data cleaning, deduplication, correlation and aggregation
Build and maintain basic dashboards and automated reports to reduce manual reporting, improve data visibility, and support more efficient access to information




Cross Functional Collaboration and Data Governance




Support Sales, Marketing, Product, Supply Chain, Finance and other teams with day to day data requests, including customised queries, report exports and basic analysis support
Provide guidance to business teams on basic data viewing and analysis methods to improve the practical use of data in daily operations
Support the standardisation of data fields, statistical rules and analysis templates, and help establish data logs and archiving practices to strengthen data governance
Contribute to the development of a more consistent and practical data culture across the business




Required Qualifications




3–5 years of business analysis experience; candidates with experience in management consulting, internet business analysis, retail operations analysis, or other relevant analytical experience, or those with extensive professional experience are preferred




Excellent communication and organisational skills, capable of handling complex issues with structured thinking and analytical abilities




Proactive, hands-on, and entrepreneurial mindset with experience working in a fast-paced business environment




Outstanding problem-solving, analytical, written and verbal communication skills




Data-sensitive, able to identify business trends and issues through data analysis; proficiency in data analysis and visualisation tools such as Excel, SQL, Tableau is preferred, but strong willingness to learn is a must




Proficiency in English (listening, speaking, reading and writing), with extensive experience in cross-team project collaboration and communication







Desirable but Not Essential




Experience in the toy industry or pop culture retail sector
Familiarity with Local and European retail landscapes
Understanding of designer toy and collectible trends, particularly in the art toy market
Experience supporting operational reporting across multiple countries or regions
Understanding of retail KPIs including conversion rate, ATV, margin, labour efficiency and inventory performance
Exposure to data governance, reporting automation, or process improvement initiatives
Experience within retail, consumer goods, eCommerce, or multi-site operations environments
Experience working with ERP, CRM, POS or business intelligence systems
Familiarity with dashboard tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker










If you are excited to be part of POP MART’s journey and believe you have the skills and passion to contribute, click Apply Now and send us your CV.

  • Establish daily, weekly and monthly monitoring for core operational indicators, including revenue, gross profit, expense ratio, payment collection, labour efficiency and store efficiency, across all revenue channels such as physical stores, vending machines and online business
  • Prepare daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly operational reports in a timely manner, benchmark performance against budget, year on year and month on month data, and analyse the causes of performance gaps
  • Track key business indicators including sales volume, average transaction value, conversion rate and profit margin, and provide regular operational analysis to support performance improvement
  • Analyse the performance of different markets, stores and vending machines, identify trends and issues, and support the development of targeted actions to improve profitability
  • Support the Business Development team with data input for store and vending machine site selection, based on market data and operational analysis
  • Support monthly and quarterly operational review meetings by preparing review materials and presentations, highlighting business progress, key issues and improvement priorities, and tracking follow up actions
  • Work closely with the Finance team to verify operational, cost and expense data, align statistical definitions, resolve data discrepancies, and ensure management reporting is accurate and reliable


Business Insights and Reporting


  • Work closely with business teams on a daily basis to understand key business pain points, and support practical data solutions based on business needs and operating scenarios
  • Conduct data analysis across sales operations, marketing and consumer insights, identify the business logic behind the data, and provide insights to support business optimisation
  • Improve the quality and depth of recurring insight reports by moving beyond data listing and strengthening business focused conclusions and recommendations
  • Build and maintain structured data records and archives to support data traceability, consistency and reusability
  • Extract and process data from multiple sources, including business systems, CRM and ERP systems, and use SQL for regular queries, data cleaning, deduplication, correlation and aggregation
  • Build and maintain basic dashboards and automated reports to reduce manual reporting, improve data visibility, and support more efficient access to information


Cross Functional Collaboration and Data Governance


  • Support Sales, Marketing, Product, Supply Chain, Finance and other teams with day to day data requests, including customised queries, report exports and basic analysis support
  • Provide guidance to business teams on basic data viewing and analysis methods to improve the practical use of data in daily operations
  • Support the standardisation of data fields, statistical rules and analysis templates, and help establish data logs and archiving practices to strengthen data governance
  • Contribute to the development of a more consistent and practical data culture across the business


Required Qualifications


  • 3–5 years of business analysis experience; candidates with experience in management consulting, internet business analysis, retail operations analysis, or other relevant analytical experience, or those with extensive professional experience are preferred


  • Excellent communication and organisational skills, capable of handling complex issues with structured thinking and analytical abilities


  • Proactive, hands-on, and entrepreneurial mindset with experience working in a fast-paced business environment


  • Outstanding problem-solving, analytical, written and verbal communication skills


  • Data-sensitive, able to identify business trends and issues through data analysis; proficiency in data analysis and visualisation tools such as Excel, SQL, Tableau is preferred, but strong willingness to learn is a must


  • Proficiency in English (listening, speaking, reading and writing), with extensive experience in cross-team project collaboration and communication



Desirable but Not Essential


  • Experience in the toy industry or pop culture retail sector
  • Familiarity with Local and European retail landscapes
  • Understanding of designer toy and collectible trends, particularly in the art toy market
  • Experience supporting operational reporting across multiple countries or regions
  • Understanding of retail KPIs including conversion rate, ATV, margin, labour efficiency and inventory performance
  • Exposure to data governance, reporting automation, or process improvement initiatives
  • Experience within retail, consumer goods, eCommerce, or multi-site operations environments
  • Experience working with ERP, CRM, POS or business intelligence systems
  • Familiarity with dashboard tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker

Title: Junior Data Analyst

Salary or Salary range: £46,614 - £56,345 per annum

Posting End Date: 29 July 2026




About the role




The Junior Data Analyst role is a key part of the Centre for Health Policy, and the Institute of Global Health Innovation (IGHI) at Imperial. The post will involve working with multidisciplinary teams, including academics, policy fellows, clinicians, and patient and public involvement professionals to deliver quantitative analyses for both academic research and policy projects.




What you would be doing




As our Junior Data Analyst, you will develop and deliver quantitative analyses to support IGHI’s Centre for Health Policy projects. You will leverage a mix of statistics, data science, and data visualisation techniques to derive insights from healthcare data across different topics, including behavioural science, patient safety, digital health, and mental health. You will work with a broad range of healthcare datasets from national and global sources, and support both academic and non-academic (e.g. policy) outputs.




What we are looking for




We are looking for a curious and motivated individual with a strong interest in healthcare data and its potential to support real-world impact. This role is ideal for someone who is early in their career who will be able to demonstrate:




Knowledge of data access and analysis processes for sensitive healthcare data in England (e.g. HES, CPRD).
Experience of having used R and Python in a Secure Research Environment (SRE) to support academic and/or policy outputs.
Strong quantitative methodology knowledge, including statistics, machine learning, epidemiology, and natural language processing techniques.
Experience in accessing, cleaning and analysing publicly available data to update tools and data visualisations on a regular basis.
Experience of using data visualisation software (e.g. Tableau, Infogram, Plotly or similar) to communicate analytical findings.
Experience of reproducible analytical pipelines (RAP), use of version control and environment managers and their role in maintaining transparent, auditable, and reproducible analyses.
Strong ability to convey technical information to non-technical audiences, such as patients and the public.




What we can offer you




The opportunity to translate your analytics skills into outputs that will inform decision-making at the highest levels of healthcare leadership and policy development.
The opportunity to work at a world-leading institution and be part of our mission to use science for humanity.
Access to learning and development opportunities.
Access to a range of workplace benefits including a flexible working policy from day one, generous family leave packages, on-site leisure facilities and cycle-to-work scheme.
Benefit from sector-leading salary and remuneration package (including 41 days off a year and generous pension schemes).
Interest-free season ticket loan schemes for travel.
Be part of a diverse, inclusive and collaborative work culture with various staff networks and resources to support your personal and professional wellbeing.




Further information




This is a full-time post (35 hours per week), this role is for a fixed-term contract for 12 months.




If you require any further details about the role, please contact: Sophia Batchelor (s.batchelor@imperial.ac.uk)

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary




The Senior Data Analyst supports the organisation's objective of enhancing supervisory effectiveness through better use of entity and regulatory data. The role helps transform how Supervision teams identify risks, prioritise interventions and monitor firms, delivered through data-driven insights, dashboards, analytical tools and supervisory intelligence. It sits within a live testing programme for a regulatory data reporting regime. The analyst contributes to systems acceptance, firm feasibility and supervisory usability of the data being collected. The outcome is greater confidence in the regulatory data build through faster, more thorough testing.




Key Responsibilities




Supporting Supervisory Outcomes: Analyse risk indicators, alerts and supervisory insights to enable risk-based supervision and decision making.
Regulatory Data Analysis: Analyse authorisation, holdings, transactions, legal entity and regulatory reporting data. Create integrated views across firms and entities so supervisors see a coherent picture rather than fragmented sources.
Supervisory Intelligence and Risk Analytics: Identify trends, anomalies, concentrations and emerging risks. Support thematic reviews, quantitative investigations and synthesis of alerts.
Data Quality and Improvement: Assess data quality, implement validation controls and validate legal entity identifiers (LEIs). Enrich core datasets using external sources such as GLEIF, Companies House and market data proxies.
Reporting and Decision Support: Develop Tableau dashboards, management information and self-service analytics for Supervision teams, moving towards reusable, automated reporting.
Business Analysis and Stakeholder Engagement: Gather requirements, facilitate workshops and translate supervisory challenges into analytical solutions. Cohere disparate and conflicting business needs into workable plans through engagement and governance forums.
Future State Capability: Support the move towards automated reporting, advanced analytics, continuous monitoring and early-warning indicators, building a mature supervisory intelligence capability.




Essential Skills Technical




SQL and large-scale data analysis across complex, multi-source datasets.
AWS services such as S3, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.
Data visualisation and dashboarding in Tableau or Power BI.
Data quality assessment, validation and improvement.
Stakeholder management across business and technical audiences.
Regulatory or financial services experience.







Behavioral (must-have)




Highly proactive and self-driven — sets direction and momentum without close supervision.
Strategically astute — operates across different business areas, building knowledge and relationships rapidly.
Adaptable — pivots to address new challenges at short notice as contexts change.
Data-fluent — experience driving data-focused projects with a solid grasp of common data challenges in large organisations.
Coheres competing needs — reconciles disparate business requirements into deliverable plans via engagement, workshops and governance.




Desirable Skills




Familiarity with regulatory or financial data reporting regimes.




Eligibility Criteria




UK Citizen & SC Cleared
3 days mandatory work from London Client Site.










Why Join Us?

We’re a purpose‑driven organisation committed to creating positive impact and championing inclusion.
You’ll join a culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth.
We celebrate difference and believe diverse perspectives lead to stronger solutions.
Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply — great talent comes from a variety of backgrounds.
Your lived experience, unique strengths, and personal story matter — they help us design better outcomes for the communities we serve.
We celebrate diversity of experience, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and believe these differences enable us to create meaningful impact. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness and inclusion for all, regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related conditions, or any other protected characteristic. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Salary up to: Competitive

Data Analyst

Overall Ambition

Nando’s is on a journey to Create Lasting Happiness, making a difference to the lives of our people, our customers, and the communities we work in. Originally started in Johannesburg, South Africa, we pride ourselves on creating memorable experiences for everyone involved in Nando’s: from our employees, communities, founders, and suppliers, but most importantly, our customers.

Whilst we always look back on our history and story with pride, the story is still evolving. We have recently been growing our digital capabilities to ensure the Nando’s experience remains relevant to modern-day customers.

You will be joining a tech team that has grown rapidly in the past five years and is determined to enable change within the restaurant industry by bringing innovative thinking and the latest technology tools and practices to solve some of its most complex problems.

The Data and Analysis Team

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data and Analysis team. Our remit is to ensure everyone has access to the right information, at the right time, and that Nando’s gets the best value out of our data to achieve our business goals.

Our current focus is extracting insights from the data and creating a single source of accurate, timely data as we continue to increase our data maturity and advance our predictive analytic capability and explore the role of AI in the business.

You will be part of our work to support our strategic goals and build a data-informed attitude for addressing our opportunities and challenges.

Our Values

At Nando’s, our values guide how we work, make decisions, and show up for each other every day:


Pride – We take pride in everything we do, from the quality of our food to the impact of our work.
Passion – We bring energy, enthusiasm, and a love for what we do.
Courage – We speak up, challenge the status quo, and are not afraid to try new things.
Integrity – We do the right thing, act honestly, and build trust with each other.
Family – We care for and support one another, creating a sense of belonging where everyone can thrive.


What We're Looking For

As a Data Analyst you will work across a wide range of domains from financial and operational data, to kitchen tech and stock, helping our teams make better decisions grounded in sound analysis. As a curious problem-solver, you will be able to move between the technical and the commercial; and be comfortable building data models as well as presenting findings to senior stakeholders.

In this role you’ll work independently across the full data stack, understanding the ‘why’ behind requests before jumping to the ‘what’, and contributing to the translation of business problems into well-defined, actionable work. You’ll be supported by a collaborative team and won’t be expected to deliver everything solo from day one, but you’ll be expected to grow into doing so.

You will…


Write and maintain SQL models (in Dataform) to transform and serve reliable data across our pipelines
Support data engineers in the design, building and testing of data pipelines, able to contribute meaningfully, not just consume the output
Build and iterate on cloud-based reports and dashboards in Looker (or similar BI tool), giving our support teams and restaurants clear, actionable insight into performance
Translate business questions into well-scoped analysis and understand the problem and domain before reaching for the answer
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, choosing the right medium for the audience
Peer review colleagues’ work and contribute to data quality standards and documentation
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and data tasks, and take the initiative to implement them


Skills Required

You will have proven experience in the following:


Writing complex SQL to query, transform and model data across our cloud data platform (window functions, CTEs, complex datatypes)
Building and maintaining data models in Dataform, or a similar data transformation tool such as Snowflake or DBT, with an understanding of how they fit into the broader pipeline
Building reports and dashboards in Looker or a similar BI tool, serving reliable, self-serve data to the business
Using Git as standard practice — branching, pull requests and code review
Contributing to the translation of business requests into clearly scoped, actionable work items
Applying data quality techniques — writing tests, identifying issues proactively and communicating data limitations clearly
Documenting data models, definitions and lineage to a production standard
Understanding data governance principles and championing good data management practice within the team
Applying and understanding when to use relevant statistical methods to support analysis
Supporting data engineers in designing, coding and testing data processing pipelines
Using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Claude) to improve the speed and quality of your work — critically, not blindly — with an awareness of responsible AI use and data governance implications


You will also display


Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, able to explain complex findings in plain language and tell the story behind the data
Genuine intellectual curiosity, actively exploring new tools and methods, including AI, and sharing what you learn with the team
Comfort with ambiguity, able to define the right question and find the “so what” before jumping to answer
A product mindset, understanding the business objective behind every piece of analysis, not just the request on the surface
A proactive approach to improving processes, data quality and ways of working, with the initiative to make it happen, not just flag it
A collaborative team attitude, peer reviewing others’ work, sharing knowledge and contributing to a stronger team


Inclusion

At Nando’s, everyone is welcome. Inspired by our Southern African heritage we know and value the richness that diversity brings to Nando’s. We’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful culture for all; including our existing and future Nandocas, partners and suppliers, customers and the communities we are a part of. We deliberately work hard to create an environment where every individual is valued, respected and can flourish regardless of who they are, their background or outlook on life.

We welcome applications from a diverse range of individuals and will consider any reasonable adjustments in order to enable candidates to perform as well as possible during the recruitment process.
