Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DATA ANALYST

ABOUT US

Every day, we push beyond expectations to help millions of people save money, at a time when it’s never mattered more. Through MoneySuperMarket, MoneySavingExpert, Quidco and our B2B partnerships we supply products to more than 24 million unique monthly visitors, helping UK households to save billions of pounds a year. Can you tell this is something we’re exceptionally proud of!

Creative, collaborative, ambitious – it’s hard work. But what makes it worth it? Leaving work knowing we’ve made a difference to our customers, users, and to each other.

Put our distinct brands together with our dedicated colleagues and you’ve got a workplace with lots of personality. We’re open-minded, diverse, and love our differences. Everyone plays a part, and comes together to work hard, go beyond, and make sure everyone feels they belong.




WHY JOIN THE TEAM?

Understanding data and using it to improve customer experience are critical pillars of MoneySuperMarket Group’s success, leading to an extensive investment in people and capabilities within our Group Data function.




The Data Analytics team plays an essential role in helping the business achieve its goals and are actively involved in identifying unique areas where data can add more value to our customers. We use machine learning, data-driven experimentation, and analytics techniques with a tech stack involving Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GitHub, DBT and Tableau to gain insight into user behaviour, and optimise marketing and user experience.




Far more than number crunchers, MoneySuperMarket data analysts influence the direction of the company through actionable data-driven insight. The data analyst will work with the rest of the team to identify opportunities for personalisation, monitor performance of experiments, develop and track KPIs, and automate manual processes.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

In this hands-on role, you will apply your communications, technical and problem-solving skills to:

Work pro-actively within the data analytics team to deliver high impact projects that will:
Empower people across the business to make data-driven decisions by building self-serve reports and recommendations.
Deliver actionable insights across MoneySuperMarket, MoneySavingExperts and QuidCo brands.




Build relationships with stakeholders and ensure your work is communicated across the business.
Present findings and recommendations tailored to the relevant audience.
Troubleshoot and optimise existing data sources.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Workplace: White City, London - Hybrid

Data Analyst, Central Insights

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the ITV Insight Group’s Central Insights team.

Central Insights plays a crucial role in shaping ITV’s understanding of the UK television market, evolving viewer behaviours and future opportunities in an exciting, highly competitive and increasingly complex media landscape. Our work helps the business understand how viewers engage with ITV’s content across broadcast, VOD and SVOD, and supports key decisions across content, scheduling, marketing, product, strategy and performance planning.

As part of a cross-functional team, you will partner with Insight Managers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Analysts and business stakeholders to understand their challenges and help answer the “big questions”. You will use data to create clear, accurate and actionable insight, helping stakeholders make better decisions and supporting ITV’s wider strategic objectives.

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering analytical requirements for your business area, working with the wider team to produce high-quality analysis, dashboards, reports and recommendations. You will be encouraged to sharpen your technical skills, think critically about the questions being asked, and communicate insight in a way that is clear, trusted and impactful.

The team

ITV is on a mission to Supercharge Streaming and Optimise Broadcast with data and insight right at the centre of our digital transformation strategy.

The business faces many challenges ahead to achieve this vision: What content should we commission? Which audiences are the most commercially attractive for us? What should our marketing strategy be? How do we optimise our product to improve view through rates? How do we use VOD (Video on Demand) to offset declines to Linear TV?

Whatever the question, ITV Insights is here to lead the business to its most successful future by putting insight with integrity, ingenuity, and impact, at the heart of every key decision.

Responsibilities:


Analysing audience behaviours and providing insight on our viewers to drive business value.
Provision of accurate and insightful analysis on how viewers engage with and consume the nation’s best-loved and most-watched content across broadcast, VOD and SVOD.
Communicating analytics and insight to business stakeholders in a non-technical, strategically-minded and impactful manner.
Creating analysis, dashboards and reports that help stakeholders understand performance against key business KPIs.
Supporting proof of concept analysis for new metrics, methodologies, segmentations or analytical approaches.
As part of a cross-functional team, developing and embedding dashboarding solutions for business stakeholders, enabling a culture of self-service analytics.
Evaluating the performance of content, release strategies, marketing activity and product experiments, and supporting recommendations for future tests and next steps.
Working with large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities and risks in viewer behaviour and content performance.
Supporting forecasting and performance analysis across key business KPIs.
Collaborating with subject matter experts in a range of disciplines, including Insight Managers, Data Scientists, Analysts and business stakeholders, to drive projects forward.
Helping to embed analytical best practice across the team, including clear documentation, reproducible analysis and high-quality standards in analytical delivery.


Skills you’ll need (minimum criteria)


Proven experience (or similar exposure) within a data analytics role, with the ability to turn complex data into meaningful insights
Ability to create insightful analysis and dashboards.
Comfortable visualising and presenting analysis across a range of formats, including reports, PowerPoint, dashboards and email.
Experience using SQL to analyse large datasets.
Understanding of analytical techniques and statistical concepts.
Experience using Python for analytics, data transformation or modelling.
Strong attention to detail and a drive to produce accurate, trusted and well-documented analysis.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to tell clear and impactful stories with data.
Ability to work collaboratively with analysts, insight specialists and business stakeholders.
A curious and critical mindset, with the ability to question assumptions and understand the limitations of analysis.


Other things we’re looking for (key criteria)


A passion for TV programmes and an interest in the wider media landscape.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms such as GCP, BigQuery, AWS, Redshift or Databricks.
Experience working with data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio.
Experience of working with first and third party data, ideally in a TV, media, streaming, product, marketing or customer analytics environment.
Experience using Jupyter notebooks is preferable.
Experience of forecasting or predictive modelling in a business analytics context is preferable.
Keen problem solver who can demonstrate critical thinking, coupled with strong communication skills.
Interest in improving insight capability through automation, self-serve analytics, documentation or new ways of working.

Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services

At HH Global, we help the world’s most recognized brands turn their growth ideas into measurable impact through responsible marketing activation.

We are a global marketing activation partner that connects brands to their customers and delivers sustainable marketing execution at scale.

With over 4,000 colleagues across more than 55 countries, you’ll join a diverse, high-performing community, empowered to deliver sustainable, innovative solutions for our clients.

Purpose of the job

This role sits alongside our Client Engagement and Commercial teams analyzing the data generated through our service delivery to a global FMCG / beverage client.

You will receive, interrogate, qualify and validate the transactional data available and through a learned understanding of our service commitments, build reporting and story-telling around savings, commercial outcomes and contract compliance. Is the data correct and valid ? _ What have we achieved for our client ? _ Are we fulfilling our contractual obligations ?

We need you to be a strong and articulate communicator to engage with our client and various internal stakeholders.

Advanced Excel capability is essential. Being able to attend our Bishopsgate HQ for occasional meetings when required is necessary.

This is a permanent role and not open to those on Student Visas, Post Study Work Visas or otherwise requiring sponsorship now or in the future.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Data Analysis


Analyze large datasets relating to marketing campaigns, supplier costs, and operational performance
Review spend across channels (print, digital, POS, logistics, media production, etc)
Identify trends, anomalies, and cost drivers within campaign execution
Produce regular commercial performance reports and dashboards


Savings + Optimization


Identify and quantify cost-saving opportunities across marketing execution activities
Support savings initiatives including supplier renegotiations, process improvements, and specification optimization
Analyze pricing structures and benchmark costs against historical and industry standards
Track and report realized vs. forecast savings


Stakeholder Collaboration


Work closely with client engagement, procurement, finance, and operations teams
Present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Support client discussions with data-driven insights and recommendations


Data Management + Reporting


Build and maintain dashboards and reports (eg Power BI, Tableau, Excel)
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance across systems
Automate reporting processes where possible


Knowledge, skills + experience


High capability in data analysis and visualization tools (advanced Excel, SQL | Power BI, Tableau or similar)
Ability to manipulate and analyze large datasets with accuracy and translate that data into actionable commercial insights
Understanding of financial metrics, cost analysis, and ROI modelling - experience analyzing budgets, costs and supplier pricing
Strong understanding of cost drivers and margin optimization
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and inefficiencies
Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and quality
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex data clearly _ experience working with cross-functional teams
Confident presenting insights and recommendations

Description:
We are looking for a strong self-starter with a genuine passion for data and a drive to produce results. Client first
Results and impact driven
Self-motivated
Continuous improvement




Role Purpose

The LPS Analyst will report to the LPS Data Lead, providing hands-on analytical and data support across LPS's monoline facilities and wider Lockton portfolio solutions initiatives. The primary focus of the role will be to:




Continue building and maintaining the data infrastructure underpinning Lockton Portfolio Solutions monoline facilities.
Support opportunity scoping through the interrogation and modelling of premium and claims data.

Ensure reporting remains current and reliable as facilities grow and data sources evolve.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights.
Strong communication skills — able to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience working in the insurance or financial services sector.
Familiarity with London Market data processes, including BDX, Xchanging or Vipr.
Experience working with large, multi-source datasets and building data pipelines.
Knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
Experience building automated reporting solutions or data workflows.
Hands-on experience using Databricks for analytics and reporting workflows

Description:

Location: London (Hybrid – 2 days per week in office, either Mon/Wed or Tue/Wed)

Contract: 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract

Salary: £93,000 – £103,000 + Guaranteed Full Bonus

Reports to: Head of Tax Transformation

The Opportunity




My client is seeking a highly analytical Tax Automation & AI Data Analyst to join the Tax Transformation team on a 12-month fixed-term basis.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, automation and applied AI.




You will play a key role in helping the Tax function modernise its operating model by combining established automation technologies such as Alteryx with emerging AI capabilities, including LLM-powered tools and Agentic AI solutions.




Working directly with tax subject matter experts, you will help transform manual and spreadsheet-heavy processes into scalable, controlled and auditable solutions.




This is a hands-on delivery role focused on building practical automation and AI-enabled capabilities rather than leading people.




The successful candidate will be passionate about using data and technology to solve business problems, confident engaging with non-technical stakeholders and able to help teams identify new ways AI can create value across Tax operations.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop and maintain Alteryx workflows that automate complex tax and finance processes.
Partner with Tax SMEs to identify, prioritise and build a pipeline of automation and AI use cases.
Use data engineering and automation techniques to reduce manual processing and improve operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of AI-enabled solutions, including LLM-based tools, Claude use cases and Agentic AI capabilities.
Help the Tax function understand how AI can be practically and responsibly applied to enhance processes and decision-making.
Build controlled, auditable solutions within a regulated financial services environment.
Source, cleanse, validate and reconcile data from multiple systems and datasets.
Develop reporting, dashboards and analytical outputs to support operational and strategic tax activities.
Create clear technical documentation and promote adoption of new tools and processes.
Work closely with data engineering colleagues to help meet growing demand for automation and AI initiatives across the department.
Proactively identify opportunities for continuous improvement and bring forward innovative solutions.




Essential Skills & Experience

Minimum Requirements

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Hands-on experience developing business-critical workflows in Alteryx.
Alteryx certification or willingness to obtain certification quickly.
Experience working with complex datasets and data transformation activities.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience applying AI technologies within business processes, particularly:
LLM-based tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT or similar)
Prompt engineering and AI-assisted workflows
Emerging Agentic AI capabilities
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage and influence non-technical users.




Desirable Experience

Financial Services, Insurance or another highly regulated environment.
Experience supporting finance, tax, risk or control-related processes.
Knowledge of Power BI or similar visualisation tools.
Experience building AI-enabled automation solutions.
Understanding of governance, controls and risk considerations when deploying AI capabilities.
Exposure to tax, finance transformation or process improvement initiatives.




Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who:

Has strong Alteryx expertise as their core capability.
Is excited by the practical application of AI in business environments.
Can bridge the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders.
Enjoys helping non-technical colleagues adopt new technologies.
Thinks creatively about how data and AI can transform processes.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are

  • You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
  • You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
  • You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
  • You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
  • You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
  • You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
  • You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale

What you will do

Translate data into insight

  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
  • Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
  • Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation

Build and maintain dashboards & reports

  • Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
  • Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
  • Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users

Contribute to data quality & modelling

  • Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
  • Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
  • Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
  • Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated

Partner across teams

  • Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
  • Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
  • Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation

What we need from you

  • 2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
  • Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
  • Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
  • Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
  • Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
  • This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office

Experience you may have

  • A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
  • Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
  • Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
  • Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
  • Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks

Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Title: HOLT Data Analyst

This Analyst role sits within the HOLT team in London and provides broad exposure to HOLT’s valuation framework by collaborating across the Customs and Data Solutions, Model Development and Investment Strategy teams.

The role is designed for an early‑career professional with strong analytical fundamentals who is keen to develop across multiple areas, rather than specialize immediately.

Support valuation and financial analysis using the proprietary HOLT methodology across companies and sectors

Support documentation, testing, and process improvements across models, data, and analytical tools

Job Type

Full Time

Job Reference #

337395BR

City

London

Your team

HOLT is a proprietary valuation and analytics platform within UBS, supporting research, investment products, and client solutions across the firm.

This Analyst role offers structured exposure to multiple HOLT capabilities, providing a strong foundation for future development within HOLT or the broader Investment Bank.

The role emphasizes learning, collaboration, and practical application of valuation and data insights, making it an ideal entry point for candidates seeking a broad and flexible early‑career path.

Your expertise


2–4 years of relevant experience in finance, analytics, research, data, or a related role
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar
Good understanding of financial statements, corporate valuation, and equity markets
Strong programming fundamentals with a focus on automation and problem solving;
Ability to learn and adapt quickly
Clear written and verbal communication skills
Collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn across different functional areas
Demonstrate a passion for financial markets and investment decision‑making
Progress toward CFA or similar professional qualification
Prior exposure to equity research, investment strategies, or data/analytics roles
Familiar with Databricks; AI code assistants; NLP and Machine Learning; LLMs and AI Coding tools
You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use.

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

Title: Research & Data Analyst
Description:
Turn Data Into Insight. Help Organisations Make Better Global Decisions.

What if your research and analysis helped shape decisions for organisations operating in more than 180 countries?

At ECA International, trusted data is at the heart of everything we do.

Our products, technology and insights help multinational organisations understand the true cost of international mobility, benchmark compensation, support expatriates and make confident workforce decisions around the world.

Behind that data is our Product Analytics team - a group of curious, analytical thinkers who transform complex global information into trusted insight.

We're looking for a Research & Data Analyst to join that team.

This is far more than a traditional research role. You'll combine research, data analysis and emerging AI-powered techniques to help build and maintain one of the world's leading global mobility data sets, supporting products relied upon by organisations and international assignees across more than 500 cities worldwide.

If you're naturally curious, enjoy working with data and want to build a career where technology, AI and analytics come together, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As part of our Product Analytics team, you'll help collect, analyse and interpret information that powers ECA's products and services.

Working alongside experienced researchers, analysts and product specialists, you'll contribute to projects that influence how global organisations support their international workforce.

Your responsibilities will include:


Conducting primary and secondary research across a wide range of global mobility topics
Collecting, validating and organising information from surveys, databases, reports, AI tools and other trusted sources
Analysing data to identify trends, patterns and meaningful commercial insights
Supporting the creation of reports, presentations and recommendations for internal teams and clients
Researching market trends, competitor activity and emerging developments within global mobility
Exploring AI-supported and agentic research methods to improve the speed, quality and accuracy of research
Working collaboratively across Product Analytics and the wider business to continuously improve research processes and data quality


Every project is different, giving you the opportunity to continually expand your analytical skills while developing a strong understanding of international markets and global mobility.

Requirements

We're looking for someone with an analytical mindset who enjoys solving problems, asking questions and uncovering insights from data.

Whether you've recently graduated, completed an apprenticeship or already have some experience in research or analytics, you'll be excited by the opportunity to learn and develop within an international data-driven business.

You'll ideally have:


Strong analytical and numerical skills
Excellent attention to detail and pride in producing accurate work
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Confidence working with Excel and an interest in data analysis
Curiosity about how AI can improve research and analytical workflows
A proactive approach to learning and continuous improvement
The ability to manage multiple priorities while working collaboratively within a team
An interest in global business, economics or international affairs


It would be advantageous if you also have experience or exposure to:


SQL or Python
Data analysis or statistical techniques
Generative AI or agentic AI research tools
Data platforms such as PostgreSQL or Snowflake
Research, economics, business intelligence or market analysis through university, work experience or personal projects


Benefits

At ECA International, you'll join a business where research, technology and data combine to solve complex global challenges.

You'll work with experienced researchers, product specialists, engineers and analysts, developing valuable technical and analytical skills while contributing to products trusted by organisations worldwide.


Hybrid working
Excellent employee benefits
Ongoing learning and professional development
Exposure to modern research techniques, AI tools and data platforms
A collaborative international culture where curiosity and innovation are encouraged
The opportunity to build a career at the intersection of research, data and technology


For more than 50 years, ECA International has helped organisations successfully manage international workforces.

Today, our data, technology and expert insight support businesses operating across more than 180 countries, helping them navigate global mobility, compensation, tax, cost of living and workforce planning with confidence.

By combining trusted research with innovative technology, we're helping shape the future of global mobility.

Title: Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
Location: Multistory, Birmingham (Please note this role is primarily office based)

Salary: £37k

This role brings an exciting opportunity for the right candidate to join our growing Fraud Team. Reporting into the Fraud Manager, we are looking for an experienced data analyst to provide insights and track new and emerging trends to protect CrossCountry’s revenue through the prevention and detection of fraudulent activity across our network.

Purpose of job

The purpose of the Fraud Data Analyst is to proactively explore fraud-related risks to CrossCountry through effective data analysis. Using a variety of data sources, the postholder will identify fraudulent activity across the network, including both individual cases and wider trends or patterns.

The role will support the Revenue Protection and Anti-Fraud strategy by providing insight into revenue risks, identifying opportunities for intervention, and evidencing the impact of anti-fraud initiatives.

Principal Accountabilities


Support the Revenue Protection and Fraud team in the delivery of the Revenue Protection and Anti-Fraud strategy.
Use analytics to identify fraud risk and support the mitigation of revenue loss.
Evidence revenue recovered or generated as a result of analytical insight and recommendations.
Manipulate and analyse complex datasets from multiple sources.
Identify fraudulent travel behaviour by individuals and develop subject profiles for investigation.
Identify routes, locations, and processes at risk from fraudulent activity.
Highlight and quantify weaknesses in current processes and controls.
Produce insightful, accurate, and easy-to-interpret reporting for Senior Managers and wider stakeholders.
Work closely with internal departments and external partners, including other Train Operating Companies, to support fraud prevention initiatives.
Keep up to date with industry trends, emerging threats, and analytical techniques.
Undertake any other duties that are appropriate to this role, including ad-hoc analysis as required.


Essential


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience of working with complex datasets and drawing meaningful insights.
Ability to communicate findings clearly to a range of stakeholders.
Experience in reporting, data visualisation, or dashboard creation.
Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Ability to manage workload and prioritise effectively.
High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Desirable


Experience within fraud, revenue protection, or a regulated environment.
Knowledge of data analysis tools (e.g. SQL, VBA, Power BI).
Understanding of fraud patterns and risk indicators.
Experience working with transport or rail industry data.


To apply for this role, please submit your CV by Thursday 30th July 2026.

Please note, the successful applicant will be required to attend a medical and have a DBS check carried out.

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Job description:



Sizewell C’s business is to design, finance, construct, commission, operate, maintain, and eventually decommission the nuclear power plant and related infrastructure at Sizewell C in Suffolk. Overall, whilst the Company is in the construction phase, the Boards’ principal focus is on the development and construction of Sizewell C on time, on budget and to the highest quality and safety standards. The Company is maturing to meet all these requirements.

Sizewell C is economically regulated by OFGEM under the RAB model similar to other UK electricity distribution networks and Thames Tideway.

Sizewell C construction strategy is to replicate the design of Hinkley Point C, using the majority of the same supply chain, but innovating in the way it is delivered to achieve savings in time and cost of around 20%. The CCO will need to be guided by and incorporate lessons learned from the Hinkley Point C commercial delivery to achieve Sizewell C’s ambition.

Following Financial Completion and Revenue Commencement, Sizewell C is fully funded and is owned by; The Secretary of State for Energy Security and Net Zero representing HM Government, La Caisse, Centrica, EDF and Amber Infrastructure. 

 

Reporting Analyst

Location: Based in London on a hybrid basis with travel to Suffolk as required.   

Contract: Permanent, full-time. 

Salary: £56,000k - £66,000k dependant on experience, plus benefits 

Benefits include: 

Annual Leave: 28 days per annum, increasing to 30 days after 5 years of service, plus bank holidays. 
Bonus: 5% annual bonus. 
Pension Contributions: Defined Contribution Pension Scheme with up to 7.5% employee contribution 15% employer contribution. 

 

 

Closing Date:  Tuesday 4th August 2026.

 

Sizewell C is entering an exciting phase of growth as we mature into an independent organisation and continue building one of the UK’s largest and most important energy projects. 

 

About the Role

 

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Reporting Analyst to join the Sizewell C project team. In this role, you will be responsible for producing accurate, timely, and insightful reports that support project controls, programme delivery, and strategic decision-making across one of the UK's largest infrastructure projects.

Working closely with project managers, planners, commercial teams, and senior stakeholders, you will transform complex project data into meaningful management information, helping to monitor performance, identify trends, and support informed decision-making.

 

About You

 

Experience in a Reporting Analyst, PMO Analyst, Project Controls, or Business Intelligence role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query, Pivot Tables, and complex formulas.
Experience using Power BI to develop dashboards and visualisations.
Knowledge of project reporting within large infrastructure, engineering, construction, or energy environments.
Ability to interpret large datasets and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders.
Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet reporting deadlines.

 

 

Why Join Us?

 

Be part of one of the most important low-carbon energy projects in the UK.
Work in a mission-driven environment that values innovation, integrity, and long-term sustainability.
Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career development.
Flexible and hybrid working options. 

 

 

 

 

Key Competencies 

 

Behavioural Competences   

 

Humility 

 

Recognise the value brought from different cultures and experiences 
Be open to other’s points of view and ideas, be willing to debate and to compromise 

 

Positivity 

 

Positively challenge poor quality and performance 
Identify solutions at the lowest possible level 
Encourage tier 1s and others to bring new ideas forward 

 

Respect 

 

Value the rules and environment in which we operate  
Give and receive feedback with respect  
Embrace and engage with new people and ideas 

 

Solidarity 

 

One team, working closely together and helping each other 
Empowered teams always looking forward. 
Shared responsibility for delivery the project outcomes 

 

Clarity 

 

Communicate clearly and consistently  
Promote collaboration and team alignment  
Clearer and faster decision making  
Drive simplification at all levels 

 


If this sounds like the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today. 

 

When joining Sizewell C, you may wonder why you are contacted by colleagues with an EDF email or see the EDF logo on portals that you access and/or documentation you receive; this is because we have partnered with EDF for the provision of a number of support services whilst we complete a successful transition out of the EDF group.

At Sizewell C we encourage and embrace diversity and how it can improve our experience and performance at work. It is a requirement that those who join us have the right to work in the UK. Whilst sponsorship may be a possibility that we can explore, we are fully committed to local recruitment where possible, and those already holding the right to work in the UK.  

To be appointed to this role, you will need to meet the criteria for Security Vetting, which will, ordinarily, require you to have been a resident of the UK for at least three of the past five years.

Title: Data Analyst - Consulting
Description:
IWSR is the global authority on beverage alcohol data and intelligence. Now part of WGSN, the world's leading trends forecaster, IWSR has for over 50 years been trusted by the leaders of global beverage alcohol businesses as an integral part of their strategic planning and decision-making.

Our Consulting team advises C-suite leaders across the world's biggest alcohol manufacturers and major domestic players. This is a newly created, early-career role, driven by sustained growth in demand for consulting and custom data analytics projects. You'll work across live client projects from day one, turning complex quantitative data into clear, client-ready analysis and recommendations.




What you'll do

Use IWSR's proprietary category and consumer datasets to build, interrogate and interpret complex quantitative analyses
Support consulting projects end to end, including research design, analysis planning, and building charts and outputs in Excel and PowerPoint
Conduct secondary/desk research to bring market intelligence and trend context into client deliverables
Translate quantitative findings into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations
Work across multiple live projects at once, prioritising to meet deadlines




What we're looking for

A naturally curious, inquisitive mindset. Someone who wants to understand the 'why', not just report the 'what'
Strong attention to detail and pride in accurate, well-checked work
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, and comfort turning large, complex data sets into clear insight
Degree-level (or Masters) qualification in a numerate discipline: maths, science, engineering, economics or social science
A team-first attitude, happy to help wherever it's needed
Comfortable with a hybrid, London-based working pattern (more time in the office than out)




Nice to have

Interest in, or knowledge of, beverage alcohol, drinks, food or FMCG
Fluency in Spanish or French; other European languages or Mandarin also welcome
Exposure to Power BI, SQL, SPSS, SAS or Q




Apply via the IWSR careers site. You'll be asked a few quick questions as part of the application.

Title: Data Analyst
Place: City Of London, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Data Analyst – London




5-6 Month Contract




Up to £525 per day | Outside IR35




Hybrid Working – 1-2 Days Per Week Onsite




We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join an exciting transformation programme focused on evolving how the organisation uses data to drive better business decisions.

This role will play a key part in enabling self-service analytics by leveraging Looker to create semantic layers across core datasets. These semantic models will support Looker AI Agents (Looker Conversation), Large Language Models (LLMs) and automated push notifications, giving business users greater flexibility to explore data, receive proactive insights and accelerate decision-making.

A significant focus of this role will be working with LLM-powered AI solutions, reviewing large and complex datasets, validating AI-generated outputs and ensuring that insights delivered to the business are accurate, reliable and fit for purpose. You'll be responsible for maintaining rigorous quality assurance standards and will have the confidence to sign off AI-generated outputs before they are released to the business.

Working closely with business stakeholders, data engineering teams and analytics specialists, you'll help shape how AI, semantic modelling and trusted data are used across the organisation.




Key skills and responsibilities,

Looker expertise – Proven hands-on experience developing and working within the Looker platform, including semantic layer creation and optimisation.
Looker AI Agents – Experience working with or supporting AI Agents within Looker (Looker Conversation), helping to optimise semantic models and improve AI-generated responses.
Automated Push Notifications – Experience building or supporting automated push notifications and proactive insight delivery using data-driven workflows.
LLM & AI experience – Strong experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI-powered analytics or conversational AI solutions, ensuring outputs are accurate, relevant and trusted.
Large Dataset Analysis – Extensive experience analysing, interrogating and validating large, complex datasets, identifying anomalies and ensuring data integrity across AI-driven solutions.
Semantic Layer Development – Collaborate with business domain experts to design, build and optimise semantic layers, working closely with Data Engineering to improve performance and scalability.
Quality Assurance – Significant experience testing, validating and quality assuring data products and AI-generated outputs, with exceptional attention to detail and a critical eye for accuracy.
Results Ownership – Confident taking accountability for data quality and formally signing off whether AI-generated insights meet business and delivery standards.
AI & Machine Learning Lifecycle – Previous experience supporting AI/ML initiatives and AI agents from development through to deployment, with an understanding of model validation and continuous improvement.
SQL Proficiency – Strong working knowledge of SQL for analysing, interrogating and validating large datasets.
Stakeholder Engagement – Partner with business stakeholders to understand key business questions and translate requirements into trusted analytical models.
Adaptability – Comfortable working in an agile environment where priorities evolve, AI capabilities mature and continuous learning is encouraged.




This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-enabled analytics, helping shape how the organisation leverages LLMs, Looker AI Agents, semantic modelling and automated push notifications to transform how data is consumed and trusted across the business.




Interested? Please submit your updated CV to Dean Sadler-Parkes at Harvey Nash for immediate consideration.

Title: Data Analyst

The Analyst will use creativity and technical skills to locate data sources, mine, review, validate, protect, and store data, identify trends, patterns, and anomalies, and use findings to develop strategies to reduce costs, improve processes and practices, and increase efficiency, quality, security, and consistency. To be a successful Analyst, you should be focused on translating complex numerical data into actionable strategies. You should be analytical, collaborative, communicative, and detail-oriented.

Ability to recognize patterns and trends in large data sets and use numerical information to develop business strategies.
Strong math, organization, critical thinking, and problem solving skills.
Exceptional presentation, research, and verbal and written communication.
Ability to summarize and explain complex information to other.

About our Team

Our team supports the accuracy and integrity of sales and compensation data across the organisation. We work closely with Sales Operations, Finance, and technology partners to ensure data is reliable, well controlled, and ready for critical reporting and payout cycles. The team focuses on continuous improvement, strengthening data quality, increasing automation, and reducing risk through clear processes, collaboration, and shared accountability.

Ingest and consolidate large datasets from Sales Operations, Finance, and CRM systems
Map transactions and performance metrics to sales participants
Own data quality controls, reconciliation processes, and audit trails
Ensure accurate attribution of revenue, quotas, credits, overlays, and splits
Prepare validated datasets to support compensation payout cycles
Investigate and resolve data discrepancies and support audits
Build reporting to track data accuracy, readiness, trends, and risks
Review end‑to‑end processes to identify inefficiencies and implement automation and standardisation




Requirements

Strong experience working with large, complex datasets
Advanced Excel skills for analysis, reconciliation, and validation
Experience in analytics, sales compensation, or related data operations
Ability to perform root‑cause analysis and solve data quality issues
Clear communication skills to work with technical and non‑technical stakeholders
Experience preparing data for financial or compensation processes
Knowledge of SQL or Python
Familiarity with compensation platforms, CRM systems, and data visualisation tools




Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst | Last Mile | Hybrid Working | Hatfield (2 days in the office)

Introduction

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About The Role

As a Last Mile Senior Analyst in the Global Technology Services (GTS) Analytics team, you'll use data to transform final-stage order fulfilment across the Ocado Smart Platform. Based in Hatfield, you'll deliver insights that improve delivery efficiency, customer satisfaction, and partner performance, with a focus on network planning, resource strategy, and routing optimisation.

Working across technology, operations, and international partners, you'll lead high-impact analytics projects, influence strategic decisions, and help drive lower costs and reduced carbon emissions. You'll also champion data best practices and mentor colleagues, combining technical expertise with leadership to shape the future of last-mile operations.

Key Responsibilities


Support the strategic roadmap for last-mile analytics, ensuring alignment with broader organisational goals and industry trends.
Partner with Last Mile leadership to develop data-driven strategies for route optimisation, network planning, and customer experience.
Build advanced forecasting and optimisation models to improve delivery efficiency, routing, and capacity utilisation.
Apply statistical methods and machine learning techniques to uncover actionable insights from complex delivery and customer datasets.
Track, analyse, and report on performance trends to identify operational bottlenecks and drive cost-saving initiatives.
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and self-service tools using Looker to provide stakeholders with real-time performance insights.
Collaborate with software development teams to integrate analytics solutions into operational workflows and inform platform enhancements.
Provide strategic guidance and actionable insights to international partners and strategy planners across the globe.
Mentor, coach, and provide constructive feedback to team members, championing analytical best practices and supporting career development.


Essential

What We’re Looking For


Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a passion for driving the implementation of recommendations that deliver measurable results.
Technical proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.
Programming experience with Python or R is beneficial.
Proven experience creating data visualisations and dashboards using tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
Strong analytical, numerical, and statistical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Hands-on experience utilising AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics workflows, from initial data exploration through to insight generation.


Nice to Haves


Experience applying geospatial analytics and location-based data to optimise delivery networks, routing, and operational decision-making.
Experience in last-mile logistics, home delivery, network strategy, or retail/eCommerce fulfillment operations.
Experience in last-mile logistics and network planning, including holistic operational cost-to-serve modeling.
An understanding of eCommerce customer behavior and key operational metrics such as drop densities and on-time delivery rates.
Professional experience within a consulting or advisory role, bringing structured problem-solving to projects with varied stakeholders.
A proven track record of working closely with external partners to deploy and operationalise data solutions at scale.


Benefits

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:


Time to recharge: 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
Health & wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.
Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.
Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.
Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).


Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application.

VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement & Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Who We’re Looking For

An Analyst with a strong aptitude to turn data into insights and clear recommendations for clients. Working within the VML Data & Analytics team, you will analyse data across the digital and marketing ecosystem to understand what is working, and what needs to be optimised.

Working closely with the wider analytics and data team you will be responsible for the delivery of measurement and insight projects across various digital and marketing activities and contribute to answering business questions, ensuring that we are making best use of available data to deliver against the client vision.

On a day-to-day basis you will take ownership of analysis projects, delivering them to a high degree of accuracy and take a role in presenting results and insights to clients. This will be developed and delivered with the wider team of client services, strategy and media planning so a team player is a must.

Communication and interpersonal skills are important, both in collaborating with clients and colleagues across multiple disciplines.

What You’ll Be Doing


Deliver end-to-end analyses aimed at helping Marketing to improve the experience of the customer
Deliver measurement and effectiveness projects, including dashboard reporting and deep dive evaluations to understand the impact marketing has on customer behaviour
Assist senior analysts on developing customer projects (segmentation, modelling), using statistical techniques to develop a deep understanding of customers
Ensure that the most relevant methodologies are applied to measure and evaluate, proactively recommending better ways of working
Develop and provide written and verbal output on reports and presentations, supporting with recommendations on marketing strategy
Manage and resolve data issues involving quality and consistency of data
Be the clients trusted advisor on data and analytical methodology - make it easy for them to make business decisions based on data
Present to clients and attend client meetings.
Be highly collaborative in integrating data work into agency deliverables, working with strategy and account teams to develop a culture of data informed decision-making.
Develop the skills and knowledge of colleagues, creating and sustaining a learning culture within the team.


What You’ll Need


3+ years working in a marketing environment as an analyst
Experience of coding languages such as Python, SQL, R
Experience of devising, implementing, and managing reporting dashboard design, update and automation using tools such as PowerBI and Tableau
Experience of web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics
High level Microsoft Word, Excel and PPT skills
Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy
Well-developed numeracy skills
Able to translate business needs and requirements to analytical methods and outputs
Good written and verbal communication skills
High level analytical skills in relation to performance analysis, including an understanding of different methodologies to calculate incremental uplift
Knowledge of advanced data analysis techniques that include customer segmentation, predictive modelling, multivariate analysis, querying and reporting tools, A/B testing and statistical significance

Our people are the heartbeat of our organization—creators, doers, innovators, makers, and thinkers—who drive not just marketing, but meaningful experiences that resonate in every action and interaction.

Title: Data Analyst
Place: City Of London, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Business Data Analyst



Asset Management | London | Hybrid

We're partnering with a leading investment management organisation that is investing heavily in data, automation and technology to support the next phase of its growth. As part of this investment, they're looking to hire a Business Data Analyst to join a growing data function focused on improving data quality, governance, reporting and automation across the business.

This is an excellent opportunity to work at the heart of a business undergoing significant transformation, helping to shape how data is managed, analysed and leveraged across Operations, Product, Risk, Performance, Fund Accounting and Front Office teams.




The Role



Working within a collaborative Business Data Management team, you'll play a key role in delivering the organisation's data strategy by identifying opportunities to automate manual processes, improving data governance and developing insightful reporting solutions.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across the business to understand data challenges, implement new technologies and support the development of self-service reporting capabilities.




Key Responsibilities


Drive the automation and optimisation of existing manual processes using strategic data tools
Analyse and visualise business data to provide meaningful insights across multiple business functions
Support the development of data governance standards and foundational data domains
Build and enhance self-service reporting and dashboards using Power BI
Work with third-party vendors to integrate data platforms and improve data accessibility
Produce reports for governance forums, steering committees and senior stakeholders
Create and maintain process documentation and support continuous improvement initiatives
Collaborate with business and technology teams to deliver data-focused change projects


About You



We're looking for someone with a passion for data, technology and continuous improvement who enjoys solving complex business problems.

You'll ideally have:


Experience within Asset Management or the wider Investment Management industry
Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills
Experience with SQL and Python
Experience using Power BI for reporting and dashboard creation
Knowledge of Snowflake and Alteryx
Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills
Experience working within business change or transformation programmes (desirable)
Exposure to Power Automate, APIs or SFTP integrations (advantageous)
IMC qualification or similar (desirable)


Why Apply?


Join a newly created role within a growing data team
Work on high-profile automation and data transformation initiatives
Influence the future direction of the organisation's data capabilities
Gain exposure across multiple areas of a leading investment management business
Hybrid working and an excellent opportunity for long-term career development

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Business Data Analyst

3 months contract

Day rate: £500- £550 per day outside IR35

Primarily remote, with occasional travel to Central London




Stanton House has partnered with a consultancy business supporting a major financial services client on a regulatory compliance and assurance transformation programme.




We are seeking an experienced Business Data Analyst to support the current discovery and assessment phase of the programme. This role will focus on understanding and assessing the data landscape, identifying data sources, evaluating data quality, documenting data lineage, and helping shape requirements for future implementation.




Key Responsibilities:

Conduct discovery and assessment of current-state data, technology, regulatory and operational landscapes.
Map critical data sources, flows, quality and dependencies required to support automated compliance processes.
Identify barriers to data access, including technical, commercial, and operational challenges.
Work closely with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements and develop future-state data solutions.
Facilitate workshops and engage with SMEs to understand current processes and data dependencies.
Provide consultative recommendations and support the definition of future-state solutions, operating models and implementation approaches.




Required Experience:

Strong financial services regulatory and compliance expertise, with a solid understanding of how regulators operate.
Experience working on regulatory transformation, assurance, risk or compliance programmes within financial services.
Data discovery and assessment experience, including data mapping, lineage, quality and suitability analysis.
Consulting background with excellent stakeholder management and requirements-gathering skills.
Strong AI literacy, including familiarity with leading AI models and the application of AI within regulated environments.
Energetic, engaging and commercially-minded individual who can influence stakeholders and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving programmes.




This is an excellent opportunity to join a high-profile transformation programme at the intersection of regulatory compliance, data, and AI.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst
London, Hybrid
Salary up to £45,000

This is an opportunity to work with a genuinely unique behavioural dataset that brings together digital activity, media exposure, shopping behaviour and emerging AI interactions. You will play a key role in uncovering insights that help organisations understand how consumers behave and how advertising influences real-world decisions.

The Company
They are a specialist data and analytics business focused on understanding consumer behaviour in depth. Their work combines advanced behavioural datasets with commercial insight to support global brands and media organisations. Operating as a growing and entrepreneurial team, they encourage new ideas and give individuals the chance to have a meaningful impact. Their approach goes beyond traditional research, using innovative data sources to answer complex business questions.

The Role
You will work closely with rich behavioural datasets to uncover patterns and deliver insights that drive commercial decisions. Responsibilities include:

Extracting and querying data using SQL
Cleaning, structuring and analysing large datasets
Identifying trends in consumer behaviour and generating actionable insights
Delivering post-campaign analysis to measure marketing effectiveness
Supporting bespoke analytical projects that address complex business challenges
Translating data into clear, client-ready presentations and outputs
Working across both quantitative and qualitative datasets where appropriate
Developing repeatable analytical processes and methodologies
Collaborating with senior stakeholders to evolve analytical capabilities
Exploring new ways to leverage data, including AI-driven behavioural signals
Your Skills & Experience

Strong commercial experience in data analysis, with a hands-on approach to data
Advanced SQL skills and confidence working with large datasets
Strong Excel or equivalent data manipulation capability
Experience analysing and interpreting data to generate business insights
Ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Curiosity and problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail
Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects
Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT or similar, with an interest in applying AI to analysis

How to Apply
If you are interested in applying your analytical skills to innovative datasets and delivering meaningful commercial insights, please apply with your CV.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst
London, Hybrid
Salary up to £60,000

This is an excellent opportunity for a Data Analyst to join a well-established analytics team working on one of the UK's largest and most complex customer databases. You'll have the chance to work with large-scale datasets, influence data-driven marketing strategies, and contribute to the evolution of the team's reporting and analytics capabilities.

The Company
They are a leading customer experience and marketing consultancy that helps organisations use data to better understand customer behaviour and improve engagement. Their analytics function combines data analysis, data science, and marketing insight to support business-critical decision making. With a strong focus on long-term client partnerships, they provide analysts with exposure to complex challenges and high-impact projects. The team has an exceptionally strong retention rate, creating a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and development are encouraged.

The Role
As a Data Analyst, you will work within a specialist marketing analytics team responsible for supporting customer engagement and campaign performance through data-driven insights.
Responsibilities include:

Extracting, cleaning, and preparing large, complex datasets for analysis
Writing SAS and SQL queries to interrogate data and generate business insights
Conducting pre and post-campaign analysis to evaluate marketing effectiveness
Supporting audience segmentation, profiling, and customer targeting initiatives
Building reports and dashboards to communicate findings to stakeholders
Contributing to the ongoing migration of reporting processes into Power BI
Identifying opportunities to improve data processes and analytical approaches
Working closely with stakeholders in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
Your Skills & Experience

Strong commercial experience using SAS and SQL
Advanced Excel skills
Experience working with large, complex, and imperfect datasets, including data extraction and cleansing
Marketing analytics experience, including campaign analysis, customer insights, audience segmentation, or customer journey analysis
Ability to translate data into actionable recommendations

I’m working with a growing financial technology client in London who are looking to hire an early-career Data Analyst into a maturing data function.




This would be a great role for a talented Data Analyst with aspirations of growing into a Data Science position over time. The immediate need is analytical and commercially focused, but you’ll be learning from a technically strong Data Scientist who can provide hands-on coaching and development.




This is not a deep data science or machine learning role from day one. It is a business-facing analyst position, working closely with finance, operations, marketing, and senior leadership to turn data into clear commercial insight.




The role will suit someone bright, curious, and early in their career who wants proper coaching, genuine exposure, and the chance to learn how a financial services business works from the inside.




You’ll report into a highly capable Data Scientist who is stepping into management and will provide hands-on technical guidance, with regular exposure to the Finance Director and CEO. The structure is flat, the data engineering team is already well established, and the environment is set up for someone to learn quickly without being left to figure everything out alone.




What you’ll be doing:

Analysing commercial, finance, and operational data
Spotting trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
Communicating insight clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Working with established data processes and tooling
Partnering closely with more senior people before running independently with ideas
Building your commercial understanding of a fast-moving fintech environment




What they’re looking for:

Strong SQL and some Python experience
Exposure to modern data tooling such as dbt or Airflow
Some experience with data visualisation and reporting
Strong communication skills, especially with non-technical stakeholders
High EQ, curiosity, and willingness to learn
A collaborative mindset and the maturity to ask questions before building in isolation
Fintech, financial services, or card issuing experience would be a bonus, but is not essential




The key here is attitude and commercial thinking. The client is not looking for someone who wants to disappear into technical work. They want someone who can understand a business problem, work with others, and explain findings in plain English.




Interview process:

1st stage: Intro chat with senior finance and data stakeholders
2nd stage: Technical interview
Final stage: In-office meeting with the wider leadership and data team




If you’re a Data Analyst who wants to build strong commercial foundations while developing towards Data Science over time, this could be a really strong fit.
