Title: Data Science expert
Description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Data Science Expert to support the development of advanced data and analytics solutions within a highly regulated manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to transform complex process and operational data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.

Location & Work Mode



Location: Toronto, ON
Work Mode: Hybrid
Seniority: Middle (4–6 years of experience)
Schedule: Flexibility to work with European time zones, including availability for an early shift (approximately 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM)



Key Responsibilities



Design, develop, and maintain ready-to-use data and analytics systems.
Extract, organize, contextualize, and transform data from multiple source systems into business-ready formats.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT), Automation, Digital, Quality, and other functions to gather analytics requirements.
Map process parameters and manufacturing data to source systems such as MES, PI Historian, LIMS, iShift, and cloud-based data platforms.
Develop data contextualization pipelines within cloud-based AI and analytics environments.
Build and maintain data visualization solutions and dashboards to support operational and business needs.
Develop and support machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accessibility across multiple platforms.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven insights and process monitoring.



Required Qualifications



4–6 years of experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or related fields.
Strong experience working with manufacturing, process, or operational data.
Hands-on experience with:
Python
SQL (MS SQL Server)
Power BI
Snowflake
GitHub
Experience working with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems), LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems), and process data platforms.
Knowledge of data modeling, data pipelines, data contextualization, and analytics solution development.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.


Nice-to-Have Qualifications



Experience with PI Historian and PI Vision.
Experience with JMP, SIMCA, and SIMCA-online.
Exposure to Machine Learning and AI platforms.
Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or other regulated industries.
Understanding of manufacturing processes and process performance monitoring.



Expected Compensation Range:

50K-90K The final compensation offered will be determined based on the candidate’s level of experience, skills, and qualifications, in compliance with applicable pay transparency requirements.

Canadian Experience Requirement:

No Canadian work experience is required for this position. Candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of previous Canadian experience.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Disclosure:

No Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools are used in the screening, assessment, or selection of candidates for this position. All stages of the recruitment process are conducted by human recruiters and hiring managers.

Statement Regarding Job Vacancy:

This position is a Job creation, created to support ongoing project needs.

Recruitment Process & Feedback Timeline:

Candidates will receive feedback on their application within a maximum of 45 days from the date of application or from their most recent interview stage.

Why choose us



An international community bringing together more than 110 different nationalities
An environment where trust is central: 70% of our leaders started their careers at the entry level
A strong training system with our internal Academy and more than 250 modules available
A dynamic work environment that frequently comes together for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)



Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to bringing together people from diverse backgrounds and creating an inclusive work environment. In this regard, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

Who are we?

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:

Brief Call: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!

We look forward to meeting you!

Description:
Operations Analyst




Toronto

(Full-time Permanent)




This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and digitally capable Operations Analyst to join our fast-paced team in ensuring seamless and timely campaign delivery and connectivity of all our digital screens. This role is a key operational link between Trooh’s venues, technicians, and internal teams - requiring strong communication skills, excellent coordination skills, and the ability to troubleshoot issues efficiently.




The hours of work may vary from 9:00 am to 7:00 pm (Afternoon/Evening shift)




Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

Prioritize and assign tickets to technicians through Trooh’s ticketing system.
Serve as the primary contact for technicians, managing communication and ensuring jobs are completed to Trooh’s quality and timing expectations.
Independently track and follow up on tickets, proactively resolving delays or issues with urgency.
Serve as the operational link between venues, technicians, and internal teams to ensure smooth coordination and clear communication.
Set clear expectations on technician fees at the outset of each job, ensuring quotes are reasonable and aligned with scope; review and reconcile charges to confirm accuracy and flag discrepancies.
Ensure team KPIs are being met and recommend process improvements based on patterns or operational inefficiencies.
Support operational reporting and metrics tracking through the creation and maintenance of dashboards and reports using SQL, Power BI, and Tableau.
Assist in the design of scalable reporting solutions to monitor field operations, ticketing workflows, and digital screen uptime.
Participate in special projects, assignments, and administrative duties as needed.




What you offer:

Degree in Operations, Marketing, Business Management, Data Analytics or a related discipline with 2 – 4 years of experience in a similar role.
Strong digital fluency: confident using tools like Excel (pivot tables, formulas), SQL, Power BI, and/or Tableau to analyze data, build dashboards, and generate performance reports
Comfortable working with data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and actionable insights that support operational improvements
Familiarity with CRM or ticketing systems (e.g., HubSpot) and basic database concepts
Excellent communicator: able to write clearly, speak with confidence, and adapt tone/style to suit different audiences (technicians, internal teams, venue partners).
Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage shifting priorities and tight deadlines without missing a beat.
The ability to hold people accountable and keep others on track of work assignments.
Self-motivated, reliable, and solutions-oriented—you don’t wait for direction to act.
Professional, outgoing, enthusiastic and a real team player that is ready to champion the Trooh brand.




What a career at Trooh can offer you?

Competitive compensation packages
Full benefits including RRSP matching
Generous paid time off as well as a December holiday closure
4.5 Day Work Week
Milestone Recognition Program
Employee Referral bonuses
Training opportunities: Online and leadership development training
Vibrant team-work environment




Pay Transparency

The expected salary range is $65,000 - $75,000, commensurate with experience.




Trooh is a leading American media company, reaching millions of Gen Z consumers on their daily journey out-of-home. We have transformed the landscape with the integration of data, insights and digital into large scale, sought-after locations. As leaders in audience targeting to 18-24’s, we have built scale and impact through our campus environments in over 1000+ colleges and universities nationwide. Trooh’s extensive addressable media, spread across thousands of high dwell-time locations, ensures high-impact solutions to engage Gen Z consumers at the right time. As a Great Place to Work certified organization, Trooh is equally committed to fostering a culture built on trust, inclusion, and employee engagement.




We appreciate the interest of all candidates; however, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.




Trooh Media is an equal opportunity employer. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles

We are looking for a Data Analyst, Product who will play a pivotal role in bridging data insights with strategic business decisions as Relay enters an exciting new chapter of growth. As we’ve grown, we need support from you in bridging the gap between data insights and strategic product or business decisions, influencing the direction and success of Relay. You'll be instrumental in ensuring that our product & business teams are empowered with deep, actionable insights, enabling us to make informed, data-driven decisions that resonate with our customers' needs.

What You'll Be Doing


Collaborating with cross-functional teams by proactively proposing analytical solutions and data insights that drive improvement in key strategic pillars
Ensuring teams have the necessary data they need to function effectively by identifying and tracking core KPIs on top of building dashboards and reports
Performing in-depth analysis to drive fresh insights, and inform business recommendations by presenting trends to stakeholders
Monitoring and evaluating data quality to ensure the accuracy and consistency of data
Consistently delivering high-quality data models, easy-to-interpret visuals (such as charts, graphs and dashboards), and reports that demonstrate a strong understanding of business needs and objectives
Apply statistical methods to dissect and interpret data, aiding in the prediction and evaluation of new product features and market opportunities. This includes conducting A/B tests and measuring the impact of product changes on user behaviour
Synthesize information from diverse sources. Integrate and analyze data from user feedback, surveys, operational metrics, and event logs to connect insights directly to business outcomes
Regularly reporting outcomes and insights to stakeholders across Relay, including the senior leadership team, providing a clear narrative of the impact on business objectives, thereby influencing future data-driven decision-making


Who You Are


You have 2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in another data-focused role
You are fluent in SQL, including writing complex queries, working with window functions, optimizing performance, and understanding data warehousing concepts and security best practices. You're able to clearly explain your approach and reasoning, not just produce a working query
You have experience using business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Metabase, Sigma, Periscope, Mode, or similar platforms
You have a track record of using data to influence business decisions. You enjoy turning complex analyses into clear, actionable insights that drive meaningful outcomes.
You start with the business problem before jumping into the data, asking thoughtful questions to understand the context and objectives
You have experience working with large datasets, from exploration and analysis through to delivering insights. You're comfortable working independently while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
You communicate clearly, build strong relationships with stakeholders, and enjoy collaborating across multiple teams
You thrive in ambiguity and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment where priorities, processes, and data infrastructure continue to evolve


Bonus Points


Experience with cloud computing (AWS, GCP or Azure) and familiarity with cloud data warehouse platforms (Bigquery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
Familiarity with dbt for data modelling, automation, or experimentation
Experience with a data-oriented programming language (Python, R)
You’ve joined a company at its early stages and have seen it through scale


The Interview Process


Stage 1: A 45-minute Google Meet video call with a member of the Talent Team
Stage 2: A 60-minute Google Meet video call with the Hiring Manager
Stage 3: A take-home case study, followed by a 60-minute Google Meet video call with members of our Data team.
Stage 4: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of our Leadership team


Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.

The annual salary range for this role is $99,000 CAD to $121,000 CAD.

For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $110,000 CAD. Offers below this point reflect candidates we believe can grow into the full scope of the role with support and development. Offers above this point reflect impact that meaningfully exceeds the role’s defined expectations or an expanded scope from day one.

We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub.

Why Relay Might Be the Perfect Fit For You


You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.
You crave autonomy: We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’re someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.
You own your work: You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
You build with AI, not just use it: You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.
You care about impact, not noise: You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself.
You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity: You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.
You seek out feedback: You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.
Small businesses are why we're here: Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.


Join Us

We're looking for people who are relentless, curious, and care deeply about the work. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description -- your perspective and drive matter more. We welcome diverse backgrounds and people who think critically, challenge the status quo, and want to help small businesses thrive.

Title: Customer Data Consultant
Description:
Axonify is the AI-Powered Frontline Enablement Platform that helps organizations close the gap between learning and execution. By unifying learning, execution and insights capabilities, Axonify drives real business impacts for the world's largest frontline organizations across retail, grocery, healthcare, and financial services.

More than 4 million employees across 160+ countries rely on Axonify today. It's an exciting time to join as we transform the company and build what's next.

We're a team that thinks deeply, moves with intention, and embraces new ideas. We learn quickly, keep a sharp focus on real-world impact, and take meaningful action to drive progress. And we do it as one team, with openness, creativity, and a shared drive to keep pushing what's possible.

The Role

The Customer Data Consultant is a key member of Axonify's Customer Solutions team, serving as the primary resource for customers looking to unlock the full value of their Axonify data. You'll partner directly with customers to answer complex business questions, lead analytical engagements, deliver executive-ready insights, and build scalable solutions that help customers maximize the impact of their frontline programs.

This role blends customer consulting, data analytics, technical problem solving, and business storytelling. You'll lead everything from custom data requests and Business Value Analyses to enterprise API integration consulting, while helping build the tools, frameworks, and best practices that scale how data is delivered across our customer base.

What You’ll Build

Customer Data Discovery & Custom Data Requests


Partner with customers to understand their business questions and data needs through structured discovery conversations.
Scope, prioritize, and execute Custom Data Requests by translating ambiguous business questions into clear, actionable analytical deliverables.
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer data requests, from intake and scoping through delivery and stakeholder presentations.
Build and maintain reusable queries, templates, and frameworks that accelerate delivery across common customer data scenarios.


Business Value Analysis


Lead the Business Value Analysis (BVA) process end-to-end—from data gathering and statistical analysis to executive-ready storytelling that quantifies program ROI.
Connect Axonify program outcomes to measurable business impact, including reduced turnover, improved compliance, and increased sales performance.
Develop scalable Business Value Analysis methodologies and analytical standards that can be consistently applied across the customer portfolio.
Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to identify Business Value Analysis opportunities throughout the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, Quarterly Business Reviews, renewals, and expansions.


In-Life API Solutions & Integrations


Lead the technical onboarding and integration of enterprise customers, guiding them from API discovery through successful production launch.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customer development teams, troubleshooting API integrations, authentication issues, and payload mismatches.
Architect customized API solutions that align customer workflows with Axonify's product capabilities while supporting long-term scalability.


Internal Tools & Scalable Data Infrastructure


Design and build internal tools and automations that streamline data workflows, reduce manual effort, and enable scalable delivery of customer insights.
Develop scalable content auditing and data subscription capabilities that ensure consistent, high-quality customer outputs.
Establish best practices and documentation for repeatable customer reporting solutions.
Partner with Product to identify platform capability gaps and influence future productized data solutions.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Collaborate with Marketing to identify analytics opportunities that strengthen customer campaigns.
Support pre-sales and renewal conversations with data-driven business case materials.
Ensure data initiatives align with customer objectives and Axonify data governance standards.
Mentor Data Analysts by providing technical guidance and sharing best practices in data consulting and analysis.


What You’ll Bring


Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Business Analysis, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, systems analysis, or business analysis, ideally within a SaaS environment.
Proven ability to conduct customer-facing discovery conversations and translate business questions into analytical scopes.
Strong proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing relational databases or data warehouses.
Proficiency in Python or R with practical experience applying statistical methods to business problems.
Expertise with analytics and reporting tools, particularly Power BI.
Experience building Business Value Analyses and ROI models that connect program data to executive-level business outcomes.
Experience building internal tools or automation solutions that improve operational efficiency.
Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with Google AppScript is considered a strong asset.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear strategic insights for non-technical stakeholders.
A strong consulting mindset with experience managing multiple customer engagements simultaneously.


Work Location

This role is open to candidates who are located in, and authorized to work in, Canada.

For our hybrid employees, we embrace a hybrid-flexible work environment. Most days, you choose the location that best supports your work—your home office or our Waterloo or Toronto offices. On Wednesdays, Axonifers within commuting distance come together for Work from Work Wednesdays—a day designed for collaboration, connection, and meaningful in-person moments.

Whether you are working remotely or in a hybrid environment at Axonify, you will have the tools, resources, and support you need to succeed.

What You'll Love About Axonify

We offer a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and overall success. Here's what you can expect:

Competitive Compensation: The estimated base salary range for this role is:


$103,000 - $128,000 - $153,000 CAD for candidates based in Canada.


This range reflects growth from building capability in the role to fully excelling over time, with most new hires joining near the midpoint. Actual salaries may vary within the range, or above or below it, based on factors such as experience, skills, location, and business needs.

Comprehensive Health Benefits: Health benefits from day one to support your overall wellbeing.

Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation, 7 Life Care Days, and a flexible holiday program to choose the religious, spiritual, and cultural holidays that matter most to you.

Wellbeing Support: Wellness Spending Account to support whatever wellbeing looks like for you.

Home Workspace Set-Up: Home Office Spending Account so your workspace works for you.

Family & Future Support: Parental top-up, New Parent Days, and matched retirement savings for a secure future.

Growth & Learning: Professional Development Budget to learn new skills and grow your craft.

Community Impact: Paid Volunteer Time to give back to the causes that matter to you.

In-Office Connection: Tasty Tuesdays in the office every other week because good food brings people together.

AI at Axonify

We believe AI should help people do their best work, not replace the human judgment, creativity, and connection that make us who we are. AI is a tool we use to learn fast, elevate our craft, and focus on the work that truly creates impact. That shows up in our hiring process too.

We use AI-assisted tools to create a smoother, more organized, and ultimately more human candidate experience. These tools allow our team to spend more time on real conversations and thoughtful decision-making—the things that matter.

What AI doesn't do at Axonify is make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people, using real judgment and grounded in our values.

Here's What That Means For You As a Candidate


Feel free to use AI to support your thinking—not replace it. We use AI to learn and level up, and you can too.
Be open about how you use AI if asked. Transparency helps us understand your process and how you approach problem-solving.
Stay authentic. We're hiring people, not prompts. Your ideas, your experiences, and your voice are what matter.


Diversity & Accessibility

We believe our team's unique experiences, backgrounds, cultures, beliefs, and abilities add richness to our culture and depth to our ideas. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates an environment that supports, empowers, and delivers a sense of belonging for all team members.

We want to remove any barriers that may limit you from joining Axonify. Email accessibility@axonify.com to let us know how we can support you with reasonable accommodations throughout the candidate journey.

What's Next?

Apply. Our Talent Acquisition team is committed to providing an outstanding experience throughout your journey with us.

Learn more about Axonify at www.axonify.com/careers.

The Compliance Analyst supports the Compliance team by analyzing purchasing and operational data to identify compliance gaps and business opportunities. It requires strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and clear communication of findings. A practical understanding of food products and foodservice operations is important to ensure recommendations are relevant and actionable.

Now, If You Were To Come On Board As One Of Our Compliance Analysts, We’d Ask You To Do The Following For Us


Analyze purchasing and operational data to identify trends, compliance gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Conduct recurring and ad hoc analyses to support compliance initiatives and business needs.
Quantify financial and operational impacts of identified opportunities and provide supporting analysis.
Prepare summaries, reports, and presentations for internal reviews and stakeholder discussions.
Support coordination of follow-up actions by communicating with internal teams and external partners as required, including scheduling meetings and tracking outcomes.
Assist in facilitating discussions by organizing information, preparing materials, and documenting decisions and action items.
Maintain and update dashboards, trackers, and supporting data tools to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Support operational processes related to product and item changes to ensure alignment with business requirements.
Provide analytical support for special projects and other departmental priorities as needed.


Role

Think you have what it takes to be our Compliance Analyst? We’re committed to hiring the best talent for the role. Here’s how we’ll know you’ll be successful in the role:


Post-secondary degree or diploma in Business, Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, Finance, Food Service, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Five (5) years of experience in Supply Chain Management, Food Service, and/or Data Analytics.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to interpret data and generate practical recommendations.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Power BI or similar tools is an asset.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to structure information clearly in emails, reports, and presentations.
Comfortable coordinating meetings and following up with multiple stakeholders.
Basic understanding of food products and foodservice operations is an asset.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work independently while following structured processes and guidance.


What’s in it for you?


Join an award-winning culture. We have been recognized for being a Great Place to Work, in addition to being selected as a FORTUNE Global 500 Company, Best Workplaces Retail & Hospitality, and FORTUNE World’s Most Admired Companies.

A Focus on Mental Health and Wellness. Our Mental Health and Well-Being initiative was created to share credible resources with our associates and the communities we serve on a variety of topics, including mental, physical, spiritual, and financial wellbeing. We also have an Employment Assistance Program which provides our associates with access to 24/7 support, resources, and information.
We are as diverse as our guests. We believe diverse and inclusive environments support innovation and collaboration, and benefit our associates, clients, and customers. We are committed to Listen, Learn, and Act and our Diversity Inclusion Action Councils (DIAC) are associate led groups that seek to foster inclusion through cultural awareness, engagement and appreciation of diversity. We are Stronger, Together!


Compass Group Canada is committed to nurturing a diverse workforce representative of the communities within which we operate. Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics***Analyste de données, Analytique RH
Description:
IPEX is one of North America’s leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy.

We currently have an exciting opportunity as a Data Analyst, People Analytics. This role is based in Montreal or Oakville and reports to the Lead, People Analytics.

Do not miss the opportunity to join a diverse group of people-centric professionals, thought leaders and rapid thinkers, entrepreneurs in spirit and status quo-fighters!

Job Summary

As the Data Analyst, People Analytics, you will help IPEX deliver accurate, meaningful workforce insights that support stronger HR and business decisions. You will be a key partner in managing reporting requests, maintaining data quality, improving reporting processes, and helping stakeholders understand what the data is telling them.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structure, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. You will join a People Analytics team that is evolving its reporting practices, strengthening governance, and finding smarter ways to reduce manual work. If you enjoy working with HR data, asking thoughtful questions, and improving how reporting gets done, this role offers the opportunity to make a practical and visible impact.

Principal Responsibilities

Workforce Reporting & Analytics


Help strengthen HR and business decision-making by delivering accurate, timely, and meaningful workforce reporting across recurring cycles and ad hoc requests.
Bring clarity to workforce trends by analyzing metrics such as headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational changes.
Turn reporting needs into practical insights by clarifying business questions and shaping outputs that are useful, relevant, and easy for stakeholders to apply.


Reporting Governance & Data Integrity


Contribute to a trusted people data environment by supporting consistent metric definitions, reporting standards, documentation, and governance practices.
Improve confidence in workforce reporting by validating and reconciling data from multiple sources, investigating discrepancies, and supporting quality checks and data integrity reviews.
Help ensure sensitive HR information is handled with accuracy, consistency, confidentiality, and appropriate governance.


Reporting Operations, Automation & Process Improvement


Support a more efficient People Analytics function by maintaining and improving recurring reporting tools, templates, and reporting packages.
Reduce manual effort and improve scalability by applying advanced Excel, Power Query, and automation techniques to recurring reporting activities.
Contribute to ongoing process improvement by identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, simplify reporting processes, and support smaller HR technology or Dayforce-related initiatives where applicable.


Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting Support


Build effective partnerships with HR and business stakeholders by helping clarify reporting needs, priorities, timelines, and appropriate reporting solutions.
Promote stronger data literacy by guiding stakeholders on available reports, metric definitions, governance practices, and appropriate use of workforce data.
Support better reporting discipline by constructively challenging unclear, duplicative, or misaligned requests while communicating findings in a clear and practical way.


Qualifications & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, HR Reporting, HRIS Reporting, Workforce Planning Analytics, or a related analytical role.
Experience delivering recurring and ad hoc workforce reporting, including requirements gathering, data validation, reporting governance, and stakeholder support.
Strong knowledge of HR metrics and workforce data, including headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational information.
Advanced Excel skills, with experience using formulas, pivot tables, reporting templates, data validation, and large datasets.
Experience using Power Query or similar tools to transform data, consolidate sources, and improve reporting efficiency.
Experience with HR systems such as Dayforce, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or similar platforms, and with maintaining or troubleshooting Power BI reports or dashboards.
Strong attention to detail, communication skills, and ability to work independently while managing competing priorities and supporting technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with SQL, Power Automate, Dayforce reporting, workforce planning analytics, reporting automation, or data analytics/visualization certifications is considered an asset.


The compensation for this position is between $70,800.00 and $ 88,500.00 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

IPEX is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process and, upon request, will work with qualified job applicants to provide suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability. Accommodation requests are available to candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process for IPEX jobs. To request an accommodation, please contact HR at askhr@ipexna.com.

Description:
Join one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies and be part of something extraordinary – welcome to goeasy! We’re also honoured to be named a Greater Toronto Top Employer and recognized by Great Place to Work® as having the Best Workplaces for Women & Most Trusted Executive Teams, and included on TIME Magazine’s 2025 list of Canada’s Best Companies.  These honours reflect our commitment to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where talent thrives and innovation drives us forward.

As one of Canada’s leading alternative consumer lenders, we’re passionate about helping everyday Canadians create a brighter future. Our vision is to provide a path to a better tomorrow, today. We are seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer, a technical role within the Business Intelligence Operational Reporting team, for a highly motivated and experienced BI professional. You will contribute to all aspects of advanced analytics by scoping, analyzing, developing, automating, enhancing, and validating BI reporting, analytics, and dashboard solutions – delivered both creatively and efficiently.

What will you be doing?


Perform detailed data analysis, validation, report testing to identify data quality and reporting issues.
Monitor report events and subscriptions following EDW data load completion.
Manage report user access and privileges.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to capture and validate reporting requirements.
Analyze business needs and design, develop, and implement BI solutions to meet those needs.
Translate business requirements into details technical specifications for BI/report developers.
Contribute to the development of data marts, reports, and dashboards on the Business Insights platform powered by MicroStrategy.
Communicate progress, milestones, challenges, and escalate issues as needed.
Develop deep knowledge of goeasy’s data by integrating diverse datasets, identifying key KPIs, and delivering insights to support business decisions.
Create ad-hoc queries and reports and provide ongoing analytical support.
Support self-service reporting and resolve data/reporting issued promptly to maintain a stable BI environment.
Work closely with BI and Data Solutions Architects, as well as Data and BI Engineers, to ensure adherence to development and deployment standards.


What experience do you have?


Minimum 3 years of hands-on business reporting experience.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Computer Engineering, or a related IT field (preferred).
At least 3 years of experience with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Power BI, or Tableau.
Minimum 2 years of experience with SQL Server or similar relational database systems.
Proven experience developing reports using documents, grids, graphs, and dashboards in BI environments.
Intermediate SQL skills for building, debugging, and optimizing queries.
Strong technical aptitude and analytical thinking.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to identify and utilize the right data to address business problems.
Strong team player with the ability to collaborate across functions.
Inquisitive, detail-oriented, and capable of multitasking in a fast-paced environment.
Self-starter with a proactive mindset and a commitment to delivering results.

Validate, analyse, and reconcile large and complex datasets to identify data quality issues and inconsistencies.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues.

A collaborative, proactive approach with a positive, can-do attitude.

Experience using SQL or other data querying tools.

Experience supporting technology transformation or data migration initiatives.
Familiarity with Agile delivery environments.

Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.
Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

Title: Logistics Analyst
Description:
Charger logistics Inc. is a world- class asset-based carrier with locations across North America. With over 20 years of experience providing the best logistics solutions, Charger logistics has transformed into a world-class transport provider and continue to grow.

We are seeking an individual with excellent communication and leadership skills to join the company. Charger logistics invests time and support into its employees to provide them with the room to learn and grow their expertise and work their way up. We are entrepreneurial-minded organization that welcomes and support individual idea and strategies.

We are looking for a data-driven Logistics Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical skills with industry knowledge to drive continuous improvement in our damage mitigation programs.

Responsibilities:

Support Sales, Operations, and Customer Service teams with competitive pricing, in-depth performance analysis, and data-driven insights
Perform costing analysis and develop multi-scenario pricing options to support customer negotiations
Assist in building and evaluating pricing strategies; analyze volume, profit potential, and market trends
Monitor customer performance across volume, revenue, and margin; identify gaps and inconsistencies
Respond to pricing inquiries and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner
Write SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from internal operational databases
Build custom reports and analytics dashboards using Tableau and other BI tools; present findings to leadership
Ensure accurate, clean reporting flows directly to leadership and upper management
Organize and maintain internal and external databases to support decision-making
Generate monthly and quarterly damage analysis reports and performance summaries for senior management
Conduct thorough investigations of equipment damage incidents — tractors, trailers, and cargo handling equipment
Analyze damage patterns and root causes; prepare detailed reports with photographic documentation and cost assessments
Review and process damage claims from initial report through full resolution
Coordinate with insurance carriers, repair vendors, and legal teams on complex claims
Negotiate settlements and manage vendor relationships for cost-effective repairs
Maintain accurate claims databases and tracking systems
Identify high-risk routes, facilities, and operational scenarios through trend analysis
Develop and maintain SOPs to reduce costs and improve operational efficiency
Create and implement driver training programs focused on damage prevention
Work with safety teams to establish best practices; conduct cost-benefit analyses for prevention initiatives
Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams


Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Supply Chain, Statistics, Engineering, or related field.
3+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, or insurance industries is an asset.
Strong analytical skills is preferred.
Experience with claims management systems and processes.
Knowledge of commercial vehicle operations and equipment types.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in trucking, freight, or transportation industry.
Professional certifications in risk management or claims analysis.
Familiarity with DOT regulations and commercial vehicle safety standards.
Background in fleet management or equipment maintenance.

Competitive Salary

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Our Ontario client is looking for a Data Analyst to help transform field data into meaningful insights that improve decision-making.

This is a full-time perm position. 5 days/week onsite in Newmarket, ON. You will be getting paid hourly. Overtime (Remote) will be expected and compensated.

Reporting to the Lead Data Analyst, you will be responsible for managing data generated through their proprietary mobile applications, ensuring data quality, developing analytics and reporting tools, and supporting continuous improvements to their data environment.

Responsibilities


Manage, validate, and analyze data collected through the proprietary field reporting platform.
Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for both internal teams and utility clients.
Perform quality assurance on incoming datasets and investigate data inconsistencies or anomalies.
Utilize strong analytical analysis, using excel and other methods (excel capabilities are a requirement).
Maintain and optimize reporting databases, data sources, security, and metadata.
Troubleshoot reporting issues and implement improvements to enhance data quality and reporting performance.
Develop and automate data cleansing, validation, and reporting processes.
Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and clients to understand reporting requirements and implement data solutions.
Prepare data extracts and support integrations with external systems, including GIS and enterprise databases.
Train internal staff and clients on reporting tools and dashboard functionality.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to automate manual processes and improve reporting efficiency.


Must Have


Experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas (e.g., XLOOKUP, TEXTJOIN, COUNTIFS), PivotTables, and VBA.
Experience with SQL and database querying.


Nice To Have


Experience with Python, R, Power BI, or other data analysis and visualization tools
Familiarity with SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments

Title: Transportation Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description




Position: Transportation Data Analyst

Type: Full-Time | Hybrid

Location: Brampton, ON

Reports to: Senior Manager, Inbound Transportation




About Us

Pet Valu is Canada’s leading pet specialty retailer, dedicated to strengthening the bond between dedicated pet lovers and their pets. With 50 years of animal care expertise, we operate over 800 stores across Canada under several banners, including Pet Valu, Bosley’s, Total Pet, Paulmac's Pet, Tisol & Chico. Guided by our mission to deliver products, care, expertise, and memorable moments, Pet Valu is a place where people build meaningful careers while making a positive impact on pets and communities.




What will you do?

Pet Valu’s supply chain has grown significantly as the company has expanded, supported by a $100M investment in supply chain technology and facilities. As part of this investment, Pet Valu launched Manhattan Active Transportation Management to improve network planning, centralize transportation data, and strengthen reporting and operational visibility. Description:
Who We Are

Thank you for your interest in Mueller Water Products, Inc.

For more than 165 years, Mueller Water Products, Inc. has been building the future of water infrastructure. From lifesaving fire protection to data intelligence, we are committed to developing products and solutions that help cities and utilities deliver clean, safe drinking water to hundreds of millions of people across North America.

Our purpose is to connect communities to water, life’s most essential resource, with exceptional, people solutions and products. Behind that purpose is a dedicated team, united by our shared values of respect, integrity, trust, inclusion and safety. With a vision to be the leader in water infrastructure solutions—solving challenges, enriching lives and safeguarding the future—we are making a positive impact that will last for generations.

By joining Mueller, you become part of a dynamic team dedicated to excellence and innovation, working collaboratively to achieve meaningful results. We champion our people because when they succeed, our communities thrive. We invite you to learn more about career opportunities with us and consider submitting your application.

Vacancy Disclosure

This posting is for an existing vacancy within our organization that we are actively seeking to fill. Data Analyst

We are currently searching for a full-time Data Analyst to join our team based in Toronto, Ontario.

As a Data Analyst you will be responsible for collecting, processing and analyzing data from an industry leading Internet of Things (IoT) leak detection system and providing actionable insights to water utilities.

Key Responsibilities


Manage key client sites using the EchoShore product line: an industry leading Internet of Things (IoT) leak detection system. Perform acoustic analysis and large-scale data processing for leak detection and pipe condition assessment and provide reports to water utilities (customers) to help them manage their water distribution networks.
Communicate the status of data analysis to Project Managers. Identify data anomalies and significant variances and flag them to senior staff.
Assisting with the development of automatic software tools to improve productivity and efficiency of data analysis process. You will work closely with various departments (IT, software, sales) to implement these tools, understand their data needs and provide data-driven insights.
Analyze data and work with Senior Data Analysts and Software Engineers to adjust analysis software for best outcomes including defining acceptance criteria
Develop processes and procedures for accurate and efficient data analysis
Monitor process performance through KPIs and strive for continuous improvement and further development of the leak detection center
Prepare and update Standard Operating Procedure documents as required
Build and maintain relationships with external leak detection customers
Prepare and distribute reports to external customers regarding their leak assessment results
Work in compliance with the MWP Code of conduct and all Environmental, Health and Safety policies, procedures and regulations


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields such as Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Previous experience in data analytics
Strong analytical skills, including data mining and statistical analysis
Proficiency in data analysis tools and software (e.g., SQL, Excel, R, Python). The ability to perform large scale data frame processing using Pandas and NumPy is a plus.
Database skills: good command of SQL queries. Understand database technologies: relational database (RDBMS), NoSQL, document-oriented, etc.
Good command of numerical methods and associated tools: Scipy, Matlab, Octave, or other.
Personal skills: creative, perseverant, detail-oriented, self-starter.
Well developed communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present analysis results and data insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Online asynchronous communication is required.
Critical Competencies: technical learning, time management, problem solving.


Position Assets


Experience with acoustic, seismic, and vibration analysis is a plus.
Knowledge of signal processing techniques and time-series analysis to identify anomalies, trends and other data patterns.
Experience with GIS processing software such as ArcGIS, Geocortex, DMTI Spatial
Design and implement instrumentation for data collection and analysis.
Conduct experiments to test hypotheses and validate data models.
Analyze experimental results and provide actionable insights.
Working experience in an Agile environment. Familiar with issue and bug tracking using JIRA
Familiar with Data Visualization tools such as Matplotlib, Plotly, etc


Mueller is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities. Accommodation is available, upon request, for candidates participating in the recruitment process.

Salary/Pay Range

$57,433.00-$78,970.00 CAD

The compensation range above reflects a good-faith estimate of starting base pay for full-time (40 hours per week) employment as of the date of posting. Individual compensation may vary depending on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, the role, professional experience, job-related skills, achievements, and/or work location. The range listed is only one component of the total compensation package offered to candidates.

Other Compensation & Benefits

Mueller offers a competitive salary and benefits package. Current benefit offerings include: medical, dental, and vision insurance; retirement plan with 5% company match; Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP); short-term and long-term disability benefits; paid time off; Pregnancy & Parental Leave Top Up; tuition reimbursement; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and more.

Accommodation

If you require accommodations during any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know. We are happy to work with you to meet your needs.

Mueller collects and maintains resumes for a period of 3 years for consideration of future opportunities.

SOCAN is a not-for-profit copyright collective dedicated to ensuring music creators and publishers receive what they have rightfully earned for the use of their work. Through licensing, global royalty collection and advocacy, we help creators to keep making the music that entertains, moves, and inspires us

Learn more about SOCAN’s commitment to Inclusion & Anti-Racism.  

WHY WORK WITH US?


Make a difference by supporting and collaborating with a vibrant and creative community
Enjoy many options for workplace flexibility and work-life balance
Get involved in the rapidly changing creative space
Advocate for and empower the creative community
Together, we’ll help music creators earn more income and make a living


What We Offer


35-hour workweek schedule (possible flexible work options i.e., 4-day work week (position based)
Twelve paid sick days annually (including five personal days)
Access to SOCAN fitness facility
Annual Performance Incentive bonus (dependent on a personal and company performance)
Defined contribution Pension Plan
Comprehensive, health and dental benefits program
Inclusive and collaborative working environment 


About The Role

SOCAN is seeking a Data Analyst to join our Analytics department. In this role, you’ll be accountable for turning raw data into actionable business insights through various reports and dashboards, driving improvement in our key organizational initiatives. You must be comfortable working closely with data engineers, BI analysts, and business leaders. The ideal candidate has a solid grasp of data fundamentals and is eager, curious, and possesses a drive for continuous learning and self-improvement, especially with modern cloud data stacks.

The knowledge of English is required for this position as the position requires to interact on a constant and regular basis with English-speaking stakeholders outside of Quebec

What You’ll Do / Key Responsibilities


Work directly with data engineers, BI analysts, other data analysts, and business leaders to document reporting requirements and understand business processes and how they affect data.
Perform exploratory data analysis to clean, transform, and analyze large datasets within Databricks to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities to improve our data.
Support data quality assurance by creating data quality tests and plans for various reporting and Lakehouse projects that can assist in troubleshooting data discrepancies and pipeline issues.
Work with each department leader to define and document KPIs.
Perform root-cause analysis on KPI fluctuations to provide actionable insights to department leaders.
Collaborate on the continuous development of interactive Databricks AI/BI dashboards and reports, designing and maintaining clear dashboards to communicate findings to various stakeholders.
Curate and document semantic layers to power natural language querying (Genie) for business users.
Participate in, and contribute towards daily standup meetings, project planning sessions, and retrospectives.
Manage, prioritize, and respond to ad hoc requests for data analysis.


Required

WHAT YOU WILL BRING / QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE


Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to work on large data sets, while keeping the big picture in mind.
Strong SQL skills and intermediate Python. An understanding of Spark and distributed compute environments.
Experience and proficiency performing data analysis using Databricks or similar technologies (2+ years).
Strong communicator, with the ability to tackle loosely defined problems with a solution oriented mindset.
Business writing skills as well as the ability to create technical documentation, communicating clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Stats, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent experience.


Nice To Have


Passion & love for music.
Fluency in French


COMPETENCIES


Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
Emotionally intelligent
Commitment to Continuous Learning
Process Oriented

How To Apply

If you’re interested in joining us, we’d love to hear from you: http://www.socan.com/careers/

Find Your Limitless with Reliance

By joining Reliance as a Billing Analyst, you’ll become an important Team Member and will be provided with the tools you need to succeed. We have ambitious growth plans and are looking for Team Members who want to grow with us. At Reliance, we pride ourselves on the fact that we provide limitless opportunities for growth and we encourage it by rewarding our Team Members for their success in many ways. If you’re ready to find your limitless – join us!

What do we offer?


The tools you need to succeed – including the tools for the job as well as training and development programs
A successful and knowledgeable team to be part of and learn from
Competitive base pay plus the ability to earn more tied to your success – the only limit is your potential
A great benefits plan for you / your family
Career paths so you can advance in the company
Awarded Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures with a proudly diverse and inclusive team


What will you do?


Become a key resource for the business, develop an understanding of the applications impacting customers, billing & payments, customer communications, etc.
Proactively analyze key trends, identify data integrity issues, risks and opportunities, and support delivery against financial and operational targets
Partner with the business to identify and monitor KPI’s, gather and format data into regular and ad-hoc reports and dashboards
Provide value-add analysis to drive performance
Support and analyze various aspects of the billing/payments lifecycle including reporting, auditing and updates to processes
Develop process flows and end to end functional designs
Builds effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Identify opportunities to improve processes and systems, support implementation of best practices, and drive continuous improvements
Drive / Support projects and initiatives as assigned


What do you bring?


Completion of a post-secondary degree/diploma in a related field
2+ years of experience working in an analysis and business support capacity
Expertise with Microsoft suite (Excel, Power BI, Power Point, SQL – preferred)
Experience with billing applications, SAP S/4HANA is an asset
Self-starter and strong team player, with a sense of urgency and a demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Analytical thinker, action-taker, resilient and resourceful with a keen attention to detail and results focused
Comfortable with data, strong competency in driving analysis & building and maintaining models
Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written
Exemplifies behavior that is consistent with Reliance culture, values and leadership practices


Why Reliance?

As a leader in home services and energy efficient solutions for over 60 years, Reliance Home Comfort® (Reliance) is committed to being the Destination of Choice by delivering exceptional experiences for customers seeking comfort and team members seeking a rewarding, inclusive workplace. For more information, please visit www.reliancehomecomfort.com.

Title: Data Analyst, Business Intelligence
Description:
About Float

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth.

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025, 2024 and 2023, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

Our Product

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 7,500 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.

AI Use in Our Hiring Process

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

About The Role

Float runs on data — and this role exists to make sure the business can see itself clearly.

As our Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, you'll be the connective tissue between our data infrastructure and the decisions that leadership, Finance, RevOps, and GTM teams make every day. This isn't a support queue role — it's a strategic BI function. You'll own our reporting layer: designing, building, and governing the dashboards, metrics, and self-serve tools that let Float's teams move faster and with more confidence.

You'll sit on the data team and work in close partnership with our Analytics Engineer, translating business questions into durable data products — not one-off answers. Where the analytics engineer builds the models and the pipelines, you build the intelligence layer on top: the dashboards, the metrics definitions, the reporting cadences, and the frameworks that turn clean data into business clarity.

You're also someone who is curious and treats AI as a genuine part of how you work — using it to move faster, build more, and stretch the bounds of what a data team can actually do.

You'll report to the Head of Data and partner closely with Finance, RevOps, GTM, Sales, and the Chief of Staff.

What You'll Be Doing


Design, build, and maintain Float's core dashboards and reporting infrastructure — audit for quality, assign ownership, archive stale content, and set the standard for what good looks like
Work closely with the Analytics Engineer to translate business requirements into data models — write clear specs, validate outputs, and drive metric definition alignment across stakeholders before anything gets built
Use AI as a force multiplier — not just for drafting SQL, but for building self-serve tooling, scaling analysis and making BI more accessible to non-technical stakeholders. You bring the business context that makes AI outputs actually useful, and you know where the guardrails need to go.
Define and maintain Float's authoritative metrics library — what they measure, how they're calculated, and who owns them; surface and resolve discrepancies when Finance and RevOps aren't working from the same number
Partner with the Chief of Staff and Head of Data on QBRs, board prep, and performance reporting; turn leadership questions into clean analysis, and run exploratory deep dives to answer specific questions
Build a self-serve BI environment that reduces dependence on the data team — verified dashboards, documented metrics, and Metabase collections that Finance, Ops, Support, and Sales can navigate without filing a ticket
Flag data model gaps and quality issues to the analytics engineer; help prioritize infrastructure work based on business impact


What Success Looks Like


Land and Stabilize: BI and metric governance has a clear DRI — existing dashboards have been audited for accuracy and relevance, every key metric and report has a named owner, and outdated content has been archived.
Build the Infrastructure: The BI environment is structured and trustworthy — dashboards are verified, collections are logically organized, and AI has been used to build or scale something the team couldn't have done with headcount alone.
Enable the Flywheel: Self-serve is meaningfully better and ad-hoc request volume reflects it. Leadership is making faster decisions because they have someone who understands both the data and the business context.


What We're Looking For


2–4+ years of experience as a BI or business analyst, ideally at a high-growth fintech or SaaS company
Strong SQL — CTEs, window functions, aggregations; you write clean queries and can explain them to a non-technical stakeholder
Deep experience in a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or Sigma) — you've owned a BI environment.
Comfortable reading dbt models and understanding data lineage; prior dbt experience is not necessary but ability to contribute to dbt project is expected
Comfortable using AI tools as an accelerator — LLMs for SQL drafting, documentation, or structuring analysis; you know where they're useful and where they need guardrails
Structured thinker who turns ambiguous questions into clear analytical frames — and doesn't wait to be handed one. You spot what's worth investigating and drive it yourself.
Strong written communication — your analysis only lands if the narrative does
Proactive and collaborative — you share context before being asked and work with the analytics engineer, not around them
Genuinely curious about the business, not just the data
Experience supporting a senior audiences is a strong plus
Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse is a plus
Python experience is a plus, particularly for automation or analysis outside of SQL


Our Hiring Philosophy

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.

Why You Should Join


Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies
Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role
Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team
Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits
Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration
Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office
Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters


In Short

At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.

We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Established in 1973, Roots is a proudly Canadian lifestyle brand that celebrates authenticity, quality, and community. Inspired by the great outdoors, we create timeless, sustainable apparel and leather goods designed for comfort and everyday adventure. At Roots, we believe in fostering a culture of inclusivity, creativity, and teamwork – where every team member plays a role in shaping our brand’s legacy. If you bring passion to everything you do, lead with integrity, and believe in the power of collaboration to drive growth, we’d love to have you on our journey!

Nature & Scope → Your Role at Roots

As an Analytics Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics, turning raw retail data into trusted, scalable assets and the insights that bring them to life. As a collaborative member of our data team, you'll contribute to the data models that power solutions across the Roots business and help build the data products, semantic layers, and self-service tools that empower every team at Roots to access trusted data independently. Our data team is small and collaborative, meaning you'll wear multiple hats and have broad exposure across the business.

Key Responsibilities → How You’ll Make An Impact


Support end-to-end data transformation, converting raw omnichannel source data (POS, e-commerce, inventory, CRM, and marketing) into clean, structured layers within Snowflake.
Contribute to the design and build of components of the Snowflake data mart, applying dimensional modelling best practices including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions, to help create reliable, performant data products that serve ad hoc analysis, BI dashboards, and AI data solutions.
Support Power BI report development end-to-end, from semantic model design to polished, publish-ready reports, giving commercial, merchandising, marketing, and finance teams self-service access to trusted data without analyst dependency.
Perform ad hoc analysis using SQL and Python directly in Snowflake to help answer pressing business questions, uncover trends, and deliver timely insights that inform planning, buying, and operational decisions.
Assist in maintaining data quality standards, including testing frameworks, pipeline alerting, and documentation, to help ensure the data mart is trustworthy and well-understood across the business.
Support the development and maintenance of Gen AI data solutions, including natural language interfaces enabling any business user to query the data mart in plain English.
Partner cross-functionally with merchandising, planning, marketing, and commercial teams to understand analytical needs and help translate them into scalable data products.
Participate in the continuous improvement of our data platform, contributing ideas around new tools, patterns, and AI capabilities that keep Roots ahead of the curve.


Qualifications & Experience → The Skills You Bring


3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or an equivalent data analytics role.
Strong SQL proficiency and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
Hands-on experience with ELT/ETL platforms, with Matillion or a similar cloud-native transformation tool preferred.
Proficiency building data models and dashboards with Power BI.
Solid understanding of dimensional modelling methodologies including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions.
Experience with version control using Git.
Familiarity with data quality practices including testing, documentation, and pipeline monitoring.
Exposure to Gen AI solutions such as Snowflake Cortex or Microsoft Fabric Copilot is preferred.
Retail or apparel industry experience across omnichannel environments is an asset.
Python proficiency for data transformation, ad hoc analysis, or automation is a plus.


At Roots we appreciate that skills and expertise are cultivated through a range of experiences. We are committed to reflecting Canada's diverse landscape in our products, team, and workplace culture. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. Accommodations are available for applicants throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Roots uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. These tools may be used to help review applications, assess qualifications, and support interview documentation. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by our Talent team and key leaders involved in the recruitment process.

The posted salary range is intended to reflect the competitive market value of this role and is provided to support transparency in our hiring process. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to internal equity, relevant skills, demonstrated knowledge, experience, and overall fit for the position.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Our Ontario client is looking for a Data Analyst to help transform field data into meaningful insights that improve decision-making.

This is a full-time perm position. 5 days/week onsite in Newmarket, ON. You will be getting paid hourly. Overtime (Remote) will be expected and compensated.

Reporting to the Lead Data Analyst, you will be responsible for managing data generated through their proprietary mobile applications, ensuring data quality, developing analytics and reporting tools, and supporting continuous improvements to their data environment.

Responsibilities


Manage, validate, and analyze data collected through the proprietary field reporting platform.
Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for both internal teams and utility clients.
Perform quality assurance on incoming datasets and investigate data inconsistencies or anomalies.
Utilize strong analytical analysis, using excel and other methods (excel capabilities are a requirement).
Maintain and optimize reporting databases, data sources, security, and metadata.
Troubleshoot reporting issues and implement improvements to enhance data quality and reporting performance.
Develop and automate data cleansing, validation, and reporting processes.
Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and clients to understand reporting requirements and implement data solutions.
Prepare data extracts and support integrations with external systems, including GIS and enterprise databases.
Train internal staff and clients on reporting tools and dashboard functionality.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to automate manual processes and improve reporting efficiency.


Must Have


Experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas (e.g., XLOOKUP, TEXTJOIN, COUNTIFS), PivotTables, and VBA.
Experience with SQL and database querying.


Nice To Have


Experience with Python, R, Power BI, or other data analysis and visualization tools
Familiarity with SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments
