ROBINSON’s reputation as a growing company with a customer-service oriented culture continues to attract and retain top quality people and has earned it Platinum status among Canada’s Best Managed Companies. ROBINSON is committed to a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We strive to foster an environment that values our differences and believe in giving back to the communities in which we live and work.




ROBINSON values your experience and recognizes the contributions you make to the success of our business. Your starting pay will be based on the skills and experience you bring to the role. Title: Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt
Description:
About QuadReal Property Group

QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships.

QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come.

QuadReal: Excellence lives here.

www.quadreal.com

Role Description:

The Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt (12 month Contract) will report directly to the Director, Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with a background in Data Science or Data Analytics who is looking to develop their career in an entrepreneurial and high-energy environment. Embedded within the business, this role supports management reporting, forecasting, and portfolio analysis across the RE Debt portfolio, in addition to being the primary liaison to ED&A and IT — translating reporting requirements into data specifications and building data flows from the Enterprise Data Platform through to the reporting layer. This position also works closely with the Real Estate Debt Investment, Accounting, and Operations teams, FP&A, and Portfolio Management teams across QuadReal.

Role Description:


Support scenario modelling, cash flow forecasting, leverage and liquidity analysis through Anaplan, supplemented by ad-hoc financial models as needed, using AI-assisted development for efficiency and quality control
Analyze portfolio exposures, return attribution, and market trends, and support the development of presentation materials with AIenhanced insights and visualization
Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly and ad hoc management reports for senior management, Board of Directors and BCI
Support real estate debt investment underwriting by providing portfolio impact analysis
Assist with ad hoc research projects for benchmarking, peer analysis, risk analysis, and other relevant topics
Query and extract data from enterprise data platforms to support portfolio reporting and analytics needs

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Compliance
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About The Role

The Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance, is a high-performing individual contributor within the broader analytics team. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between compliance business and technology by translating requirements into well-defined and concrete data products. You will own the "Requirement-to-Reporting" lifecycle, ensuring business requirements are robust and detailed and data engineers build the right foundations, balancing data governance with business flexibility, and delivering the final data products with reliability, predictability, and accuracy.

The Lifecycle You Will Own:


Discovery: Understanding the "Why" behind the business request.
Mapping: Identifying the "Where" (data sources) and the "Gaps."
Specs: Writing the "How" for the Data Engineers.
Validation: Testing the "Truth" of the data through UAT.
Delivery: Visualizing the "So What" for stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Strategic Translation: Partner with compliance leaders and stakeholders to understand objectives and translate them into Remitly business language and further translate them into detailed functional/technical specifications.
Metric Definition: Lead the definition of North Star metrics and KPIs, ensuring alignment across different departments to prevent "data silos" or conflicting definitions.
Documentation: Own the creation of source-to-target mappings, logic flowcharts, and business requirement documents (BRDs).
Data Scouting: Identify internal and external data sources required to fulfill business needs; perform exploratory data analysis to highlight data gaps or quality issues.
Engineering Partnership: Work hand-in-hand with Data Engineers to design scalable data pipelines, providing the necessary business logic and transformation rules.
Validation & UAT: Lead the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process, rigorously validating transformation logic and data integrity before production deployment.
Solution Architecture: Design and build sophisticated reporting solutions (Tableau, PowerBI, or internal tools) that go beyond simple charts to tell a meaningful business story.
Data Consumption: Ensure data is delivered in a "business-consumable" form, prioritizing UX/UI in dashboards to drive high adoption rates among non-technical users.


Typical Qualifications


Experience: 4-8+ years in a Senior Analyst or Analytics Consultant role, specifically focused on the end-to-end delivery of data products.
Problem Solving: Mastery of First Principles Thinking—the ability to take a vague request like "we need to increase retention" and break it down into a structured data project involving specific schemas, logic, and metrics.
AI Readiness: Proficient in leveraging AI tools for rapid prototyping of SQL logic, automating documentation, and identifying opportunities where machine learning can enhance traditional business reporting.
Communication: Expert-level ability to navigate two worlds. You can discuss JOIN logic and latency with engineers in the morning and LTV or churn-reduction strategies with executives in the afternoon.
Programming: Expert in SQL, Python or R for data exploration, validation and analysis; Working experience with DBT or Git or similar.
BI Tools: Mastery of visualization and report / dashboard building, and performance optimization; demonstrated experience in building with Tableau, Mode, PowerBI (or similar).


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is typically $120,000 - $150,000 CAD. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits:


Flexible paid time off
Health, dental, and vision + 401k plan with company matching
Paid parental, medical, military and family care leave
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. For corporate team members, we have an in-office expectation of at least 50% of the time monthly, typically achieved by coming in three days a week. This creates a consistent, meaningful overlap that supports team norms and business needs. Managers also have the flexibility to set higher expectations based on their team's specific needs. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Title: Senior Business Analytics & Insights
Description:
Marketing Statement

As the largest operating company in the integrated TransLink enterprise, Coast Mountain Bus Company (CMBC) operates a fleet of clean-fuel conventional and community shuttle buses, zero-emission trolley buses, and passenger ferry SeaBuses in Metro Vancouver, the largest single transit service area in Canada.

At CMBC, one of BC’s Top Employers, we're committed to providing an innovative, healthy, and engaging workforce. This is reflected in our workforce of over 5,500 employees performing over 400 unique jobs, who are committed and empowered to deliver service that attracts nearly 1.1 million passengers daily and connects people, businesses, and communities in the Metro Vancouver region.

We have the important job of helping our passengers get to work, appointments, visiting with family and friends, and back again every day. Metro Vancouver relies on us, and we take that as a point of pride.

Responsibilities

PRIMARY PURPOSE

Provides technical expertise to the development of a data governance framework for CMBC, including leading stakeholder engagement, developing, and monitoring progress of long-term roadmap, establishing requisite business processes, and ensuring the Data Warehouse, Business Intelligence and Analytic (DW/BI&A) solutions align with the established framework. Provides technical leadership and supervision on the design, development, and quality assurance of monthly dashboard reports to the Executive Management Team (EMT), to ensure timely and accurate delivery. Supports the Manager, Business Analytics & Insights with leading the annual Corporate Business Planning and Reporting process through stakeholder engagement with leaders from across the organization, ensuring alignment to Corporate and Enterprise-level strategic plans.

Key Accountabilities

Provides technical leadership on planning and implementation of DW/BI&A solutions. Designs, implements, and maintains customized data warehouse, business intelligence and analytics (DW/BI&A) technical solutions. Ensures DW/BI&A solutions function effectively and align with standards, policies and supports ongoing Data Governance Program within CMBC. Ensures solutions adhere to best practices and Enterprise standards.

Designs, implements, and maintains the Corporate Business Plan BI reporting solution, data collection process and KPI integration to ensure the alignment of planned annual works to strategic long-range workplans, Enterprise goals, as well as ties together corporate-level KPIs to the annual initiatives to ensure alignment to planned works and performance measures assessed.

Provides technical expertise in the development and sustainment of a data governance framework for CMBC, including standardized documentation. Leads stakeholder engagement and ensures the DW/BI&A solutions developed align with the governance framework established. Leads discussions with those identified as part of the governance framework within the organization and looks for alignment opportunities from across the Enterprise.

Stays abreast of new techniques, technologies, and industry trends, and participates in relevant industry events related to Data Governance. Leads the team towards modern practices and techniques; establishes and participates in design reviews, regular or ad-hoc data quality reviews ensuring data quality throughout the data pipeline.

Manages and develops projects of moderate to high impact, risk, and complexity. Designs and develops project scope, schedules, and work plans; defining and prioritizing deliverables; ensuring compliance with Enterprise standards, policies and procedures. Alerts management to critical issues and risks. Identifies and resolves project issues, including scheduling overruns, conflicting agendas, and technical issues.

Provides technical support to the maintenance of custom Extract Transform Load (ETL) solution, as well as continual assessment of metadata reporting to ensure data integrity and quality assurance.

Consults and collaborates with business and technology stakeholders on data management and data architecture strategies, governance, practices, and policies.

Supports the Executive Management Team by providing KPIs to report on monthly performance; leads requirements gathering, target setting, report design and delivery and documentation. Carries out analysis related to variances in corporate performance measures, recommending best practices to the Senior Management team for problem areas.

Prepares quarterly reports for the CMBC Board of Directors and TransLink Statutory Reporting requirements.

Provides support to the Manager in the development and maintenance of the Team’s Strategic Plan Roadmap, planning and decisions making. Provides input on the dependency and sequencing of projects as well as highlights any potential project or compliance risks to ensure project priorities align to annual objectives.

Participates in the development and implementation of a continuous improvement strategy by offering Business Process advisory services to other departments. Supports the delivery of better value and greater efficiency through the identification and elimination of unnecessary complexity within business processes and identification of better ways of working, applying Lean methodology.

Acts as a key liaison with International Benchmarking Groups to conduct detailed surveys and analysis. Determines international best practices related to specific Key Performance Indicators and completes analysis of moderate to high impact, recommending business changes with financial/budgetary impacts. Completes follow-up analysis to confirm impacts and ROI. Presents findings to Executive Team, and at conferences as requested by Executive leadership.

Develops business cases to support KPIs with strategic objectives and leverages available benchmarking resources for best practices; provides comparable performance measures from other transit systems and business enterprises to stakeholders towards informed decision making. Forecasts the implications of various alternatives to maximize the effectiveness of KPIs for organizational success.

Represents the Business Analytics & Insights Team on inter-departmental committees and as a technical input for larger scale capital projects as requested.

Provides technical support and guidance to other Analysts and supports Managers within the organization by connecting them to relevant data sources for their reporting needs, including developing custom SQL views of required data.

Qualifications

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

The requirements for this job are acquired through completion of a university degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or other relevant business-related fields plus seven (7) years of progressive experience in performance reporting functions in a multifaceted organization.

Other Requirements

Advanced knowledge of concepts, principles, practices and techniques pertaining to all aspects of performance measures, benchmarking, balanced scorecards and dashboards

Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Data Warehouse and BI technologies, both Cloud and on-prem (SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, Power BI Desktop, PowerBI Report Builder, PowerBI Service, Tableau etc.)

Strong knowledge of Microsoft PowerPlatform solutions including PowerApps, PowerAutomate and Power Platform Admin Centre.

Strong knowledge and understanding of the relevant concepts of data mining and data warehousing

Demonstrated ability to communicate the complexities of technical programs (e.g. Kimball methodology, modern data warehousing).

Advanced experience of data modeling and business process design software, such as Visio.

Advanced knowledge of coaching and mentoring teams on Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence Architect concepts and methodology.

Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills to handle conflict resolution, facilitating discussion and alternatives of different approaches.

Solid leadership skills with ability to manage and influence direct or indirect reporting staff, and to provide specialized guidance and expertise to all levels of the organization.

Excellent planning, organization, and time management skills with strong ability to organize competing priorities.

Experience maintaining ETL process using software such as SSIS

Prior experience in design, deployment, or sustainment of Data Governance Program

Advanced knowledge of concepts, principles, practices, and techniques pertaining to all aspects of performance measures, benchmarking, balanced scorecards, and dashboards

Advanced interpersonal and communication skills to provide specialized guidance and expertise to managers, staff and customers; and to develop and manage critical relationships at all levels in the enterprise.

Experience in leading and facilitating Lean/process improvements event is an asset.

Other Information

Recruitment Process: An applicant will be required to demonstrate their suitability for this position by meeting the minimum level of qualifications and experience in order to be invited into the selection process. A standard interview format will be used including general, scenario and behavioural descriptive interview questions.

Work Schedule

37.5 hours per week.

Work Designation

Hybrid

This position offers the flexibility of working both on-site and remotely within B.C.

Rate of Pay

The salary for this position ranges from $84,480 - $126,720 per annum. Actual salary offered will be based on education, experience, skills, and qualifications as they relate to the role.

We aim to provide competitive pay that reflects your professional background and expertise. We want to ensure our offer will align with your strengths considering experience, skills, and internal equity to offer a fair and equitable salary. The Total Compensation Package, which includes Extended Health, Dental, Transit Pass and enrollment in the Public Service Pension Plan as well as other employment offerings will be discussed in detail as your application progresses.

How To Apply

Please click the 'Apply' button at the top right corner or go to https://www.translink.ca/About-Us/Careers.aspx to apply for this position and view instructions on the process.

INSTRUCTIONS: Please save your (1) cover letter, and your (2) resume as one pdf document prior to uploading your application on-line.

Posting Date: May 27, 2026

Closing Date: Open until filled

Please note that only those short listed will be contacted.

Having trouble applying? Please view the System Requirements & FAQ's by going to http://www.translink.ca/careers.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Coast Mountain Bus Company is committed to employment equity and building a diverse workforce, representative of the customers we serve and the many communities in the Metro Vancouver region. We welcome and encourage Indigenous applicants, people of colour, all genders, 2SLGBTQ+ and persons with disabilities to apply. Learn more about TransLink's commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion.

Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. For a confidential inquiry, simply email us at jobs@translink.ca

Title: Insights Manager II
Description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

WHY THIS ROLE IS ON THE MENU

Instacart's Retail Insights team sits at the intersection of the industry's richest grocery data, our most strategic retail partnerships, and the CPG category intelligence that powers growth across the platform. As our retailer relationships scale and the complexity of our business deepens, we need someone who can turn that data into decisions — not just reports. We're hiring an Insights Manager II to serve as the analytical backbone for a portfolio of key grocery retail partners, translating ambiguous business questions into clear answers and actionable strategies. This role sits at the intersection of data, storytelling, and commercial impact, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to how Instacart grows its most important partnerships.

What You'll Cook Up In Your First Year


Retail partners make faster, better decisions because of your work. You've built a trusted analytical foundation — your insights are proactively sought out by Business Development and retail partners alike, not just delivered on request.
Root causes get found, not just flagged. When performance dips or opportunities surface, you've established a reputation for going deeper than the dashboard — your deep-dive analyses have directly influenced how partners run their business on Instacart.
QBRs and sell-in conversations land with impact. You've partnered with Business Development to craft business cases and quarterly business reviews that are analytically rigorous, narratively compelling, and tied to outcomes retailers care about.
Cross-functional teams are better equipped to answer "why" and "what's next." You've built or improved internal tools, frameworks, and narratives that help stakeholders move from raw data to clear direction — and the "so what" is never left unanswered.
You're the go-to expert on your category and partner landscape. Internal teams rely on you as the subject matter expert on macro business, operational, and customer trends across your set of retailers — and that expertise shapes strategy, not just reporting.


THE SECRET INGREDIENTS WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You think in outcomes, not outputs. You're as comfortable in a SQL query as you are in a boardroom presentation, and you know that neither matters unless the insight lands with the right person at the right moment.

Must-have Pantry Staples (Minimum Qualifications)


3+ years of experience in a quantitative business strategy role — consulting, banking, analytics, or similar.
Proficiency with SQL (complex, efficient queries), Excel, and data visualization tools.
Strong analytical reasoning: ability to work through ambiguous problems step by step and surface the "so what."
Polished communication skills and proven ability to manage senior stakeholder relationships, both internal and external.
A self-starter orientation — you don't wait to be handed a problem; you identify it, frame it, and drive toward an answer.


Optional Garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)


Experience in retail, e-commerce, or grocery — familiarity with the dynamics of online marketplaces or CPG categories is a meaningful accelerant.
Experience building business cases or presenting to external partners or clients.


Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

CAN

$133,000—$140,500 CAD

Proud to be 100% Canadian-owned, Northland Properties' are recognized as one of the most trusted names in hotels, restaurants, resorts, sports, construction, and asset management. Our well-known and loved brands have been bringing people together to celebrate unforgettable experiences across Canada, the US, Ireland, and the UK for over 50 years. As Canada’s fastest-growing hospitality group, we believe the foundation of our continued success is our people and their ability to take great care of our guests.

LOCATION: Support Centre, Vancouver, BC

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full Time

COMPENSATION RANGE: $75,000-85,000

BENEFITS: Health/Dental/Vision, RRSP, Paid Time Off, Employee Perks.

About The Role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to design and build the pipelines and data architecture that power analytics, reporting, and governance across the business. You'll spend most of your time moving and transforming data into Snowflake and Azure, and shaping the data models and structures that everything else depends on. It's a hands-on engineering role with room to influence how we build and scale our data platform.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines that move and transform data from source systems into Snowflake and Azure data stores.
Develop and optimize integrations between operational systems (including our D365 Finance and Power Platform environments) and the central data platform.
Design, document, and evolve data models, schemas, and the broader data architecture to support analytics, reporting, and governance.
Write efficient, maintainable SQL, and tune queries and warehouse performance.
Build automation, tooling, and operational scripts using Python and PowerShell.
Contribute to data quality, lineage, and governance standards, and keep documentation current.
Apply solid software engineering practices — version control, code review, testing, and CI/CD — to data workflows.
Partner with analysts, platform owners, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-structured data solutions.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve the reliability and performance of data pipelines.


What You'll Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of professional experience in software or data engineering.
Strong SQL skills, including complex queries and performance optimization.
Hands-on experience building data solutions in Snowflake, ADF and Azure Functions.
A solid grounding in relational databases and data modeling fundamentals.
Proficiency with Python for data processing and automation.
Working knowledge of PowerShell for scripting and automation.
A strong software development foundation: Git/version control, testing, clean and maintainable code, and sound problem-solving.
A clear communicator who collaborates well in a hybrid team setting.


Nice to Have


Experience with Azure data services (e.g., Azure SQL, Synapse, or Microsoft Fabric).
Familiarity with data governance, cataloging, or data quality frameworks.
Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and/or the Power Platform (Dataverse, Power BI, Power Automate) — helpful, but not required.
Experience with ELT/orchestration tooling, dbt, or other modern data stack components.
Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate, SnowPro).

Are you looking to expand your analytical skills and take the next step in your career? STEMCELL Technologies, Canada’s largest biotech company, is looking for a new Business Analyst II to join our growing team!

In this role, you will partner with stakeholders across the organization to shape business analysis strategies, translate business needs into effective solutions, and help deliver initiatives that support our strategic goals. You will play a key role in fostering strong relationships, facilitating collaboration across diverse business groups, and drive projects forward with clear communication and thoughtful analysis.

If you are a collaborative problem solver who enjoys connecting people, processes, and technology to deliver meaningful business outcomes, we would love to hear from you!

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities


Apply understanding of business analysis, project management methodologies, and techniques to ensure the successful implementation of all projects
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into clear requirements and support the identification of effective solutions
Perform data analysis and data modeling to identify and diagnose the root causes of business problems, deficiencies, and process gaps, and present data-driven insights and recommendations to stakeholders to guide decision-making
Design, develop, and maintain automated BI dashboards and reports to provide stakeholders with clear, actionable visibility into key metrics
Ability to adapt quickly to shifting priorities and evolving business needs, alongside a consistency in delivering high quality results in a fast paced environment


Knowledge And Qualifications


Typically requires a bachelor's degree with 6-10 years of relevant experience, a Master's degree with 4-8 years of experience, or a PhD with 2-5 years of experience
Proven facilitation, problem-solving skills, and strong knowledge of project management fundamentals
Experience making tradeoffs between business needs and technology constraints while keeping the end user needs at top of mind
Ability to quickly learn about business domains and how they function
Advanced proficiency in SQL, Tableau, and Excel (Google Sheets), including hands-on data modeling techniques

STEMCELL Technologies is a privately owned, Vancouver-based biotechnology company that helps power leading-edge life science research around the world. Driven by our love of science and passion for quality, we are a company of Scientists Helping Scientists—standing by our customers to provide the outstanding products, technical support, and training they need to advance their research. Scientists performing stem cell, immunology, cancer, regenerative medicine, and cellular therapy research are among those who rely on our cell culture media, cell separation products, instruments, accessory products, and services. Through our many regional offices, as well as our distribution centers in Vancouver, Seattle, Grenoble, and Singapore, we deliver our innovative, specialized products to more than 100 countries. With over 1,800 employees globally, most with scientific or engineering degrees, STEMCELL is proud to be the largest biotechnology employer in Canada.

This is an opportunity to work with highly motivated colleagues in a science-oriented, creative, and dynamic environment. We offer a competitive salary, excellent benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities.

STEMCELL is well recognized for exceptional leadership and business practices. We are one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies and operate an ISO 14001-certified environmental management system to measure and reduce our environmental impact.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Your Job

DarkVision is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Imaging & AI team. You will ensure the accuracy and reliability of our reporting pipelines by owning pipeline validation, data transformation logic and rapid development of new reporting deliverables. You will be the bridge between our expert data analysts, machine learning models, and the actionable insights delivered to our clients.

DarkVision’s ultrasound imaging system collects large datasets in terabytes, capturing sub-millimetric defects across assets spanning hundreds of kilometers. Interpreting this data requires more than just black-box models; it requires rigorous statistical verification. You will focus on developing the analysis and reporting pipelines that enable the intuitive results our clients need.

This role is on-site at our North Vancouver, BC HQ, where employees enjoy a wide array of amenities including a fully equipped gym, squash court, steam room, climbing wall, and more!

Our Team

Working in the Imaging & AI team, you will join a multidisciplinary group of scientists and engineers. This team is responsible for early-stage ideation, research, experimentation, and development. You will collaborate closely with scientists and engineers within the team, as well as with product managers and data analysts, to bridge the gap between our clients’ dreams and the raw data they acquire.

What You Will Do


Data Pipeline Development: Build and optimize pipelines that power reporting and visualization deliverables. You will proactively identify bottlenecks, data quality issues, or gaps in pipeline coverage to support the rapid development of new reporting deliverables.
Pipeline Validation and Report Integrity: Design and implement rigorous testing and validation processes for rendering and reporting pipelines. You will build automated quality checks to ensure reports are accurate, consistent, and delivered reliably to stakeholders.
Information Visualization: Create compelling 3D visualizations and automated reports that translate complex acoustic data into clear, client-facing insights for VPs and C-suite executives.



Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
Experience writing production code in a team environment.
Proficiency in Python for data manipulation and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools and techniques.



What Will Put You Ahead


Strong communication skills to present complex technical problems to senior non-technical audiences.
Experience building and deploying data pipelines to cloud environments, preferably using AWS infrastructure.
Experience analyzing high-dimensional, unstructured data (images, signals, or acoustic waveforms).
Experience processing data for 3D visualization in various formats (point clouds, meshes, volumes).



General Salary Range

For this role, we anticipate paying $70,000 to $110,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Who We Are

Description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD99763

Position Overview

Data is central to how we understand customer behavior, measure product success, and build better experiences for our customers. Autodesk is seeking a Senior Data Analyst - Product Analytics to join the Product Development & Manufacturing Solutions organization. In this role, you'll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Finance, Sales, and Marketing to transform product data into actionable insights that influence product strategy and business outcomes.

As a trusted analytics partner, you will help answer critical questions about feature adoption, customer engagement, retention, and product health. You'll define meaningful success metrics, develop scalable measurement frameworks, and uncover opportunities to improve the customer experience through data.

We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is naturally curious, and enjoys asking difficult questions that lead to better decisions. You combine strong analytical thinking with business acumen and exceptional communication skills to translate complex analyses into compelling stories that drive action.

At Autodesk, we value a hybrid work culture. Remote work is supported in Toronto and Vancouver, Canada. If you live near one of our offices, you're welcome to work there full- or part-time based on your preference.

Responsibilities


Partner with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle to define success metrics and measurement strategies before features launch
Analyze product telemetry, clickstream, and user behavior data to identify opportunities that improve customer engagement, adoption, and retention
Design, maintain, and evolve scalable product KPIs and data models that provide consistent measurement across products
Build self-service dashboards, reports, and visualizations that enable teams to independently explore product performance while maintaining trusted business definitions
Conduct deep-dive analyses to understand product usage, customer journeys, and feature performance, translating findings into actionable recommendations
Develop hypotheses, evaluate product changes, and support experimentation and A/B testing where applicable
Partner with Data Engineering to improve event instrumentation, data quality, and analytics infrastructure
Communicate analytical findings to executive and cross-functional audiences through clear storytelling and data visualization
Improve analytics documentation, metric definitions, and best practices to promote consistency and scalability across teams


Minimum Qualifications


5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, or Business Analytics, including experience influencing product or business decisions through data
Demonstrated experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to senior leadership and executive audiences
Expertise in SQL and working with modern cloud data warehouse environments
Advanced experience building dashboards and visualizations using Power BI (required); experience with Tableau or Looker is a plus
Experience analyzing event-based product telemetry, clickstream, or user behavior datasets
Strong understanding of analytical methods, hypothesis-driven problem solving, and translating ambiguous business questions into measurable analyses
Experience working with modern analytics engineering and data pipeline technologies (DBT, Airflow, GitHub, or similar)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience)


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, or product measurement methodologies
Experience using Python (pandas, Jupyter, NumPy, or similar) for exploratory analysis and automation
Familiarity with product analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, or similar tools
Experience integrating product analytics with Sales and Marketing data sources (Salesforce, Marketo, etc.)
Experience working within SaaS or cloud software organizations

Title: GIS & Database Analyst
Description:
Equinox Gold is a growth-focused Canadian mining company with four operating gold mines, and a clear path to achieve more than one million ounces of annual gold production from a pipeline of development and expansion projects.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Geospatial Data Manager, the GIS & Database Analyst is responsible for supporting the maintenance of SQL Server and drill hole databases and for preparing geospatial data, mapping, and spatial analysis outputs to support exploration, mine planning, operations, and environmental management activities across Equinox Gold assets.

This role operates as a technical contributor, supporting geospatial and database activities, maintaining integrity, accuracy, and accessibility of data, and contributing to data-informed decision-making, operational efficiency, compliance, and planning initiatives across multiple jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities


Maintain and update enterprise GIS databases, drill hole databases, and geospatial datasets for exploration, mining, and environmental projects.
Prepare maps, spatial visualizations, and dashboards to support technical teams and leadership decision-making.
Perform spatial analysis to support resource modeling, mine planning, infrastructure development, environmental monitoring, and ESG initiatives.
Support the integration of GIS data with other systems (e.g., mine planning software, drill hole databases, remote sensing platforms).
Assist field teams through data collection workflows, GPS/GNSS integration, and mobile GIS applications.
Support data governance, QA/QC, and standardization of geospatial data across all operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support geospatial needs and deliver solutions.
Maintain satellite imagery, LiDAR, drone data, and remote sensing datasets for operational use.
Provide user support and training on GIS tools and best practices.
Support regulatory reporting and permitting processes through accurate spatial data and mapping products.
Monitor emerging geospatial technologies and identify opportunities for improvement in business performance.
Complete assigned geospatial and database deliverables.
Provide technical support to internal stakeholders.


Required Experience & Technical Skills


3+ years of progressive experience in GIS/geospatial roles, preferably within mining or natural resources.
Working proficiency in GIS platforms (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS).
Experience with databases (e.g., drill hole databases, SQL Server).
Knowledge of remote sensing, LiDAR, and drone data processing.
Familiarity with scripting/automation tools (SQL, Python, ModelBuilder, or similar).
Experience working in multi-jurisdictional, publicly traded, or international mining environments is an asset.
Experience integrating GIS with mine planning or geological software (e.g., Deswik, MineSight, Leapfrog) is an asset.
Strong understanding of coordinate systems, projections, and geospatial data standards.


Certifications


GIS Professional (GISP) or equivalent (preferred).


Education


Bachelor’s degree in Geomatics, GIS, Geography, Geospatial Sciences, or a related field.


The salary range for this position is from $76,600.00 to $95,800.00.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Job Summary

UBC Sauder School of Business is one of the world’s leading business faculties. The school consistently ranks among the top 100 in the world and is recognized internationally for excellence in research and learning, an outstanding faculty and unmatched global partnerships. A collaborative and respectful culture within which all members of our community can thrive is a key principle in our strategic plan, and one that underpins our educational mission.

We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the Vancouver Point Grey campus is situated on the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the Musqueam. We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at UBC Robson Square is situated on the traditional territory of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh.

The Sauder IT & Analytics team partners with faculty, staff, students, and other institutional stakeholders to deliver and sustain relevant, reliable, and innovative information technology solutions. Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, we are committed to driving evidence-based decision-making in support of academic and operational excellence.

The Data Analyst sources and manages data from multiple systems-of-record, including raw data from databases and application APIs, curated extracts, and ad-hoc datasets. This position supports data management and analytics for the UBC Sauder School of Business, while working closely with institutional data governance and analytics teams.

This role focuses on identifying, sourcing, cleaning, managing and transforming data to provide clear, actionable insights for multiple UBC Sauder stakeholders. The Data Analyst is responsible for identifying and sourcing required data, preparing trusted and analytics-ready datasets, developing impactful visualizations, and enabling self-service analytics for business users using modern technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI-enabled analytics tools. The Data Analyst is responsible for a number of analytic areas, including, but not limited to, data preparation and management, data mining, statistical analysis, visual analysis, temporal data analysis and/or text analysis.

This role is ideal for a team-focused professional who specializes in identifying and preparing high-quality data and visualizations that empower business users. This position will play a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making, communicating insights, and advancing a modern data management and analytics environment for the UBC Sauder School of Business.

Organizational Status

Reports to the Assistant Dean, Information Technology & Analytics, UBC Sauder School of Business.

The Data Analyst collaborates proactively with business stakeholders within UBC Sauder, including other data analysts, faculty and administrative stakeholders. The Data Analyst also works with UBC’s Enterprise Data Governance & Business Intelligence teams. Work is reviewed in terms of achievement of high professional standards in the delivery of data and analytics services and broad project objectives and goals.

Work Performed

Business Engagement & Delivery


Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, gather requirements and translate them into analytical datasets, dashboards, reports and analytical solutions.
Work with stakeholders to identify relevant data sources, clarify data definitions, and understand how data flows across systems.
Support reporting needs across key domains (e.g., finance, HR, learning systems, marketing, admissions).
Enable self-service analytics by creating reusable datasets, semantic models, and reports.
Provide guidance and training to users on how to interpret and use data effectively.
Support business users in understanding the end-to-end flow of data.


Data Discovery, Dataset Development & Data Preparation


Identify, source, and bring together data from multiple information systems, files, databases, and business processes to support reporting and analytics needs.
Build and maintain curated, analytics-ready datasets within Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake).
Clean, transform, standardize and model data using SQL, Power Query, and Fabric Dataflows.
Apply business rules and data transformation logic to ensure datasets are accurate, consistent, and aligned with reporting needs.
Collaborate with other analysts, data managers, and technical partners to source, refine, and prepare data for analytics consumption.
Collaborate with other analysts and data managers to optimize data for performance, accuracy, and long-term maintenance.


Data Quality & Governance


Validate and reconcile data to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability across reports and dashboards.
Document data definitions, calculations, transformation logic, assumptions and lineage for transparency and reuse.
Contribute and adhere to data governance practices, including the use of standardized data definitions, metrics and metadata.
Identify and troubleshoot data issues, working with upstream teams to resolve them.


Dashboarding & Data Visualization


Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI within Microsoft Fabric.
Create clear, intuitive and visually compelling data products that communicate key metrics, trends, insights, and business unit performance.
Define and standardize KPIs and reporting layers.
Promote best practices in data visualization, usability, and performance, with an emphasis on empowering business user self-service where appropriate.


Advanced Analytics & Continuous Improvement


Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Support advanced analytics initiatives by preparing high-quality datasets.
Use novel technologies, including artificial intelligence, to support data management and analysis.
Leverage Microsoft Fabric capabilities (e.g., Notebooks, Pipelines, Data Agents) to enhance productivity and insight generation.
Manage version control of notebooks and data deployments across environments.
Improve dashboards, datasets, and reporting processes based on user feedback, and changing business needs.
Identify, source, clean, prepare and manage data from multiple independent systems-of-record.
Ensure data is continuously available in data lakes and/or data warehouses
Validate data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability across datasets.
Build dashboards, reports, and curated datasets.
Maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, KPIs, calculations, and reporting logic.
Ensure alignment with enterprise data standards and governance practices.
Support the full analytics lifecycle, from data discovery and preparation through to reporting, visualization, and insight delivery.
Contribute to the evolution of the organization’s analytics and reporting capabilities.
Performs other duties as assigned.


Consequence of Error/Judgement

The position is expected to exercise sound judgement in organizing work, communicating with stakeholders, following established procedures, documenting issues accurately, and escalating concerns in a timely manner. Poor judgement or inaccurate information may negatively affect the quality, consistency, and continuity of activities within UBC Sauder. The role will have access to a significant amount of data and responsibility for this data. All work must be within the bounds of data security and privacy.

Supervision Received

Works within a team, showing proactive initiative under the direction of the Assistant Dean, Information Technology & Analytics.

Supervision Given

Takes on a leadership role as required in directing ad hoc projects and recommending solutions to ensure optimal reporting and quality of data analysis.

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of two years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.


Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications


Undergraduate or graduate degree in Business Operations, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience in data management, data analysis, business intelligence, or other analytics roles.
Experience in proactively identifying, collecting and preparing data for use in data pipelines, reporting, and analytics.
Experience building dashboards and preparing datasets in enterprise environments.
Experience working with large and complex datasets from multiple independent systems of record.


People Skills


Excellent communication and data storytelling abilities.
Strong stakeholder engagement and collaboration skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, quality and documentation.


Technical Skills


Strong experience with Python and Microsoft Fabric (including Power BI, Dataflows, and Lakehouse/Warehouse environments).
Strong experience with SQL (T-SQL, PL/SQL) for data querying, transformation, and validation.
Advanced skills in DAX, semantic modeling, and building interactive reports within the Fabric ecosystem.
Expertise in building Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic models.
Experience with OneLake, Delta tables, and Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) concepts.
Proficiency in Power Query M and/or Microsoft Fabric Dataflows for data preparation.
Familiarity with notebook-based analytics.
Understanding of data modeling concepts (star schemas, dimensional modeling).


Additional Assets


Experience with enterprise systems such as Workday, CRM/Salesforce, and Student Information Systems.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and metadata management practices.
Familiarity with cloud-based analytics platforms (Microsoft Azure and AWS preferred).
Experience enabling self-service analytics in large organizations.
Familiarity with Data Agents/Copilot in Microsoft Fabric.
Experience working in Higher Education.

Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:
As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required








CompensationThe salary range for this role is CAD$71,000 - CAD$93,000
















Total Rewards




Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility. 










We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team. 










In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life: 












Health & wellbeing - Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).


Financial wellbeing - RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.


Time & Flexibility - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).


Family support - Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.


Growth, community & gear - Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events), Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear). 











 *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role. 








Equal Opportunity




 




Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 




 




Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  




 




All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.




 




Leave it Better




We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way. 




Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world. 




 




Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better 




Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always. 




Commit. We set bold objectives and see them through.

Description:
INTRODUCTION

At Specialty Program Group Canada (SPG Canada), we are insurance entrepreneurs united by a bold vision: to aggregate strengths and deliver unmatched value as Canada’s largest Delegated Underwriting Authority Enterprise (DUAE).




We exist to satisfy insurance needs in our target markets faster, better, and even where others might not. We do this by uniting leading underwriting talent and specialty insurance brands under one coast-to-coast platform, delivering speed, service, and expertise at a national scale.




But what truly sets us apart is our people. At SPG Canada, you will be part of a collaborative, growing team that values innovation, professional development, and shared success. Our culture is built on entrepreneurial thinking, open communication, and a strong sense of purpose. We believe in empowering our employees to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow their careers within a supportive and dynamic environment.




Our legacy MGA brands include Cansure, i3 Underwriting, Totten Insurance Group, Beacon, Anderson McTague & Associates, Mode, and Avro. Our value to our partners is further enhanced through our in-house claims management team, Specialty Claims Canada.




Together, we are building more than a market leader — we are building a place where talented professionals can thrive.




SPGCanada.ca




OVERVIEW

We are looking for an Enterprise Data Analyst to join our Data & Intelligence team.




Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric are core to this role, along with Power BI. Experience with Google Cloud data architecture (e.g., BigQuery) is an accepted alternative platform background. Experience in the insurance industry is preferred.




The Enterprise Data Analyst will work collaboratively with business partners in technology and operations, along with the field, to gather information, analyze results, investigate and identify risks and processes, and drive new and existing data products in the SPGC ecosystem.




This role sits within the Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric are core to this role, along with Power BI. Experience with Google Cloud data architecture (e.g., BigQuery) is an accepted alternative platform background. Experience in the insurance industry is preferred.

The Enterprise Data Analyst will work collaboratively with business partners in technology and operations, along with the field, to gather information, analyze results, investigate and identify risks and processes, and drive new and existing data products in the SPGC ecosystem.




This role sits within the Data & Intelligence team, which is responsible for the data used by products delivered in partnership to the field. The Analyst will work cross-functionally to drive improvements in our Data-as-a-Product solutions and will support data testing, data quality, and data governance projects as directed.




This is a hybrid position based in our Vancouver, BC office.




RESPONSIBILITIES

In this position you will:

Support various data warehouse and platform enhancement initiatives — new subject areas, improved data quality, faster data availability, internal compliance, and simplified usage — contributing to the regular, iterative release of data within the SPGC ecosystem.
Liaise with IT and Operations teams to ensure technical and business solutions fully meet stakeholder needs for BI reporting, ad-hoc extracts, data science projects, and customer relationship management.
Support business, contractual, and compliance data needs by creating and maintaining reporting pipelines and delivering one-off reports to internal and external partners.
Perform data profiling; plan, execute, and review user acceptance test (UAT) cases. Establish minimum viable product and acceptance criteria for development sprints and undertake UAT for data-related projects.
Execute data projects assigned by your line manager, ensuring business requirements are properly understood and user stories are well crafted to enable efficient, accurate ETL/ELT development.
Develop and prioritize development stories, participate in Agile ceremonies, and contribute to after-action reviews for data projects.
Establish programmatic processes to proactively measure and manage data quality (ideally automated) using SQL and related languages; coordinate remediation of data defects and data quality problems.
Collaborate with the Data & Intelligence team to implement common data definitions and metadata documentation. Serve as an EDW and data-source subject matter expert.




QUALIFICATIONS AND CHARACTERISTICS

You’re a good fit if you have:

Bachelor’s degree in a related quantitative field, or 5 years of related insurance industry data experience.
Strong, hands-on SQL proficiency — query authoring, performance tuning, and data validation.
Microsoft Fabric experience (Google Cloud data architecture such as BigQuery accepted as an alternative platform background).
Strong, hands-on SQL and Python proficiency — query authoring, performance tuning, data validation, and transformation/automation work in Microsoft Fabric notebooks.
Power BI and DAX for reporting and dashboarding.
Practical exposure to data warehousing, business intelligence, data modeling, and master data management concepts.
Demonstrated SCRUM/Agile experience.
Understanding of data governance, data integration, and master data management best practices.
A consultative style that leverages both business and technical resources.

Strong assets (nice to haves):

Familiarity with the EPIC broker management system.
Exposure to NetSuite / NetSuite Analytics Warehouse.




BENEFITS

By joining Specialty Program Group Canada, you’ll become part of a rapidly growing company focused on providing innovative insurance solutions to support independent brokers in Canada. As a member of our team, you’ll benefit from:

Dental care
Extended health care
Paid time-off
RRSP match
